title: Cybersecurity Manager
descriptionHtml:
Cybersecurity Manager

Location: Remote - Europe (European time zones)

About FullEnrich:

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them and verifying data in real-time until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.

What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted GTM data infrastructure layer powering modern revenue teams and AI agents. Today, more than 6,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, Intercom, Unify,and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

The Role:

You'll be joining as our Cybersecurity Manager, reporting directly to our VP of Engineering.

At FullEnrich, security and privacy aren't just compliance requirements; they're fundamental to our product and the trust our customers place in us. As we scale, we're looking for someone to take ownership of our security, compliance, and corporate IT programs, ensuring we continue to protect our customers, strengthen our infrastructure, and meet the expectations of increasingly sophisticated enterprise clients.

As our first dedicated security and IT hire, you'll have the opportunity to build and shape this function from the ground up. You'll own our security strategy and compliance roadmap, working closely with Engineering, leadership, and teams across the business to implement practical, scalable controls. Our engineers build and operate the platform, while you'll define, oversee, and continuously improve the security measures that protect it.

We're already SOC 2 compliant, with ISO 27001 and additional certifications on the horizon. Operating across multiple regions and working with 20+ data providers also brings interesting challenges around data privacy, vendor security, and international regulations.

This is a hands-on role with significant autonomy, direct exposure to leadership, and the opportunity to build a security function that grows alongside the business.

What You'll Do:

Security & Infrastructure

  • Own and continuously improve our application and infrastructure security posture, partnering with Engineering to implement and maintain effective security controls.

  • Lead our vulnerability management program, including external penetration testing, vulnerability disclosure, and remediation tracking.

  • Identify, assess, and prioritize security risks, ensuring vulnerabilities are addressed based on their potential business impact.

Compliance & Certifications

  • Own our security compliance program end to end, maintaining SOC 2 and leading future certifications such as ISO 27001.

  • Manage ongoing evidence collection, auditor relationships, control assessments, and remediation activities.

  • Develop and maintain a scalable compliance roadmap aligned with business growth and customer requirements.

Security Governance & Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain security policies, risk assessments, and our company-wide risk register.

  • Lead regular access reviews, security awareness initiatives, and incident response preparedness.

  • Coordinate security incidents and drive continuous improvements to our security processes and controls.

Corporate IT & Identity Management

  • Own our corporate IT security framework, including device management (MDM), identity providers, SSO, and SaaS access controls.

  • Oversee secure employee onboarding and offboarding, account provisioning, and hardware inventory management, working with our operational IT team on execution.

  • Improve and automate IT security processes to ensure they remain reliable and scalable as the company grows.

Data Privacy & Vendor Security

  • Oversee privacy operations, including data subject requests, vendor data processing agreements, and cross-border data transfers.

  • Ensure our practices align with applicable privacy regulations, including GDPR and US state privacy laws, coordinating with our DPO and relevant stakeholders.

  • Build and maintain a risk-based vendor security assessment process across our data providers and wider SaaS ecosystem.

Customer Trust & Enterprise Security

  • Own the security due diligence process for enterprise customers, including questionnaires, audits, and security reviews.

  • Maintain our customer-facing security documentation, trust page, and audit report distribution.

  • Partner with Sales and leadership to turn security and compliance into a competitive advantage, helping customers move through procurement and security reviews with confidence.

What Success Looks Like:

By 3 months

  • You've taken full ownership of our existing SOC 2 compliance program, with evidence collection, control monitoring, and auditor coordination running smoothly.

  • You've assessed our current security posture, completed an initial risk assessment, and identified the highest-priority improvements across infrastructure, corporate IT, and identity management.

  • You've established an effective process for handling enterprise security questionnaires and customer due diligence, with turnaround times measured in days rather than weeks.

  • You've developed an initial 12-month security roadmap covering remediation priorities, penetration testing, incident response, and future certifications.

By 6 months

  • You've implemented improvements to our highest-priority security and IT controls, including identity management, endpoint security, and access governance.

  • You've established a repeatable vulnerability management process, with penetration testing completed or underway and remediation tracked through to resolution.

  • You've strengthened our incident response readiness through documented procedures and a tabletop exercise.

  • You've implemented consistent processes for vendor security reviews and privacy operations, ensuring risks are assessed and regulatory obligations are managed effectively.

By 12 months

  • Our SOC 2 compliance program is operating as a continuous, audit-ready process, with renewals running smoothly and minimal disruption to the wider business.

  • You've made measurable progress against our security roadmap, including advancing ISO 27001 or other certifications agreed with leadership.

  • Our corporate IT and security processes are reliable, scalable, and embedded into everyday operations.

  • Security is actively supporting business growth, with faster enterprise due diligence, stronger customer confidence, and fewer security-related obstacles in the sales process.

What We're Looking For:

  • Proven experience owning a security and compliance program end to end, including SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification, auditor management, evidence collection, and control remediation.

  • Strong understanding of application and cloud infrastructure security, with the ability to partner effectively with Engineering teams to identify risks and implement practical controls.

  • Hands-on experience with corporate IT security, including MDM, identity providers, SSO/SCIM, SaaS access management, and employee lifecycle processes.

  • Solid knowledge of data privacy regulations, particularly GDPR, and experience navigating international data protection requirements and cross-border transfers.

  • Experience managing security governance processes, including risk assessments, vulnerability management, incident response, and security policies.

  • A proactive, hands-on approach, with the ability to balance strategic thinking with practical execution in a fast-moving environment.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the confidence to work across technical and non-technical teams, engage with auditors, and represent security in enterprise customer discussions.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience working in a data-heavy or API-first SaaS business, particularly data enrichment, data brokerage, or similar industries.

  • Security management certifications such as CISM (Certified Information Security Manager) or equivalent.

  • Experience working as, or closely alongside, a Data Protection Officer (DPO).

  • Experience supporting enterprise sales processes through security due diligence and customer-facing security reviews.

  • French language skills or proficiency in another European language.

The Hiring Process:

  • Intro to FullEnrich with our Talent Team (30 min) – A chance to learn more about you, introduce FullEnrich and the role, and explore whether there's a mutual fit.

  • Practical case on a real security & compliance scenario from our world (1 hr) – A chance for you to showcase how you think and work.

  • Deep dive with the VP of Engineering (1 hr) – A chance to talk through your approach, strategy, and how you'd operate in this role.

  • Final with the CEO (45 min) – A chance for you to meet our CEO, Ben, and have a conversation around FullEnrich's values, ambitions, how we work, and what we're building together.

Benefits:

Your benefits package will reflect the requirements and market practices of the country in which you're employed, including applicable leave, healthcare, retirement and wellbeing benefits.

Full details will be shared during the hiring process.

FullEnrich is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

title: Data Engineering Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Plasma

Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.


The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

The Role

We're looking for a hands-on Data Lead to build Plasma's data function from the ground up. You'll be our first dedicated data hire, working across Consumer, Payments and Business to give the company one trusted view of its users, its money and its operations.

At first you'll build much of the platform yourself: our Snowflake warehouse, the pipelines that feed it and the modelled layer on top. As the function grows, you'll choose the tools, set the standards and hire the team.

The Work

  • Own Plasma's data platform end to end: the Snowflake warehouse, ingestion from production systems and third-party providers, and the modelled layer the rest of the company builds on

  • Define the metrics the company runs on, including funded users, activation, engagement, balances, spend and retention, and make sure every team uses the same definitions

  • Partner with Consumer to understand how users behave across regions, segments and products, and turn that into specific product decisions

  • Design and analyse experiments, and be clear about when a result is real and when it isn't

  • Work with Payments and finance so the business can trust its numbers: reconciliation across ledgers, providers and banking partners, revenue reporting and unit economics

  • Find fraudulent and abusive patterns across onboarding, funding, card spend and transfers, and build the signals and rules that let risk and operations act on them

  • Treat data quality, testing, access control and PII handling as part of the platform, not an afterthought

  • Choose tools deliberately, set standards for the function and hire the team as Plasma scales

The Bar

  • A senior, hands-on data practitioner with a track record of both building a data platform and using it

  • Deep SQL and data modelling skills, with enough engineering range to build and run production pipelines yourself

  • Comfortable starting from very little, and building something that still makes sense when the team is five times bigger

  • Strong judgment on tradeoffs: speed vs. rigour, build vs. buy, a quick answer now vs. a reusable model later

  • You turn analysis into decisions. You can explain a finding to a non-technical leader in a few sentences and tell them what to do about it

  • You communicate clearly, write clean, tested code, and lead through technical decisions whether or not you're managing people yet

  • You have very high agency. You don't wait to be told which problem to work on; you go and find the ones that matter

Nice to have

  • You've been an early or founding data hire at a fast-growing fintech

  • Experience with real money data at a fintech: payments, cards, ledgers, settlement, chargebacks or FX. You know the ways financial data goes wrong

  • Hands-on fraud, risk or financial-crime analytics

  • Familiarity with stablecoins and on-chain data, including how blockchain transactions map to accounts, balances and ledgers

  • Experience hiring and growing a data team

  • Machine learning in production for fraud, risk or personalisation

What's in it for you

  • Above-market salary for the level of the role, with token compensation.

  • A beautiful London HQ with gym access and daily food, for those who thrive in an office environment. Visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're joining from abroad.

  • Premium health insurance for you and your family, fully covered by Plasma.

  • Monthly wellness budget, whether that's the gym, therapy, sauna, or massage.

  • All the tools and tech you need to operate at your best.

  • Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with your work shipping to hundreds of thousands of people, moving millions of dollars every day.

Data Protection & Privacy
We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Any personal information you provide during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable local data protection laws.

title: Design Manager or Senior Design Manager - Norway (Stargate Norway - Narvik)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for Europe’s AI revolution. Nscale are developing cutting-edge sovereign generative AI solutions, powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centres and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads.

The growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Nscale is positioned at the heart of this transformation — building the platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation.

Nscale are working closely with the world’s most advanced AI technology providers, integrating next-gen compute hardware and GPU clusters in both partner and Nscale built facilities. This is an opportunity to join Nscale’s journey, play a key role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company designed to scale rapidly across Europe and beyond.

The Role

The Design Manager will be based on-site in Narvik and will oversee the design process throughout delivery of the Stargate Norway initiative. The position is essential in ensuring the design process enables our facilities to be built to world-class technical standards, delivered on schedule, to budget, and adaptable to the rapidly evolving needs of AI compute. You’ll work together with Construction, Cost Management, and in-country delivery teams, as well as collaborating with key technology providers and design partners to bring high-density infrastructure from concept to reality.


Key Responsibilities

  • Involvement in the full lifecycle of data centre and infrastructure design — from concept development through construction drawings — Nscale’s solution is tailored to support dense AI compute, low-latency workloads, and high-efficiency operations; contributing to the creation, evaluation, upkeep, and continuous improvement of design documentation, technical standards, and specifications, ensuring they support organisational goals while encouraging innovation and best practice.
  • Review design packages for code compliance, constructability, and performance. Identify risks early and implement design changes to maintain project trajectory.
  • Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders (design, construction, cost, engineering, in-country teams) to align design with business objectives and project needs.
  • Involvement in permitting processes coordinating with local consultants 
  • Design and adapt facilities to accommodate advanced compute clusters, high-power electrical infrastructure, and liquid cooling solutions. Familiarity with modern AI compute architecture is a strong advantage.
  • Manage internal alignment and consultant teams, ensuring cohesive, accurate, and high-quality design deliverables that meet technical and operational standards.
  • Maintain project schedules, deliverable tracking, and clear documentation workflows using BIM and cloud-based collaboration tools.
Who You Are
  • Experienced design manager, preferably in data centre, mission-critical, or high-performance computing projects.
  • Technically Strong – Deep knowledge of MEP systems, high-density power, and infrastructure suited for AI compute.
  • Collaborative – Comfortable working across teams and time zones, including remote and hybrid models. NScale’s culture is to build collaborative teams of which you will be an integral part.
  • Multilingual – Fluency in English is required; Norwegian preferred, other European languages are an advantage.
  • Digitally Fluent – Proficient with Procore/EDMS systems, Revit, Navisworks, and BIM-based workflows.
  • Startup-Ready – Flexible, proactive, and ready to help build world leading AI systems, culture, and scale.

title: Directeur Exploitation Datacenters – Infrastructures Critiques (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Head of DC Operations (H/F)

Région parisienne

Votre mission

Dans un environnement où la disponibilité et la fiabilité des infrastructures sont essentielles, Isatalent recherche un(e) Head of DC Operations pour piloter les opérations de ses data centers en région parisienne.

Rattaché(e) à la direction, vous êtes garant(e) de la performance opérationnelle, de la continuité de service et de la fiabilité des infrastructures. Vous encadrez les responsables de site et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'expertise centrales, les clients et les partenaires de maintenance.

Dans un contexte de croissance de l'entreprise et d'exigences opérationnelles, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'harmonisation des pratiques, la structuration du pilotage des activités et l'accompagnement du changement auprès des équipes.

Votre objectif : construire une vision opérationnelle consolidée, maîtriser les risques et fédérer les équipes autour d'exigences communes de performance, de sécurité et de qualité de service.

Important – Nature du profil recherché

Nous recherchons un/e professionnel/le de l'exploitation technique de datacenters (Data Center Operations / Critical Facilities), et non un Directeur des Systèmes d'Information ou un Directeur des infrastructures IT.

Une expérience concrète du pilotage opérationnel des infrastructures physiques critiques est indispensable : installations électriques (HT/BT), UPS, groupes électrogènes, systèmes de refroidissement (CVC), maintenance préventive et corrective, gestion des incidents et continuité de service.

Les profils exclusivement orientés IT, systèmes, réseaux, cloud, hébergement ou gestion de projets informatiques ne correspondent pas au périmètre du poste.

Vos responsabilités

Piloter la stratégie et la performance des opérations multisites

  • Élaborer une feuille de route opérationnelle à court et moyen terme, en définissant les priorités, les plans d'action et les ressources humaines et financières nécessaires.

  • Définir et harmoniser les méthodes de pilotage des activités opérationnelles sur l'ensemble des sites.

  • Consolider et faire évoluer les KPI et tableaux de bord portant notamment sur la disponibilité des infrastructures, la maintenance, la communication client et le respect des procédures.

  • Analyser les résultats, identifier les écarts de performance et piloter les actions correctives.

  • Produire un reporting structuré à destination de la direction et éclairer les décisions stratégiques.

Manager les responsables de site et accompagner la transformation

  • Encadrer et accompagner les responsables de site dans le pilotage de leurs activités et le développement de leurs compétences.

  • Apporter une expertise opérationnelle et technique permettant de challenger les choix, les priorités et les plans d'action.

  • Favoriser l'autonomie, la responsabilisation et la coopération des équipes.

  • Organiser l'allocation des ressources et le suivi des plans de charge.

  • Accompagner la réorganisation du périmètre, harmoniser les pratiques et contribuer à l'intégration de nouveaux sites.

  • Travailler en transversalité avec le responsable du pôle Expertise et les autres fonctions de l'entreprise.

Garantir la fiabilité des infrastructures et maîtriser les risques

  • Garantir la disponibilité, la résilience et la continuité d'exploitation des infrastructures critiques.

  • Superviser la maintenance préventive, corrective et réglementaire, ainsi que les travaux, extensions, rétrofits et changements réalisés en environnement exploité.

  • Reprendre et consolider la cartographie des risques opérationnels et techniques, notamment les points uniques de défaillance (SPOF) et les obsolescences critiques.

  • Hiérarchiser les risques, définir les plans de traitement, en évaluer les impacts financiers et humains et identifier les investissements nécessaires.

  • Piloter les incidents majeurs, les escalades, les analyses de causes et le suivi des actions correctives et préventives.

  • Garantir le respect des exigences de sécurité, de conformité et de continuité de service.

Développer la relation client et le partenariat avec les mainteneurs

  • Garantir le respect des engagements contractuels, des SLA et des standards de qualité attendus par les clients.

  • Renforcer la qualité de la communication opérationnelle et la confiance avec les interlocuteurs clients.

  • Développer une relation constructive et partenariale avec les mainteneurs et les prestataires.

  • Améliorer la coordination des interventions, le suivi des engagements et la qualité des prestations.

  • Identifier les axes de progrès et piloter les actions d'amélioration de la performance des partenaires.

Piloter les budgets et l'amélioration continue

  • Élaborer et suivre les budgets OPEX et CAPEX du périmètre.

  • Arbitrer les priorités de maintenance, de renouvellement et d'investissement en fonction des risques, des capacités et des engagements clients.

  • Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires, environnementales, HSE, ICPE et des référentiels ISO applicables.

  • Déployer des standards, procédures et méthodes de travail homogènes.

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de la performance énergétique des installations, notamment du PUE, et à la maîtrise des coûts d'exploitation.

Votre profil

Formation et expérience

  • Formation supérieure, idéalement Bac +5, de type ingénieur ou master spécialisé en génie électrique, énergétique, climatique, maintenance industrielle ou management des opérations. Un Bac +3 technique pourra être étudié au regard d'une expérience particulièrement solide.

  • Expérience significative dans l'exploitation, la maintenance ou la direction technique d'infrastructures critiques.

  • Expérience significative en management de managers, en pilotage multisite ou dans une fonction de responsabilité opérationnelle comparable.

title: Director, Corporate Development & Investor Relations
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You'll shape Airwallex's global corporate development strategy in line with the company’s long-term vision and help drive strategic growth and investor engagement globally.

  • Lead live M&A execution, including operating and financial modelling, due diligence, cross-functional coordination, and post-acquisition integration.

  • Build and maintain relationships with venture, growth, and public equity investors.

  • Develop clear investor materials and communicate Airwallex’s strategy, performance, and growth drivers to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Partner with Finance, Legal, Data Science, the CEO’s Office, and other teams to support fundraising, strategic finance initiatives, and high-impact decisions across the business.


This role is based in London, and you'll be expected to work from the office three days a week (Mondays, Wednesdays, Thursdays).

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 10+ years of experience in top-tier investment banking, private equity, venture capital, management consulting, corporate development, or an equivalent field.

  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

  • Investment banking experience, including M&A and live deal execution.

  • Strong analytical skills and data literacy, with the ability to create clear, concise investment memos and financial models.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to senior management and external stakeholders.

  • A track record of operating as a self-starter, prioritizing effectively, and managing a demanding workload.

  • A strong sense of accountability for delivering important outcomes.

Preferred

  • Experience in technology, financial services, and/or a high-growth environment.

You'll thrive here if

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

  • You come to the table with a point of view, not just a problem.

  • You can advocate hard for a position, then fully support the team’s direction once a call is made.

Learn more about your team

Finance & Corporate Development helps Airwallex grow with control. We're a trusted partner to the business, providing actionable insights on performance, supporting market and product expansion and helping to shape the future of our product. We ensure that Airwallex meets its financial reporting, tax and safeguarding obligations globally. We work with existing and prospective investors to raise capital and ensure it is deployed effectively.

This is a team for people who want to reimagine how the CFO office works. We’re looking for founder-like energy, high integrity and a passion for technology. You'll thrive here if you enjoy working cross-functionally, think from first principles and can balance speed of execution with analytical precision.

All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Equal opportunity

title: Director, EMEA Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About the Role

We are looking for a Director, EMEA Professional Services to build and lead our services and customer engineering motion across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

This is a player-coach leadership role at the center of the EMEA go-to-market. You will shape how we engage EMEA customers after the sale and alongside it. You will help Sales position and sell both the subscription and, when it fits, services. You will own staffing and delivery for EMEA engagements. You will also coordinate the wider Customer Engineering team in region, including Enablement Engineers, Activation Specialists, and Account Managers.

You will work closely with EMEA GTM leadership and stay aligned with global Professional Services leadership. EMEA should feel like one team with the rest of PS, with the local context it needs to win.

Location: London preferred. Open to other EMEA locations with strong overlap with UK and European business hours. Some travel to customers and to our San Francisco and New York offices is expected.

What You'll Do

  • Define EMEA Customer Engineering programs: Partner with EMEA GTM leadership to design and run programs for the region. This includes onboarding, activation, enablement, and services offerings. Adapt global programs to regional needs such as data residency, regulated industries, language, and partner ecosystems.

  • Support positioning and selling: Support the creation and evolution of standard pre sales assets to support the AEs with positioning Professional Services. Work with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers on deal strategy. Help position the subscription and the right post-sale path for each customer. Join executive conversations when needed. Scope and sell Professional Services when it is the right fit. Review SOWs, estimates, and pricing for EMEA deals.

  • Own resource management and delivery: Own staffing, capacity planning, and utilization for the EMEA PS team. Match engagements to the right people and practices. Make sure delivery follows PS methodology, including scoping, technical review, documentation, and customer handoff. Review key deliverables, surface risk early, and handle escalations.

  • Lead and grow the EMEA team: Hire, onboard, coach, and develop Architects, AI Engineers, and Engagement Managers in region. Set clear expectations and give direct feedback. Build a team culture with a high bar for quality and craft.

  • Coordinate across global Customer Engineering in a matrix model: Provide day-to-day coordination and supervision for EMEA Enablement Engineers, Activation Specialists, and Account Managers. Set shared priorities and make sure customers get a connected journey from activation to enablement to services to expansion. Work with their functional leaders on performance, growth, and standards.

  • Align with global PS leadership: Keep delivery standards, tooling, pricing, and reporting consistent across regions. Share what works in EMEA. Bring back playbooks, reusable assets, and process improvements from the global team. Contribute to the PS operating rhythm and roadmap.

  • Run the business: Own EMEA PS bookings, utilization, delivery margin, and customer outcomes. Report on pipeline, capacity, and risk to Customer Engineering and GTM leadership.

  • Stay close to customers: Remain active in key accounts. Act as the senior escalation point for strategic EMEA customers. Be a credible voice with technical and executive stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

  • You have 10+ years of experience in professional services, solutions engineering, customer engineering, or consulting. At least 4 of those years were in leadership roles.

  • You have led a services or post-sales team in EMEA. You know the regional market and its regulatory landscape.

  • You have helped sell technical services alongside a software subscription. You can scope work, price it, and defend it with customers.

  • You have owned resource management and delivery. You understand utilization, capacity planning, and delivery quality.

  • You have led through influence in a matrix organization. You can set direction for people who do not report to you.

  • You are credible with engineers and executives. You can discuss agent architectures, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise AI adoption.

  • You have built programs from scratch in a fast-moving environment. You do not wait to be told what to do.

  • You communicate clearly and directly. You work well across time zones with a global team.

You exemplify our operating principles

  • You are motivated to build something great. You hold a high bar for quality, craft, and impact.

  • You embrace hot takes. You share informed opinions, challenge the status quo, and engage in constructive debate.

  • You operate with maximum agency. You take ownership, move work forward independently, and help others unblock.

  • You run to the roar. You lean into hard problems, ambiguity, and fast-moving challenges.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML, LLM applications, or agent frameworks

  • Experience with SaaS subscriptions, usage-based pricing, and services attach

  • Experience working with SIs and cloud marketplaces in EMEA

  • Experience in a high-growth startup or open-source company

  • Fluency in one or more European languages in addition to English

How Success Will Be Measured

  • EMEA customers have clear programs and a connected post-sale journey.

  • Services attach rate and bookings grow in the region, with healthy margins.

  • EMEA PS meets its utilization target over time, with exceptions understood and managed.

  • Delivery consistently follows PS standards, and material risks surface early.

  • Matrix partners in Enablement, Activation, and Account Management are aligned on EMEA priorities.

  • EMEA practices stay consistent with global PS and feed improvements back to it.

Compensation and Benefits

descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role summary and impact 

This role is within the Data, Tech, and Analytics (DTA) team, within the Global Client Solutions organisation. The Global Client Solutions (GCS) team is responsible for all global clients within WPP. DTA is responsible for servicing clients with best-in-class data solutions, data strategy, analytics, technology and AI solutions to drive client growth. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. We believe the best work happens when we’re together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. 

Who we are looking for 

We are seeking a Director of Global Client Enablement to drive adoption, scale and measurable value from WPP Open across a portfolio of global client accounts hubbed in France. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a hands-on environment, working closely with clients, agencies, and internal teams to drive adoption, engagement, and measurable value from our platform and DTA services. 

You will be responsible for assessing adoption, identifying opportunities and blockers, and coordinating prioritised adoption plans, ensuring that client teams are trained and supported, and that feedback loops are established to continuously improve the client and user experience. You will work alongside regional and global enablement leaders to ensure your cluster’s enablement efforts align with WPP Media’s broader business objectives (Keep, Grow, Win). 

What you’ll do 

  • Client-team adoption:
    • Manage enablement programs for two key global client accounts within the French hub.
    • Assess adoption maturity, client priorities and use cases.
    • Identify opportunities and blockers and create clear, prioritised adoption plans.
    • Ensure client teams are onboarded effectively and supported through adoption of WPP Open, including relevant media tools, Agent Hub and Open Intelligence. Partner with account teams to expand product usage and deliver measurable business impact. 
  • Hands-on enablement delivery:
    • Deliver tailored product walkthroughs, demos and training, supported by practical guidance and best practice.
    • Coordinate change-management activity that helps client teams move to WPP Open-enabled workflows, embeds new ways of working and sustains day-to-day adoption. 
  • Collaboration & coordination:
    • Act as the primary enablement contact for the client portfolio, coordinating the adoption journey across client, account, regional, Product, Data and Analytics teams.
    • Establish clear owners and follow-through for actions, maintain feedback loops, share learning across accounts and markets, and consolidate client evidence to inform product and roadmap priorities.
  • Cross-functional enablement: 
    • Coordinate relevant cross-studio workstreams, pilots and joint initiatives across Media, Creative, Production, Commerce and other WPP capabilities.
    • Surface, document and route product, data or technical blockers to the appropriate specialist teams, track progress and maintain alignment through resolution without assuming specialist delivery ownership. 
  • Performance tracking & reporting:
    • Monitor adoption metrics, engagement levels and client satisfaction across the portfolio.
    • Evidence measurable client value, identify trends and gaps, reassess adoption maturity and adjust priorities and adoption plans with regional Enablement leadership. 
  • Support for growth & retention:
    • Identify opportunities for deeper adoption, optimisation and new WPP Open use cases that create measurable client value and support growth and retention.
    • Contribute to pitches where relevant, and develop enablement materials, case studies and success stories that evidence impact and can be reused across clients. 

The role coordinates enablement and adoption; technical deployment, configuration, integration and specialist delivery remain with the relevant Product and capability teams. 

Skills and Experience 

  • Experience in client enablement, customer success, change management or training within a technology or data-driven organisation. 
  • Strong understanding of technology and AI-enabled platforms and ability to act as a confident product advocate. 
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and influence stakeholders. 
  • Ability to work collaboratively across functions and manage multiple client priorities. 
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret adoption data and translate insights into action. 
  • Familiarity with media planning and buying workflows is a plus but not required. 

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. 

We believe the best work happens when we’re together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment.

title: Director, Learning & Development, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need.

As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.

Summary of Position:

We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Director, Learning & Development – EMEA to lead the development and execution of learning initiatives across EMEA markets.

This role will focus on strengthening organizational capabilities across three key pillars: Clinical Acumen, Business Acumen, and Leadership & Soft Skills, ensuring employees have the knowledge, skills, and confidence to drive business performance.

The Director will partner closely with regional leadership and global cross-functional teams to deliver a consistent global learning strategy while addressing local market needs.


Position Responsibilities

Clinical Acumen & Scientific Excellence

  • Develop learning programs focused on disease state, mechanisms of action, clinical evidence, and therapeutic landscapes. Enhancing clinical story telling consistent with the approved product information (SmPC) and applicable codes of practice. Partner and coordinate with Commercial, Medical Affairs, Marketing, and other stakeholders to ensure scientific knowledge and learning standards are met. L&D drives design, delivery and measurement of training programs, and collaborates with functional leads on application in the field.
    • Establish clinical competency assessments and certification programs, defined jointly with Medical Affairs and the Information Officer / Scientific Service, to ensure readiness and proficiency and to meet national requirements for medical sales representative qualification where applicable.

      • Business Acumen & Commercial Excellence

      • Build capabilities in market understanding, strategic thinking, business planning, and commercial execution.
      • Develop learning initiatives that strengthen top-quality customer engagement, account management, and competitive understanding.
      • Partner with regional leaders to identify capability gaps and align learning priorities with business objectives.
      • Support product launches, commercial readiness, and continuous performance improvement.

        • Leadership Development & Soft Skills

        • Design programs focused on emotional intelligence, communication, effective questioning, active listening, and influencing skills.
        • Strengthen leadership capabilities in coaching, feedback, accountability, and team development.
        • Foster collaboration, adaptability, and a culture of continuous learning.
        • Integrate behavioral development into clinical and commercial learning initiatives.

          • Global Alignment & Learning Effectiveness

          • Translate the Global L&D strategy into a regional learning roadmap aligned with European business priorities.
          • Ensure consistency in learning objectives, content, competency standards, and execution across markets.
          • Adapt learning experiences to local market requirements while maintaining global alignment.
          • Implement learning assessments, certification, and performance measurement to demonstrate impact.
          • In line with Company policies, leverage Artificial Intelligence and digital learning platforms and innovative methodologies to enhance learning effectiveness.
          • Ensure that the use of AI and digital tools for content creation maintains the required medical, legal and compliance review standards, data privacy and traceability.

            • Medical, Legal & Compliance Governance

            In Europe, learning operates within a highly regulated framework. The Director will establish and run a structured governance and operating model with Medical Affairs and the Information Officer / Scientific Service on one side, and Legal & Compliance on the other. This model ensures that all scientific and medical training content is accurate, balanced and approved through the appropriate channels, and that all learning, especially for customer-facing roles, meets applicable legal, regulatory and industry code requirements.

descriptionHtml:

The Director of Employee Listening & Insights will lead WPP’s global approach to understanding and responding to employee sentiment, creating a scalable, insight-led listening ecosystem that drives visible action and sustains trust through transformation.

  • Build a data-driven culture where employee sentiment and experience are embedded into decision-making at all levels.

  • Increasing the insight-to-action ratio, with listening insights translated into tangible and communicated actions.
  • Monitoring transformation sentiment and fatigue, identifying emerging risks and enabling timely intervention.

What you'll need:

  • Proven experience shaping and activating employee listening and insights strategies, translating feedback into meaningful organisational change and action.
  • Strong partnership skills, with experience working across People Analytics, HR, GBS, Communications and Technology to deliver an integrated listening and insights approach.

  • Experience working within large, complex, global and federated organisations, balancing global consistency with local and regional needs.

About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Join Delinea as Sales Engineering Director for Northern Europe and shape how the world’s leading identity security platform is positioned and demonstrated to enterprise customers. In this role, you will build and mentor a team of 5-7 Sales Engineers across the region, develop technical strategy, and directly influence Delinea’s competitive positioning in the market. title: Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰 Base salary for this role is £112,000 - £145,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits 

Engineering Management at Monzo:

Engineering Managers at Monzo are part of cross-functional, autonomous teams and groups. Our teams are mission driven, and typically include Product Managers, backend, web and mobile engineers as well as data scientists, designers and subject matter experts relevant to that mission. Teams are organised into groups, and then collectives - we aim to keep our line management structure as shallow as possible, and for teams to directly own decision making relevant to their work.

The Engineering Manager role at Monzo is split into three pillars - people, product, and technical leadership. Engineering Managers are accountable for the technical and delivery outcomes for their area - that means supporting and developing best in class engineering talent, as well as creating an inclusive team environment for people to do their best work.

You can read more on the expectations of Engineering Managers on our Progression Framework.

The Role

We're continuously hiring Engineering Managers as we continue to grow and build new teams. We hire on a pipeline based approach which means your application will be considered across all of our open EM positions. We use the interview process to assess your strengths and we'll match you to a role that best aligns with your experience. Of course, this is a collaborative process so you can also tell us which roles you're most interested in as you progress through interviews 😊 We're currently hiring across Platform, Core App, and Expansion.

You’ll spend your time:

  • Taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager.
  • Actively fostering a high bar for engineering excellence within your teams. You’re accountable for the technical outcomes your teams deliver alongside individual engineer performance and growth, so holding a high bar (and clearly articulating your expectations) is key.
  • You’ll initially lead a group of around 7-10 engineers (depending on the role) and support, coach and develop them through their career with regular 1:1s and continuous feedback.
  • Partner with senior engineers in your area to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.
  • Lead on communication with stakeholders from other teams, creating focus space for engineers to do their best work.
  • Collaborate with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.

You should apply if:

While this is not a role which requires hands-on-coding, we are looking for an experienced manager who has a strong technical and delivery background and has worked as a software engineer in previous roles.

We recognise that engineering managers lead in different ways, we’re looking for someone who: 

  • Is comfortable operating with ambiguous problem areas with a high degree of autonomy.
  • It’s a bonus if you have experience working in an experimentation led environment.
  • Has delivery experience and is able to guide the squads in achieving their outcomes.
  • Focuses on outcomes over processes, who optimises for the highest impact and leverage.
  • Is able to input, understand and challenge engineering decisions - but to empower the team to make those decisions themselves
  • Has an understanding of what good looks like for a high-performing team of engineers and ability to chart a course to get there
  • Is able to to coach people to achieve their goals
  • Has a natural ability to inspire and motivate a team

We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again.

How we work 💻:

Locations & Flexible Working : 

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. 

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. 

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

The interview process:

After an initial informal 30 min recruiting call, our interview process involves two main stages:

  1. Initial Call Interview (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our Senior Engineering Managers or Engineering Directors. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)

  2. Loop Stage (3 hours 30 mins) The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability) and one 30 minute reverse interview (more details below).

The Loop is one stage, and the interviews in the Loop are:

- Team and Org Management (1 hour)
An example based interview with 1-2 of our engineering leaders. They’re interested to hear examples from your previous experience on the teams you’ve led, how you’ve shaped and partnered with product, and the impact you had.

- System Design (1 hour)
You'll partner with a Staff or Principal Engineer on a technical whiteboarding exercise.

- Behavioural (1 hour)
Similar to Team and Org Management, this is an example based interview with 1-2 Engineering Leaders. This interview focuses on your people leadership style and core behaviours as an Engineering Manager.

- Chat with an Engineering Leader (30 mins)
At Monzo, we believe interviews are a two-way street. This will be your opportunity to ask us any questions about Monzo, engineering leadership or our teams – whatever’s on your mind. 

All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. 

What’s in it for you:

💰 Base salary for this role is £112,000 - £145,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK  

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍We offer flexible working with no company mandate on how often you need to come into the office. You can be London based or remote within the UK (with ad hoc visits to our London office).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here

We're usually always hiring for Engineering Managers, so there's no closing date for this job.

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

title: Enterprise Sales & Strategy Associate (Internship)
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🐼 Who we are

You. Better. With Alan.

Alan's vision is to make prevention the new norm of care for all. Our mission is to help people live in good health to 100 while helping employers feel proud, turning health benefits from a cost centre into their most valuable investment.

We're building a vertically integrated health partner that seamlessly unites insurance and smart healthcare delivery into one system.

By connecting all aspects of care - private, public, and direct to consumer - we create the most member-centric healthcare experience. Through deep engagement, we empower everyone to overcome day-to-day health obstacles and live healthier lives.

We partner with 32,000+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 700K members, and have reached €500M+ in ARR.

Our team of 600 people (still growing) operates across France 🇫🇷, Spain 🇪🇸, Belgium 🇧🇪, and Canada 🇨🇦.

🤘 How we do it ?

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

🎯 What drives us — We're obsessed with helping our members live healthier

Mission is the Boss: long-term thinking, seeking our mission success above all else.

Member & customer-led: obsessively focused on solving members & customers problems and creating the most delightful experiences.


🏆 How we build excellence — We hire the best people and give them platform to succeed

Champions of excellence: extremely high standards and talent density.

Distributed ownership: accountable enlightened despots, everyone owns their decisions and results.

Radically transparent: all information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously


🤝 How we grow together — We help each other improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

Optimistic alchemy: optimists who collaborate with genuine care and support teammates.

Empathetic challengers: direct, caring feedback combined with praises to help each other grow professionally

Bold & creative contrarians: think differently to achieve greatness, try new approaches


⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters most

Disciplined in execution: taking decisive actions with focus that compounds success over time

Fight for simplicity: only high impact processes, smart frugality

🚀 Your mission

Enterprise is our fastest growing market segment and represents a unique opportunity for Alan to become the health partner of millions of members by 2030.

Strengthening this segment is a high priority : we are doubling down to accelerate on the foundations set this year, increasing our reach, reinforcing our offer and positioning in order to support a growing number of larger companies in France.

As an Enterprise Sales & Strategy Associate, you will play a key role in helping us structure our approach to Very Large companies (> 3,000 employees). You will work closely with a team of 2 Senior Account Executives, 1 Business Developper and our Business Segment Lead, supporting them with closing deals and driving various growth-related projects.

You will be responsible for:

  • Deal support: partnering with Account Executives on their deal strategy, account mapping, meeting preparation and pitch presentations in order to tailor our approach.

  • Prospecting Support: Collaborating with Business Developers and Account Executives to build and deploy targeted prospecting strategies through account mapping, lead qualification, C-Level outreach, cold-calling and nurturing campaigns.

  • Tender management and RFP (Request for Purchase) Library: orchestrating tender answers with a dedicated taskforce (ops, marketing, pre-sales, sales, top management), with ownership of specific sections and content to build. Ideal to shape project management skills!

  • Networking & Brand Awareness: identifying events to participate to and personas to meet for our Founders and Senior Execs to make Alan more visible among decision-makers

  • Process Scaling: auditing existing sales processes (CRM, minutes of meeting automation, meeting prep framework….), identifying and implementing improvement areas

  • Go to Market Strategy: along with the crew lead or the Business Segment Lead, opportunity to dig deeper into a topic to crack (Unions market in France, brokers market…)

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • Are fully fluent in French & English (written and spoken)

  • Are analytical and think strategically : selling to very large accounts asks for the ability to map organizations to find the best interlocutor and have a clear picture of our positioning on the health insurance market

  • Have a strong business sense: bringing a disruptive vision on a conventional market such as health insurance is hard. It requires the ability to convince high level stakeholders and be able to outline our product's impact at a strategic level.

  • Are self-organized and autonomous: you are well-versed in missions requiring precision and reliability. You are able to manage a project from start to finish with minimal external assistance.

  • Communicate effectively: given the number of internal stakeholders with whom Very Large Sales interact on a daily basis, the ability to communicate with clarity is essential.

  • Display a growth mindset: you know how to ask for and receive feedback in order to grow and take the best of this experience to set you up for success in your early professional life.

  • Excel at teamwork: given the strategic implications of our Very Large business segment, volume and timeline of work, you have the ability to lead transversal initiatives towards a particular objective.

  • Show versatility: given the scope of work, you should be able to jump from one topic to another

  • Have a strong product and “Tech” sense: Alan is an innovative company offering the most high-end healthcare software on the market. In order to thrive in selling it, you need to enjoy deep diving in the technical dimension of the software industry.

Level considered for this position is between A0 and A2.

We're looking for someone to start in January 2027, ideally for a 6-month internship.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Flexible office. Amazing office space at our HQ quai de Valmy

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk -it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

Deine Rolle

B. TÜV, Dekra) termingerecht.

Dein Profil

This role is on-site five days a week, from our office in central Edinburgh — a short walk from both Waverley and Haymarket. You’ll sit inside a small finance team, which means direct exposure to the wider business rather than being several layers removed from it.

It’s a fast-moving environment with light process and a genuine bias toward using technology to remove manual work, not add to it.

We’re a fast-moving, Edinburgh-based Legal AI company that’s just raised over $80m. Joining now means joining early enough to shape how our finance function is built — with modern tools, real ownership, and a team that wants to do things properly rather than just keep pace.

descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

📈 Finance community at Alan

Finance & Strategy exists to enable better decisions, faster, at every level of the company, in a regulated, diverse and ever-changing business.

We succeed when ambitious goals become credible plans, when strategic bets are grounded in financial reality, and when the entire company (not just Finance!) speaks the language of performance.

We set the right ambition, we monitor whether we're getting there, and we raise our hand when something needs to change.

We are not record-keepers. We are builders, partners, and challengers. We are looking for people who want to build, support decision-making processes and challenge the status quo.

The core responsibilities of the Finance & Strategy community are:

  • Strategy & Planning: steers Alan's financial performance through business planning, financial and operational monitoring, investor relations and financing

  • Financial Reporting: is the steward of Alan's financial truth, ensuring that we produce accurate, timely financial data. It owns the reporting to all key stakeholders (board, leadership team, tax authorities, and regulators like the ACPR) and ensures that financial data is the single, uncontested source of truth for the company's performance

  • Finance Data and Operations: Build and own the core finance data and tooling infrastructure (models, pipelines, and concepts that connect business operations to financial reality). This is where Finance meets product thinking

  • Functional poles with end-to-end ownership of their domain: Treasury, Procurement, M&A

⭐️ The insurance controller role ⭐️

Our insurance scope is growing fast: more complex reinsurance treaties, prévoyance (disability and death cover) moving in-house, new products and markets. At the same time, Finance is taking over the Solvency 2 balance sheet, which will be audited from 2028.

We’re looking for a rigorous, ownership-driven insurance finance professional to own our prévoyance technical flows and the production of the Solvency 2 balance sheet. You’ll join the Financial Controlling team (within Financial Reporting) and act as the hub between Risk, Actuarial, Ops, Data and Strategy, as well as the main contact for our reinsurers and external auditors.

You’ll know these numbers inside out: how they’re produced, what business reality they reflect, and how to defend them to auditors, the ACPR and the Board. You read the source texts yourself (accounting rules, Solvency 2 regulation, treaty clauses), form your own view, and know when to escalate.

⭐️ What you will do ⭐️

  • Prévoyance flows: own premiums, claims, technical provisions (mathematical and claims reserves) and related reinsurance, from P&L through balance sheet and cash

  • Reinsurance accounting: manage reinsurance accounts, quarterly settlements and profit-sharing clauses, making sure the books reflect what our treaties actually say

  • Solvency 2 balance sheet (solo and group): restate French GAAP to Solvency 2, challenge actuarial best estimates and risk margin, and track own funds quarter to quarter

  • Regulatory reporting: prepare balance sheet and own-funds QRTs and write the balance-sheet section of the SFCR

  • Audit readiness: be the single point of contact for auditors on Solvency 2, starting with the 2027 dry run, with documentation and controls always ready

  • Monthly review: analyse and comment on your scope (P&L, balance sheet, variances, loss ratio and other insurance KPIs)

  • Automation: turn manual computations into clear specs for our Finance Data team, and use data and AI to make closing faster and more reliable

  • Business partnering: flag the accounting and solvency impact of new products, treaties or markets early and follow through to implementation

⭐️ What we’re looking for ⭐️

  • At least 5 years in insurance accounting, ideally Big 4 insurance audit followed by finance or reporting at an insurer

  • Strong command of French GAAP insurance accounting (technical provisions, reinsurance, insurance P&L)

  • Hands-on experience with the Solvency 2 balance sheet and QRTs

  • Strong analytical skills: reconciling large datasets, bridging French GAAP to Solvency 2, spotting inconsistencies; comfortable with SQL and AI tools

  • Organised, rigorous and comfortable building structure from ambiguity; you close the loops and can explain technical topics to actuaries, auditors and non-finance stakeholders alike

  • Fluent in English and French

Big pluses: prévoyance experience (long-term reserves, mortality/disability tables, profit-sharing), having built a Solvency 2 production process, actuarial knowledge, IFRS 17.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

Key responsibilities

What we are looking for

Desirable experience

  • Hydrostatic or pneumatic pressure testing.

  • Python, MATLAB, or similar tools for test-data processing and evaluation.

  • Data-acquisition systems, test-bench automation, or test-facility development.

  • Working proficiency in German.

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.
The Role Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like “Why are we delaying so many flights?” or “How can we better identify instances of money laundering?” As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.

As an FDSE, your responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team.

Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. You’ll work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop.

  • Impact: We take on meaningful and challenging projects that change the world for the better.
  • Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end, working through any obstacles we may encounter.

  • Trust: We trust each other to effectively manage time and priorities and give people the space to think for themselves.
  • Growth: We encourage ourselves and our peers to seek new challenges and opportunities for growth, as well as find new ways to innovate and share knowledge.

Vogel berät mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen in steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Fragen.
