title: HR Consultant
descriptionHtml:
De functie

Als HR Consultant zorg je ervoor dat de dagelijkse HR-processen binnen Interconnect soepel en zorgvuldig verlopen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor een correcte personeelsadministratie, bewaakt de kwaliteit van HR-processen en ondersteunt leidinggevenden en medewerkers bij uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je werkt aan verschillende onderdelen van de employee journey, waaronder in-, door- en uitstroom, verzuimadministratie, personeelsmutaties en werving & selectie. Daarnaast denk je actief mee over het verbeteren van processen en het verder professionaliseren van de HR-dienstverlening.

Je maakt deel uit van een betrokken HR-team, bestaande uit een HR Teamlead, HR Business Partner en HR-medewerker. Het team valt onder de afdeling Business Support.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Beheren en bewaken van de kwaliteit en volledigheid van personeelsdossiers.
  • Verwerken en controleren van personeelsgegevens in HR-systemen, waaronder Nmbrs.
  • Ondersteunen bij de salarisverwerking en uitvoeren van administratieve controles.
  • Adviseren over personeelsregelingen, arbeidsvoorwaarden en HR-procedures.
  • Beantwoorden van HR-gerelateerde vragen van leidinggevenden en medewerkers.
  • Verzorgen van administratieve processen rondom in-, door- en uitstroom en verzuim.
  • Bijdragen aan HR-projecten en de realisatie van HR-doelstellingen.
  • Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden en optimaliseren van HR-processen en werkwijzen.

Wie ben jij?

Je houdt van structuur, werkt zorgvuldig en vindt het leuk om collega's verder te helpen. Tegelijkertijd kijk je kritisch naar bestaande processen en denk je actief mee over hoe zaken slimmer en efficiënter kunnen worden georganiseerd.

Je beschikt over:

  • Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding.
  • Kennis van HR-processen, personeelsadministratie en relevante wet- en regelgeving.
  • Bij voorkeur enkele jaren werkervaring als HR-medewerker, HR Consultant of in een vergelijkbare functie.
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling.
  • Een proactieve, nauwkeurige en resultaatgerichte werkhouding.
  • Beschikbaarheid van minimaal 32 uur per week.
  • Ervaring met Nmbrs is een mooie aanvulling.

Wat biedt Interconnect?

Je komt terecht bij een stabiel en groeiend familiebedrijf waar samenwerking, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en een prettige werksfeer centraal staan.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tot € 4.250 op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis, ervaring en opleidingsniveau.
  • Een jaarlijkse prestatiebonus die kan oplopen tot één bruto maandsalaris.
  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
  • Een goede pensioenregeling waarbij Interconnect gemiddeld twee derde van de premie betaalt.
  • 25 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis, met de mogelijkheid om maximaal 10 extra dagen bij te kopen.
  • Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,21 per kilometer of volledige vergoeding van het openbaar vervoer.
  • Mogelijkheid om maximaal 40% van de contracturen vanuit huis te werken.
  • Een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan en mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen.

Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

  • Een moderne werkomgeving in het hoofdkantoor in ’s-Hertogenbosch, inclusief lunch-/werkcafé, gaming room en skybar.
  • Een eigen fitnessruimte met moderne apparatuur en groepslessen onder begeleiding van een professionele trainer.
  • Regelmatige teamactiviteiten, waaronder een zomer-BBQ, game nights, vitaliteitsdagen en teamuitjes.

Over Interconnect

Interconnect is een Nederlands familiebedrijf dat sinds 1995 actief is in de wereld van IT-infrastructuur, datacenters en clouddiensten. Met ongeveer 130 medewerkers en eigen Tier III-datacenters in ’s-Hertogenbosch en Eindhoven levert Interconnect veilige en betrouwbare IT-oplossingen aan onder andere managed service providers, softwarebedrijven en zakelijke eindgebruikers. De organisatie speelt een belangrijke rol in de digitale infrastructuur van Nederland en combineert technologische expertise met de betrokkenheid en korte communicatielijnen van een familiebedrijf.

Interesse?

Ben jij een ervaren HR-professional die klaar is voor een leidinggevende rol met impact?

title: IAM Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
As an IAM Software Engineer, you’ll focus on Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions. Your work combines technical analysis, platform configuration, low-code implementation, integration, testing, and troubleshooting, with custom coding where needed. You’ll work closely with engineers, architects, consultants, and customer teams to deliver secure, reliable solutions. 

You’ll join an engineering delivery team of around 8–12 people, working across customer assignments in two-week sprints, often with a specific sprint focus. Our ‘you build it, you run it’ approach combines implementation, ongoing improvement, and troubleshooting after delivery, supported by senior engineers in your own and neighbouring teams doing similar work. 

What you’ll do as an IAM Software Engineer 

  • Design and deliver IGA solutions that help customers govern access, using standard platform capabilities, low-code tools, and integration standards, with C#, SQL, and APIs where needed. 
  • Translate customer needs into technical designs and engineering tasks, working with architects, security engineers, and customer stakeholders to meet security, compliance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. 
  • Troubleshoot complex IAM issues, identify root causes, and implement lasting improvements that reduce recurrence and security risk. 
  • Improve automation and delivery practices, using PowerShell and CI/CD where appropriate to make implementation and ongoing changes more reliable. 
  • Share knowledge and support junior engineers through mentoring, design sessions, and reviews of configurations, integrations, and code. 

The impact you’ll have 

Your engineering work will help leading organizations manage access confidently, protect sensitive data, and comply with evolving regulations. By building reliable IAM solutions and improving delivery practices, you’ll contribute to technical strategy and help the team deliver more effectively—strengthening client security and trust in the digital landscape. 

What we can offer you 

Autonomy in your work and support for your career development. 

  • Permanent, full-time contract (40 hours per week) 
  • Flexible, hybrid working: typically two days per week on location—one at a client site and one at our Waardenburg office. 
  • Work outside normal hours is rare (currently fewer than five occasions per year) and always discussed in advance. 
  • Typically, 5–15 learning days per year for your development, including certifications and events. Training and associated costs are agreed individually rather than through a fixed training budget. 
  • 30 days of annual leave: 25 flexible days and 5 fixed company days. 
  • Variable team bonus and annual profit distribution 
  • Mobility budget or company lease car 
  • Private pension scheme 
  • Home office setup budget and monthly remote work allowance 
  • Regular team and company social events 

What you’ll bring to the team 

Core experience and skills 

  • 3–6 years in software or platform engineering, including at least one year designing and implementing IGA solutions such as Omada Identity or Microsoft Entra ID Governance. 
  • Experience in solution design, configuration, API integration, testing, and deployment, using Git and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps). 
  • Practical C# and SQL experience to troubleshoot and extend IAM solutions where needed. 
  • Strong analytical, design, and problem-solving skills, with a deep understanding of software security and the ability to turn security and compliance requirements into practical solutions. 
  • A relevant bachelor’s degree (e.g., computer science or information security), or equivalent experience. 

How you work 

  • Strong collaboration, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with a structured, proactive approach and the ability to drive work independently. 

Practical requirements 

  • English at C1 and Dutch at B2 or higher, written and spoken. 
  • Client-site travel is within the Netherlands, with current major clients in the Randstad. You’re able and willing to travel to those sites and our Waardenburg office; no driver’s license is required. 
  • Currently residing in the Netherlands and eligible to work here. 

Nice to have 

  • Azure experience. 
  • AI-assisted tools for analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, or coding. 
  • Relevant certifications, e.g., Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Omada Certified Engineer, or CISSP. 

About SITS | Traxion 

SITS | Traxion specializes in Identity & Access Management, with 24 years of consulting experience and a team of 120 specialists. We work with organizations across sectors, including Schiphol Group, dsm-firmenich, Gemeente Rotterdam, Belastingdienst, E.ON, and Ayvens. 

As part of the European IT security group SITS, we combine international collaboration with a flat organizational structure and a respectful, collaborative culture. 

Ready to make an impact and secure Europe’s digital identities? Apply today!
Interested but have questions before applying? Contact to learn more about the role and whether it matches your experience. 

At SITS | Traxion, we believe diversity strengthens our teams and fosters innovation. We are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender, background, or experience, can thrive.

title: Implementation Manager
descriptionHtml:

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Keyshot. People don’t just use Light - they enjoy it.

We’re an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you’re excited to modernise how the world runs money - one workflow at a time - you’re in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors and advised by industry titans, we’re building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

About the Role

You'll own several concurrent implementations end to end — from contract signature to go-live. The plan, the customer relationship, the scope, the timeline, the outcome. You hand over to Customer Success once the customer is live.

Your customers are Financial Controllers, Finance Directors and CFOs at fast-growing multinational SaaS and tech companies. Senior, technical, time-poor. They expect you to keep up on multi-entity accounting, consolidation, intercompany, multi-currency and statutory reporting — and to tell them straight when they're asking for something that won't work.

No two implementations look the same. Every customer brings problems that don't have a textbook answer — a consolidation edge case, a migration shape the playbook doesn't cover, a process that needs rebuilding before it can be automated. You'll work the problem, ship the answer, and move on to the next one.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own several concurrent implementations end to end, from kickoff to go-live

  • Run the customer relationship through implementation — Controllers, Finance Directors, CFOs

  • Translate finance requirements into platform design — chart of accounts, entity structure, consolidation logic, reporting

  • Lead data migration — chart of accounts mapping, opening balances, historical data, cutover

  • Hold scope through the project — keep delivery aligned to what was sold, surface and reset drift early

  • Push back on requests that won't work, and bring the customer with you

  • Spot projects going off-track before the customer does, and intervene

  • Train and enable customer finance teams to run on Light from day one of go-live

  • Contribute to the playbooks, templates, and patterns the team builds over time

Experience & Qualifications

  • Degree in finance, accounting, business, or a related field

  • 5+ years in finance transformation, ERP implementation, or finance advisory — Big 4, a finance-focused boutique, or a vendor-side professional services team (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Workday Financials)

  • You are fluent in accounting and can hold your own with a Controller on multi-entity consolidation, intercompany eliminations, accrual accounting, statutory vs management reporting. Qualified accountant is a plus, not a requirement

  • You bring structure to messy projects — clear plans, sharp prioritisation, and the judgement to know which details matter and which don't.

  • You excel at building trust with C-suite executives and finance leadership teams through clear communication and consistent delivery.

  • You are comfortable working cross-functionally — you have delivered through Product, Engineering, Sales, and customer teams without formal authority over any of them

  • You diagnose implementation issues quickly and deliver practical solutions that balance customer needs with technical feasibility.

  • You have a real implementation with your name on the go-live — vendor-side, consulting-side, or as the lead on a customer-side migration. Not "I've used an ERP"

  • You use AI tools daily, have specific opinions on where they help in delivery work and where they don't

  • Fluent English; additional European languages a plus

  • Bonus: multi-jurisdiction experience (IFRS, US GAAP, local GAAPs); experience losing a customer or missing a go-live and learning from it

You'll probably struggle here if

  • You've only ever implemented one ERP, or only ever on one customer - you’ll be running multiple implementation projects simultaneously.

  • You need a PMO, a mature methodology, or a big delivery org around you to operate - you’ll be operating in a startup environment, without a large structure/org surrounding you, ownership and a self starter nature is key

  • You've never owned a go-live solo; someone else was always accountable - see above!

  • You can't give a concrete example of telling a senior customer "no" and making it stick

  • You've used ChatGPT once and weren't impressed - we go all in on AI at Light and need people just as passionate about it!

The good stuff

In addition to being part of a great team and working in a really fun and innovative environment, we offer:

💸 A competitive salary + potential stock options

🏝 Generous package of paid annual leave + public holidays in the country where you are based.

🥳 Regular socials and company off-sites (last time was Northern Italy and next time is in October).

🚀 A huge opportunity for career growth as you'll help shape a market-defining product.

The famous last words

Working at Light means you're embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat-code is that we've built something like this before - and are now doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.

Join the rocket ship while it's taking off 🚀

title: Ingénieur études CVC confirmé
descriptionHtml:
BERS est un bureau d’études CVC indépendant spécialisé en conception, exécution et audits techniques sur sites occupés (Île-de-France principalement, avec quelques projets à l’international).

Nous intervenons sur des projets tertiaires et industriels, souvent en environnement contraint, avec des installations existantes complexes et peu documentées.

Aujourd’hui, nous structurons une première équipe technique (projeteurs et apprentis) capable de produire à haut niveau.

Vos missions

Tu es acteur des projets qui te sont confiés, de l’analyse initiale jusqu’à la livraison finale.

Dans ton rôle, tu es aussi attendu sur :

  • La prise de décision technique sans dépendre systématiquement de validation
  • La structuration de tes sujets (priorités, organisation, clarté des livrables)
  • La montée en compétence de ton équipe (projeteurs / apprentis)
  • L’amélioration continue des méthodes (outils, automatisation, IA métier…)

👉 Tu es responsable du résultat final.

Pas uniquement de la production.

Vos compétences

Compétences

  • Expérience en bureau d’études CVC (minimum 3–5 ans)
  • Capacité à produire des études complètes en autonomie (notes de calcul, pièces techniques, conception)
  • Maîtrise AutoCAD et outils classiques

❌ Ce poste n’est pas fait pour toi si :

  • Tu attends des instructions précises avant d’avancer
  • Tu n’es pas à l’aise avec l’incertitude ou les environnements imparfaits

  • Tu es capable de décider avec 70% d’information
  • Tu assumes tes choix techniques, y compris face au client

Ici, l’autonomie n’est pas un mot-clé.

C’est une réalité opérationnelle :

👉 on te confie un sujet
👉 tu le portes
👉 tu le livres

➕ Gros plus

  • Expérience terrain (chantier, mise en service, exploitation…)

👉 Comprendre le réel fait gagner énormément de temps ici

Avantages

  • Structure légère → décisions rapides, peu d’intermédiaires

👉 L’objectif : passer ton temps sur la technique, pas sur le bruit

🧠 Des projets concrets

  • Contraintes réelles
  • Solutions appliquées sur le terrain

👉 Ici, ce que tu conçois est utilisé

Ce poste n’est pas pour tout le monde.

Tu seras rapidement en situation de :

  • avancer sur des dossiers incomplets

Si tu es à l’aise pour :

title: Integration Architect
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Position Summary

The Integration Architect is an individual contributor within Metrea's Platform Development Capability Area, owning the architecture, development, and support of system interfaces across the organisation's core ERP, Supply Chain, and Maintenance business applications. Drawing on strong .NET, API/SFTP integration, conversion scripting, and SQL development experience, the postholder will design and deliver the interfaces and custom system features that connect Metrea's business-critical platforms. 

The role calls for a strong technical background coupled with a solid understanding of business process, and the ability to interact effectively with personnel at all levels of the business. In an entrepreneurial and fast-paced environment, there will be a need to adapt and rapidly prioritise to changing business needs in support of the company's commercial and operational objectives. 

This is a hands-on architecture and development role. The successful candidate will be expected to design solutions, build integrations, develop custom code and scripts, troubleshoot issues, and engage directly with business stakeholders.

What You'll Do

  • Participate in project planning activities, especially as it relates to scoping new system implementation initiatives  
  • Work closely with project team and end users, in order to gather information specific to interfaces, conversions, and enhancement needs  
  • Creation of technical specifications  
  • Table/field level mapping between systems required to develop interfaces and conversion scripts  
  • Development and support of interfaces (including APIs and SFTP file transfers) between our ERP system and aircraft flight operations, logistics, and maintenance systems, along with integrations with third party solutions  
  • Development of conversion scripts, when required  
  • Development of custom code that is scalable and extendable  
  • Development of frameworks and tools to support integrations and conversions  
  • Daily monitoring of system interfaces  
  • Debugging production issues  

What You Bring

  • Self-motivated; team oriented; responsible, and reliable    
  • Positive attitude and proactive style. Candidate must have the ability to work in a structured, yet variable environment  
  • Expertise in interface architecture and development include API development (Rest/JSON and SOAP/XML), and flat file transfers via SFTP  
  • Experience with integration and ETL frameworks  
  • Experienced in SQL, including creation for SQL views, stored procedures, and functions  
  • Experienced in architecting and developing custom solutions  
  • Ability to create technical specifications and documentation  
  • Expertise in ERP development; 2-3+ years of hands-on D365 FO development and integration experience is a must, including designing and supporting integrations with enterprise business systems.
  • Experience in Power Platform development is a plus  
  • Microsoft Synapse expertise is a plus   
  • Strong analytical skills  
  • Strong experience in implementing packaged and/or custom systems  
  • Experience in supply chain, maintenance, and project accounting systems, would be a plus  
  • Strong grasp of systems from “big picture” integration perspective  
  • Expertise in MS Office suite.  Visio experience would be a plus  
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail and accuracy  
  • Must be organized, focused and able to deliver under tight timelines  
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communications skills, with the ability to interact with various levels of personnel, including end users, management, and developers  
  • Microsoft Architecture certification or other architecture certification would be a plus

Benefits

Work Authorization / Security Clearance

The employee will have the legal right to work in the UK and will be able to produce right to work documentation.  You may be required to obtain security clearance for this role. Details of this can be discussed in the interview process. 

AAP/EEO Statement

Metrea Management Limited (MAM)  is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.

This is a full-time position with typical working hours of Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.  

Work Environment

Hybrid role, London 3 days per week 

Travel

Our Firmware

At Metrea, our single core value is Rooted in Humility, and our four cornerstone attributes are Entrepreneurial, Systematic, Discerning, and Over-Deliver. These form what we call our Teammate Firmware. Just like technical firmware connects software and hardware, our Firmware is the constant interface between our mission and our people. It defines how we show up, how we work together, and how we solve complex problems.

Our team Firmware creates a web-like, hyper-collaborative, dynamically hierarchical way of working that helps us adapt quickly, communicate openly, and distribute decision-making to where expertise actually lives. It enables groups to self-organize around hard problems, shift fluidly as priorities evolve, and operate with the trust, curiosity, and discipline required in a complex mission space. This foundation allows us to deliver elegant, effective solutions and uphold our purpose: protecting our precious inheritance.

title: International Expansion
descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally.

Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s future markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at startup-urgent pace.

What you will be doing

  • High-level strategy development, defining and executing Axle’s international expansion plans, and assessing the commercial value of new markets and business models

  • Diving deep into policy and regulations, understanding how market access works and what needs doing to achieve it

  • Developing the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships with key stakeholders. You’ll be jumping on the phone (and eventually, getting on the ground) with grid operators, utilities/retailers and potential clients to create and disprove hypotheses as quickly as possible.

  • Building the aeroplane as it flies: getting hands dirty with implementation as each international business scales, scoping and setting up pilots, tracking down partners and building relationships.

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, sniff out commercial value, and run through walls to get us into markets at speed.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get ambitious projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification.

What's in it for you

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, additional references, and welcome to the team!

Compensation: £75K – £200K

title: IT Support Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the Role

We are hiring an IT Support Engineer to own the employee technology experience end to end — from day-one device readiness through the full asset lifecycle. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who is equally comfortable resolving a Tier 3 macOS escalation, standing up device management infrastructure from scratch, and turning repetitive support work into documented, self-service processes.

You will be the technical escalation point for our Windows and macOS fleet, administer our identity and endpoint management platforms, and partner with security to keep the fleet patched and compliant. You will also mentor junior support staff and set the standard for white-glove service across the company.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint & Device Management

  • Be the front line supporting MDM platforms across the fleet in collaboration with our Technical Engineer — Supporting Windows & macOS — including enrollment, configuration profiles, group policies, and software distribution.

  • Serve as the Tier 1/2 escalation point for macOS and Windows device management issues, including configuration drift, update failures, and security policy conflicts.

  • Work with Technical Engineers to standardized OS images and deployment workflows on a quarterly cadence.

  • Monitor endpoint performance and digital employee experience to identify emerging issues before they scale, and drive proactive remediation across the fleet.

  • Execute workstation imaging, setup, and deployment for new hires and internal transfers, scaling to 100+ builds per month during peak hiring.

Identity & Access Management

  • Tier 1 /2 — provisioning, deprovisioning, group management, and application access requests.

  • Tier 1 /2 supporting authentication methods including FIDO2 security keys, passkeys, and biometric authentication.

  • Troubleshoot via remote sessions with Slack Huddle, Zoom, or Google Meet.

Security & Compliance

  • Partner with the IT Engineering team on patch management, vulnerability remediation, and endpoint compliance using tools such as BigFix, SentinelOne, or Automox.

  • Exposure in supporting security-driven remediation tickets within SLA and maintaining fleet compliance against internal and regulatory standards.

Service Delivery & Support

  • Own a high-volume ticket queue in ServiceNow or Jira, consistently meeting or beating SLA targets while maintaining high customer satisfaction.

  • Provide in-person and remote support to a globally distributed workforce across North America and EMEA time zones.

  • Troubleshoot Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace issues including sync failures, authentication errors, mail flow, and collaboration tooling (Teams, Zoom, SharePoint).

  • Support conferencing and telephony systems for internal and executive-level meetings.

Asset Lifecycle & Vendor Management

  • Provide asset management support to help track and manage our computer hardware and software.

  • Asset shipping and recovery for our new joiners and leavers.

Enablement

  • Lead new-hire IT onboarding sessions covering workstation setup, security protocols, and support procedures.

  • Author and maintain runbooks and self-service documentation in Confluence or SharePoint to reduce repeat ticket volume.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in IT support, end user services, or systems administration.

  • Strong hands-on expertise troubleshooting both Windows and macOS in an enterprise environment.

  • Production experience administering at least one major MDM platform (JAMF Pro, Microsoft Intune, Addigy, or equivalent), including building configuration profiles and policies from scratch.

  • Working knowledge of identity platforms — Okta, Active Directory, or Entra ID — including SSO and MFA administration.

  • Experience with endpoint security and patch management tooling (BigFix, SentinelOne, Automox, Zscaler, or similar).

  • Proficiency with an ITSM platform (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management) and a track record of meeting SLA commitments at volume.

  • Strong administration skills in Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate with minimal process and high ambiguity, and to build structure where none exists.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a white-glove approach to customer service across all levels of the organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • JAMF Certified Tech (JAMF 200) or higher; Microsoft, Okta, or CompTIA certifications.

  • Linux fundamentals and experience administering virtual machines (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V).

  • Experience supporting file share, print, or application servers on Windows Server.

  • Scripting for automation (PowerShell, Bash, or Python).

  • Reporting and dashboarding experience with Power BI or equivalent.

  • Experience supporting users across multiple international regions.

Success in the First 6 Months

  • Fully ramped on the fleet and operating independently as the Tier 3 escalation point for Windows and macOS.

  • Measurable reduction in average time-to-resolution and repeat ticket volume through documentation and automation.

  • Onboarding and imaging workflows standardized, documented, and consistently delivering day-one readiness.

  • Endpoint compliance sustained at or above target across the fleet.

Physical & Work Requirements

  • Ability to lift and move IT equipment up to 40 lbs.

  • Onsite presence required for imaging, deployments, hardware repair, and in-person support.

  • Occasional after-hours or weekend work for maintenance windows, migrations, and escalations.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

descriptionHtml:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Lead Backend Engineer in the Service Standards team, you will shape how services are built, deployed, and operated across all of Vinted. You will work closely with a team on the development of our core service framework—providing engineering teams with golden paths, robust service contracts, standardized tooling, and performance benchmarks to ensure high reliability and developer velocity at scale.


You will sit in the Service Standards team, part of the Service Ecosystem domain, reporting to the Engineering Manager of that team.


The Service Standards team is responsible for standardizing service startup, consumer APIs, and foundational backend frameworks across Vinted's engineering landscape. Within it, this is a senior individual-contributor role combining technical leadership with high autonomy—you will define architectural directions, establish best practices, and guide engineers across domains without requiring full management overhead.


You will collaborate closely with platform, observability, and product engineering teams to ensure our service framework and standards seamlessly integrate into daily workflows. Your work will directly impact developer experience, platform reliability, and system performance as Vinted continues to scale.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Lead the technical direction and design around service standards and golden paths.
  • Define and evolve company-wide service standards, including consumer APIs, service contracts, startup routines, and performance guidelines.
  • Build reusable backend libraries, tools, and scaffolding to streamline new service creation and maintenance.
  • Partner with backend engineers across domains to drive adoption of framework updates and gather continuous feedback.
  • Evaluate pragmatic trade-offs between architectural consistency, delivery speed, and technical debt across the platform.
  • Collaborate with Observability and Infrastructure teams to integrate telemetry, SLOs, and resilience practices into standard service templates.
  • Ensure security, privacy, and compliance guidelines are embedded directly into service contracts and framework templates.
  • Mentor senior backend engineers, participate in architectural design reviews, and foster high engineering standards across teams.
  • Drive architectural proposals (RFCs/ADRs) for platform-wide backend standardization.

About you 

  • Have deep backend engineering experience and strong architectural intuition, with proven success building scalable services and frameworks.
  • Demonstrate a track record of driving cross-team technical alignment and leading complex initiatives across multiple engineering groups.
  • Possess expert knowledge in designing API contracts, service startup patterns, and performance optimization.
  • Understand trade-offs in platform design and know how to build golden paths that engineers love to use.
  • Communicate technical vision and architectural choices clearly to both technical leads and engineering leadership.
  • Enjoy mentoring engineers, conducting design reviews, and sharing best practices to level up the backend engineering community.

title: Lead Deployment Architect
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: initial value realization, adoption, and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Lead Deployment Architect, you are the technical authority for our strategic accounts within Celonis delivery. You shape how Celonis solutions are designed, architected, and delivered across your portfolio of strategic customer engagements. You define what good delivery looks like - setting architectural standards, designing end-to-end solution strategies, and ensuring that AI-augmented and agentic workflows are deployed effectively at scale.

You operate at the intersection of deep platform expertise, domain knowledge, and customer strategy. You are equally comfortable leading a technical design review with Celonis engineers and presenting a transformation roadmap to a customer’s C-suite. You bridge the gap between pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring that what was promised can be delivered - and often shaping the promise itself.

This role carries significant organizational leverage. You set delivery patterns that other teams follow. You define how AI agents should be orchestrated for complex, multi-workstream engagements. You work in close collaboration with Deployment Engineers and raise the bar for the entire practice.

The Work You’ll Do

Solution Architecture & Design

  • Support Services scoping in pre-sales, ensuring the right Services are positioned in line with the Celonis solution architecture proposed
  • Design end-to-end Celonis solution architectures for complex enterprise deployments, spanning multiple process areas, business units, and geographies
  • Define the technical blueprint for how the Celonis platform integrates with customer systems, data strategies, and transformation goals
  • Designing secure, scalable architectures tailored to complex enterprise requirements, optimizing for long-term usage growth and high concurrency.
  • Make architectural trade-off decisions: build vs. configure, custom vs. standard, phased vs. big-bang - with clear rationale tied to customer outcomes
  • Own solution quality & outcome delivery across engagements, conducting design reviews, and ensuring delivery teams follow architectural standards

AI Orchestration & Delivery Innovation

  • Design how AI deployment agents (Apollo) should be used across complex, multi-workstream engagements, defining agent workflows, validation checkpoints, and quality gates
  • Develop reusable specifications, templates, and patterns that enable Deployment Engineers to direct AI agents more effectively
  • Pioneer new delivery approaches that leverage AI to compress timelines, improve quality, or unlock use cases that were previously impractical
  • Set standards for AI output validation, ensuring the organization maintains quality as delivery accelerates

Customer Strategy & Advisory

  • Serve as the senior technical advisor to strategic customers, building trusted relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders
  • Translate customer business challenges into Celonis platform strategies, identifying high-impact use cases and defining success metrics
  • Support pre-sales by providing technical credibility in complex deals, validating solution feasibility, and shaping project scope
  • Guide customers through their Process Intelligence maturity journey, advising on platform expansion, AI readiness, and organizational change
  • Leverage the broader ecosystem of Celonis experts to remove potential blockers in customer engagements
  • Establish deep, technical advisor relationships with customer stakeholders (Lead Data Engineers and Architects, Head of Data Intelligence, Head of Business Transformation) to provide technical reassurance and maintain "Expert-to-Expert" alignment during the course of the deployment 

Successful Implementation

  • Work together with Deployment Engineers on delivery projects to implement the most complex and cutting edge use cases for our customers
  • Stay on top of the newest technologies Celonis has to offer and own the implementation of early stage products for our customers, ensuring close feedback cycles with Product & Engineering
  • Review Solution(s) Blueprint to ensure quality, scalability and production readiness of business critical and operational use cases

Domain & Industry Depth

  • Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
  • Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
  • Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain in collaboration with the Deployment Engineer, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

Practice Development

  • Contribute to hiring: define what great looks like for the Deployment job family, conduct interviews, and calibrate candidate assessments
  • Share knowledge across the organization through internal enablement sessions, documentation, and community of practice leadership
  • Ensure the link with Product & Engineering to feed customer insights and field experience back into platform development, and to influence the platform roadmap

What Distinguishes This Role from Deployment Engineer

  • Scope: You work across multiple engagements and shape solutions across a portfolio/cluster/industry vertical (4+ concurrent clients)
  • Influence & Practice Development: your Scope allows you to identify and set standards that other teams follow - for solution architecture, AI orchestration patterns, and delivery quality
  • Bridge: You span pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring continuity between what’s sold and what’s delivered
  • Force multiplier: Your work multiplies the effectiveness of Deployment Engineers rather than substituting for it

The Qualifications You Need

  • Experience: 8+ years in technical consulting, solution architecture, or delivery leadership within enterprise software, consulting firms, or system integrators. At least 3 years in a senior or lead technical role with multi-stakeholder responsibility in large-scale projects at tier-1 organizations (e.g. digital twin implementations, global AI transformations, near-real-time data pipelines, etc.) 
  • Architecture skills: Proven ability to design complex, multi-component solutions that span data integration, process intelligence, automation, and AI, while remaining grounded in the “so-what” of a customer’s process. Deep understanding of enterprise architecture patterns and trade-offs.
  • Platform mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the Celonis platform, including the Process Intelligence Graph, data modeling, advanced PQL, automation and orchestration engine, and AI modules. Ability to push the platform’s boundaries via a working knowledge of Python.
  • AI & agent orchestration: Demonstrated ability to design AI-augmented delivery workflows leveraging frontier tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Experience with context engineering, multi-agent system design, or AI validation at scale. Ability to define how AI should be used, not just use it.
  • Domain expertise: Deep knowledge in at least one major process domain or industry vertical. Ability to translate domain expertise into scalable solution patterns and credible customer advisory.
  • Customer executive presence: Track record of building trusted advisor relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders. Ability to present transformation strategies, defend architectural decisions, and navigate complex organizational dynamics. Demonstrated experience navigating complex IT landscapes and communicating technical trade-offs to senior leadership.
  • Consulting & communication: Exceptional ability to translate between technical and business audiences. Experience leading workshops, design sessions, and strategic reviews with senior stakeholders.
  • Leadership & mentoring: Demonstrated ability to raise the performance of teams around you. Experience mentoring technical staff, setting quality standards, and contributing to organizational capability development.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology Management, Business Informatics, or a comparable field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English and German required. 

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

descriptionHtml:

Les métiers du Software Engineering évoluent avec l’IA : viens apprendre à devenir un Tech Lead AI Native.

Tes futures missions :

Nous recrutons un·e Tech Lead pour concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs.

En tant que Tech Lead, tu es garant du rythme et de la qualité de delivery de ton projet. title: Lead Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Platform Engineering is the centralised team that builds, provisions and runs the infrastructure every other engineering team at Allica depends on. Whether a product serves a business banking customer or a colleague inside the bank, it lands on a platform this team designed. The team owns both halves of that, building the platform and running it, against the availability and resilience standards a regulated bank is held to. Well-architected is the operating standard, not an aspiration: reliability, security, cost and operational excellence are design inputs from the start.

The job is to make the right thing the easy thing, through paved roads, self-service provisioning, sensible defaults, and controls encoded in the platform rather than bolted on afterwards. Every control the platform enforces is one a product team does not have to think about, and one we can evidence on demand. Role Description The Lead Platform Engineer is the senior technical leader for a core domain of Allica's platform. You set its technical direction, you are accountable for how it behaves in production, and you build it yourself.

This is a hands-on role. Expect to spend a real share of your week in infrastructure as code, pipelines and live systems, and the rest setting standards, reviewing designs and making the calls that are too consequential to delegate. Your customers are internal. Product engineering and data engineering choose whether to use what you build, so adoption and the friction you remove are the measures that matter.

Principal Accountabilities

Platform Architecture and Engineering

  • Own the architecture of Allica’s Cloud platform: landing zones, subscriptions and network topology, container runtime, and the integration and resilience patterns that sit on top. Design again Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework as working disciplines. 

  • Build the reusable core: Terraform modules, deployment templates and platform services that let a team stand up production-grade infrastructure without reinventing the security, networking and observability plumbing each time.

    Infrastructure as Code and Automation 

  • Deliver and manage all infrastructure through Terraform and secure CI/CD, so that every change is automated, repeatable, version-controlled, tested, and reversible. Drive manual change and configuration drift towards zero. 

  • Set and evolve engineering standards for the function: code quality, peer review, policy as code and, release management.

    Security, Governance, and Compliance 

  • Embed security, governance, and compliance throughout the platform lifecycle, implementing effective policies, access controls, encryption, vulnerability management, monitoring, and configuration standards. 

  • Collaborate with Allica’s Security, Engineering, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure platforms meet organisational, regulatory, and control requirements, supported by clear documentation and auditable evidence. 

  • Identify and manage architectural risks, security vulnerabilities, control gaps, and technical debt, ensuring remediation actions are prioritised, tracked, and completed.

    Platform Operations and Service Ownership 

  • Own availability, reliability, and run cost for the platform, backed by service objectives, monitoring you can operate from, and tested recovery arrangements.

  • Lead the response to complex incidents, own the root-cause analysis, drive out repeat causes rather than repeat fixes. 

  • Use service data, operational experience, and FinOps practices to continuously improve platform automation, resilience, engineering standards, cost visibility, forecasting, and resource optimisation.

    Team Leadership 

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of platform engineers while remaining personally hands-on in architecture, design reviews, and the hardest technical problems. 

  • Set the technical bar and raise it, through coaching, design review and the example of your own work.

    Personal Attributes & Experience 

  • A strong track record architecting, and running production Azure environments at scale.

  • Fluent in landing zone and subscription design, private networking, containerised compute, API management and resilience patterns across zones and regions.

  • Line Management Experience

  • Extensive hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure at scale, infrastructure as code, containerised runtimes, identity and observability. 

  • Has carried production accountability for systems that matter. Comfortable in handling incidents. 

  • Treats developer experience as a product.

  • Talks to engineering teams, watches how they actually work and designs for adoption rather than mandate. 

  • Treats regulatory and security requirements as engineering constraints to design around, not obstacles to route past.

  • Prior regulated or high-assurance experience helps but is not a prerequisite. 

  • Gets adoption by building things engineers want to use and by making a clear case, not by escalation. 

  • Prefers the boring, well-understood solution unless the problem genuinely demands otherwise. Willing to remove things.

    Desirable Experience 

  • Architecture or engineering experience with Google Cloud Platform. 

  • Experience working in complex, regulated, or security-sensitive environments.

  • Knowledge of Kubernetes, container platforms, serverless services, and cloud-native application patterns. 

  • Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD technologies.  Familiarity with FinOps, operational resilience, regulatory compliance, and cloud-control frameworks.  Relevant Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Terraform, security, or architecture certifications.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Lead Tech SRE
descriptionHtml:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.

About the role

Kestra Cloud is our fully managed SaaS edition of Kestra. Each customer gets a dedicated Kestra instance on dedicated infrastructure, so the platform is a fleet of isolated stacks rather than one shared cluster. It is in Beta today, running production workloads for early customers, with General Availability planned for 2027. Each instance runs arbitrary user code (scripts, containers, queries against their own systems) through hundreds of plugins, and the fleet grows with every new customer. Provisioning, upgrading, and observing dozens to hundreds of identical stacks without drift is the core problem.

We're looking for a Lead Tech SRE to own Kestra Cloud end to end: the architecture and specs, the delivery, the monitoring, and the continuous improvement of the platform. You decide how the platform should evolve, write it down, split it into work, and ship it with your team.

You would lead a team of three, yourself included. That means you stay hands-on (a large share of your week is Terraform, Kubernetes manifests, and incident work) while setting the technical direction, reviewing designs, and dispatching work to two SREs.

You work closely with the CTO, the platform engineering teams building the Kestra core, and our security engineer. This is an engineering leadership role, not a people-management-only one.

What you would do

Architecture & specs

  • Own the target architecture of Kestra Cloud on GCP: the per-customer dedicated stack (cluster, network, databases, queues), how it is templated and versioned, regions, and the path from Beta to GA.

  • Write the specs (design docs, RFCs, ADRs) that turn product needs into infrastructure work, and defend the trade-offs: cost per customer vs isolation level, GCP project vs cluster vs node pool per customer, managed service vs self-run.

  • Define SLOs and error budgets per service and per tier, and make them the basis for prioritization.

Delivery

  • Break specs into work and dispatch it across the team, then review and unblock. You set the bar for Terraform modules, Helm charts, and GitOps conventions.

  • Automate the customer instance lifecycle: provisioning, upgrades, scaling, backups, migration, and decommissioning, with no manual steps.

  • Own the release path of Kestra Cloud with ArgoCD and GitHub Actions: progressive rollouts, rollback, and upgrade safety across the whole fleet of customer instances.

Monitoring & operations

  • Build the observability stack (metrics, logs, traces, alerting) so that issues are caught before customers report them.

  • Run on-call and incident response for the team: rotation, runbooks, blameless postmortems, and follow-ups that actually ship.

  • Plan capacity for a workload that is bursty by nature, and keep autoscaling honest.

Continuous improvement

  • Drive cost efficiency (FinOps) on GCP: per-customer cost visibility, right-sizing, committed use, and spot where it fits.

  • Harden the platform with our security engineer: network policies, workload identity, secrets, and audit trails toward SOC 2 expectations.

  • Feed back into the product: when Kestra itself makes the cloud hard to run, you write the issue, propose the fix, and work with core engineering to land it.

Our Tech Stack

  • Cloud: GCP (GKE, Cloud SQL, GCS, Cloud Load Balancing, IAM / Workload Identity)

  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Helm

  • Orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker

  • Deployment & Repository: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD

  • Monitoring & Logs: OpenTelemetry, Elastic, Prometheus, Grafana

  • Datastore: PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch

  • Queuing: Redis, Kafka, AMQP

Your first six months

title: Machine Learning Compiler Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the position

We’re looking for compiler engineers to join a new ML Compilers Team at Jane Street. 

Machine learning is a critical pillar of our global business. Our ever-evolving trading environment serves as a unique, rapid-feedback platform for ML experimentation, allowing us to incorporate new ideas with relatively little friction. Our ML team is full of people with a shared love for the craft of software engineering, and for designing APIs and systems that are delightful to use.

ML compilers let us quickly turn research ideas and novel architectures into high-throughput training jobs and low-latency inference. To get the most out of our hardware resources and enable rapid model development and deployment, we are working to understand and improve the current ML compiler technologies and explore where it makes sense to build our own solutions. In this role, you would shape the development of our compiler stack.

If you’ve never thought about a career in finance, you’re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you’ll fit right in.

About you

The ideal candidate has worked on an ML compiler in the past, but non-ML compiler experience is also valuable. Experience with any part of the stack is fine, be it high-level ML frameworks (PyTorch, Jax, TensorFlow), graph compilers (Inductor, XLA, TVM) or kernel DSLs (Triton, Helion, cuTile). You should understand how all those pieces fit together even if you are unfamiliar with specific parts. 

Some other things you might be excited about are:

  • Optimisations in ML compilers: algebraic rewriting, materialise vs recompute tradeoffs and fusion, equality saturation, scheduling languages, loop-level optimisation, autotuning
  • ML compiler frontends: graph capture, symbolic and dynamic shapes, control flow, automatic differentiation
  • GPU kernel programming and architecture: Triton, cuTile, CuTeDSL, CUDA, compute and memory hierarchies, programming with tensor cores
  • Compiler concepts: static analysis, intermediate representations like SSA and CFGs, instruction selection
  • ML inference: CUDA Graphs, KV caching, batching
  • ML training: Tensor/Sequence/Expert/Pipeline Parallelism, FSDP, NCCL, activation checkpointing
  • GPU debugging and optimisation: CUDA-GDB, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute
  • Formal methods: proof assistants, automated theorem provers, agentic proof systems
  • Programming languages and DSL design: embedded DSLs, staging and metaprogramming, type systems, functional programming
  • Fluency in English is required

title: Marketing & Branding Intern (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Description

We are looking for a creative owner, because how the world sees us decides which doors open. Join the CEO Office at QuantumDiamonds (QD) and take ownership of everything marketing and branding. You will shape how semiconductor manufacturers, failure analysis labs, partners and future colleagues experience QD, at trade shows, at events, online and in every piece of material we hand out. As an Intern in Marketing & Branding, you will drive our branding, prepare our trade show appearances and events from start to finish, and create the materials and merchandise that represent us. At the same time, you will set up the processes that make our marketing repeatable as we scale toward industrial production.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

  

What will you do

  • Own our brand day to day and drive our ongoing branding, from rollout across all touchpoints to keeping our look consistent

  • Plan and prepare our trade show appearances end to end: booth concept, materials, logistics, shipping, and coordination with organizers and vendors

  • Plan and organize our own events and customer visits, from invitation to follow-up

  • Design decks, flyers, brochures, posters and booth materials for trade shows and customer meetings

  • Develop new merchandise and manage the process with suppliers, from idea to delivery

  • Turn trade shows, customer installations and milestones into content for LinkedIn and our website

  • Gather input from the people who build and sell our technology and work directly with management

  • Set up templates, checklists and processes for trade shows, events and marketing materials so they can be repeated and scaled

 

What is expected of you

  • You are enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Marketing, Communication, Design, Business Administration, or a related field

  • You have first experience in marketing, branding, event management, or content creation, ideally in a B2B tech environment

  • You have a strong eye for design and are confident with tools such as Canva or Figma

  • You write clearly and can make complex technical topics understandable without oversimplifying them

  • You are well organized and keep many moving parts on track, especially under deadline pressure before trade shows and events

  • Experience with LinkedIn company pages, Webflow or another CMS, or AI tools in content production is a plus

  • You have a strong technical understanding and quickly get to grips with complex topics, so you can explain our technology and its value

  • A background in physics, engineering, or another technical field is a plus

  • You take ownership: you drive topics yourself and follow them through to completion

  • You are available for a full-time internship of 4 to 6 months, can work from our Munich office

  • Fluent English is required, German is a plus

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 24 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.
