title: Mission Planning & Ground Station Systems
descriptionHtml:
VisionSpace is a dynamic consulting, technology and engineering company delivering solutions and services for the Space and Defence sectors. We work across satellite operations, ground data systems, ground stations, automation, artificial intelligence and cybersecurity.

Our motto is Space and Beyond is Our Playground. We empower our customers to shape the future of satellite operations by bringing automation and intelligence into operational systems.

About the Role



We are looking for a Mission Planning & Ground Station Systems Engineer to join our team supporting activities at EUMETSAT in Darmstadt, Germany.

The position will support the CGSS project, an established operational project responsible for an application used to generate ground station pass schedules for EUMETSAT missions.

The successful candidate will contribute to the development, maintenance, verification and evolution of the application and will work closely with engineers, operational teams and end users.

This is a great opportunity for a professionals in applying their technical skills to operational satellite ground systems and mission planning.

What You'll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will include:

  • Contributing to the development, maintenance and evolution of the CGSS application.
  • Developing and maintaining software components, with a particular focus on Python-based development.
  • Supporting the development and maintenance of web-based applications and interfaces.
  • Analysing software requirements and translating operational needs into technical solutions.
  • Performing software Verification & Validation (V&V) activities.
  • Preparing and executing functional, integration, regression and acceptance tests.
  • Investigating and troubleshooting software anomalies and supporting their resolution.
  • Supporting the integration and deployment of software releases.
  • Contributing to technical and user documentation.
  • Working directly with end users and operational stakeholders to understand requirements, collect feedback and support effective use of the system.
  • Contributing to the reliability and maintainability of software used within an operational space environment.
  • Working closely with other engineering teams involved in mission planning, ground station systems and satellite operations.


What We Look For



You do not need to fulfil every requirement below. We are looking for candidates who combine several of these skills and are motivated to develop further within the space operations domain.

Technical Experience

Ideally, you will bring experience in several of the following areas:

  • Software engineering and the software development lifecycle.
  • Python development.
  • Development of web-based applications.
  • Software Verification & Validation, testing and quality assurance.
  • Requirements analysis and software documentation.
  • Version control and collaborative development environments, preferably using tools such as Git/GitLab.
  • CI/CD, automated testing or software deployment processes.
  • Linux-based development or operational environments.


Space Domain Experience

Experience or knowledge in one or more of the following would be highly desirable:

  • Satellite or spacecraft operations.
  • Mission Planning Systems or scheduling applications.
  • Ground segment software and operational systems.
  • Ground Station Monitoring and Control systems.
  • Ground station scheduling, pass planning or contact planning.
  • Integration of mission planning applications with other mission control or ground segment systems.
  • Working with operational teams or end users in a mission-critical environment.


Previous experience with EUMETSAT, ESA or comparable European space programmes would be an advantage, but is not mandatory.

Education

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline.
  • Relevant professional experience in a similar role is a plus.


Personal Skills



We're looking for someone who:

  • Has strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Enjoys working directly with technical and operational end users.
  • Can communicate effectively with both software engineers and operational stakeholders.
  • Takes a structured and reliable approach to development, testing and troubleshooting.
  • Can work independently while contributing effectively to a multidisciplinary team.
  • Is curious and willing to learn about mission planning and satellite ground operations.
  • Has good attention to detail, particularly when working with operational software and verification activities.
  • Has English language proficiency at C1 level or above, both written and spoken.


Additional Requirements

  • Candidates must have the right to work in the European Union.

title: Montu Pharmacy Assessment Centre
descriptionHtml:
Ready to start or take the next step in your pharmacy career?

At Montu, we are doing things differently, and that includes how we recruit.

We are growing, and we are looking for enthusiastic, hardworking and patient-focused individuals to join our pharmacy team in Winnersh Triangle.

Whether you are looking to take your first step into healthcare, explore a new career in pharmacy or bring your existing pharmacy experience to a rapidly growing organisation, we would love to meet you.

We are hosting a Pharmacy Assessment Centre on Monday 2 November 2026, giving you the opportunity to experience a different approach to recruitment, demonstrate your skills and learn more about what it is like to work at Montu.

You do not need previous pharmacy experience for all of our opportunities. For our entry-level positions, what matters most is your attitude, willingness to learn and genuine commitment to making a difference to patients.

Our pharmacy is busy. Really busy. It is a lively, energetic environment where things move quickly, teamwork is essential and no two days are quite the same. If you enjoy being on your feet, working alongside others and being part of a team where everyone has a role to play, you could feel right at home.

Behind every prescription we process is a patient relying on us to get things right. Whether you are packing medication, dispensing prescriptions or completing final accuracy checks, your contribution matters.

Opportunities Available

We are recruiting across several positions within our pharmacy team, with opportunities for both experienced pharmacy professionals and individuals looking to enter the industry.

Pharmacy Assistant

An excellent entry point into the pharmacy sector, with no previous pharmacy experience required.

You will support the day-to-day operations of our busy pharmacy, including preparing orders, packing medication, supporting stock management and helping ensure prescriptions are processed accurately and efficiently.

We are looking for individuals who are organised, reliable, comfortable with repetitive tasks and enjoy working in a hands-on, fast-paced environment.

Trainee Pharmacy Dispenser

Looking to develop a career in pharmacy? This could be your opportunity.

No previous dispensing experience is required. You will receive training and support as you develop the knowledge and practical skills needed to work within our dispensing team.

You will learn about prescription processing, medication handling, accuracy, pharmacy procedures and the importance of maintaining high standards of patient safety.

Pharmacy Dispenser

For individuals with an existing dispensing qualification and experience working within a pharmacy environment.

You will support the safe and accurate dispensing of prescriptions, working closely with pharmacists, technicians and the wider pharmacy team.

You will need excellent attention to detail, a strong understanding of pharmacy procedures and the ability to maintain accuracy while managing high prescription volumes.

Accuracy Checking Dispenser

We are looking for qualified and experienced Accuracy Checking Dispensers who can help maintain the high standards of accuracy and patient safety expected within our pharmacy.

You will undertake accuracy checking duties within the scope of your qualification, training and authorisation, supporting the efficient processing of prescriptions and working collaboratively with the wider team.

Accuracy Checking Technician (ACT)

For qualified Pharmacy Technicians with an accredited accuracy checking qualification and current GPhC registration.

You will play an important role in maintaining dispensing accuracy, supporting pharmacy operations and ensuring our processes meet the required professional and regulatory standards.

You will bring confidence, attention to detail and the ability to work effectively in a high-volume dispensing environment.

What Is Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre?

We know that traditional interviews do not always give people the best opportunity to demonstrate what they can do.

That is why we are taking a slightly different approach.

Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre is designed to be an engaging, practical and interactive experience where you can demonstrate your abilities, meet members of the Montu team and gain a better understanding of our working environment.

You can expect a combination of practical and team-based activities designed to assess skills relevant to working within our pharmacy, including:

  • Attention to detail and accuracy

  • Literacy and the ability to follow written instructions

  • Working effectively with others

  • Organisation and the ability to follow processes

  • Speed and efficiency without compromising accuracy

  • Communication and problem-solving

We are not expecting everyone to arrive with pharmacy knowledge, particularly those applying for our entry-level opportunities.

We are interested in how you approach tasks, how you work with others and whether you have the right attitude to succeed in our environment.

What happens after the assessment centre?

Candidates who successfully complete the assessment centre will be invited to attend a further on-site interview at Montu on a later date.

Please note that attendance at the assessment centre does not guarantee an interview or offer of employment.

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for people who genuinely want to be part of a team making a difference.

Our ideal candidates will be:

  • Patient-focused: You understand that the work you do has a direct impact on the people relying on our service.

  • Detail-oriented: Accuracy matters, particularly when working with medication.

  • Comfortable in a busy environment: You enjoy an energetic workplace and can remain focused when things get hectic.

  • Reliable and hardworking: You take pride in doing your job well and supporting the people around you.

  • Team players: You understand that pharmacy operations depend on people working together.

  • Adaptable: You are comfortable learning new processes and responding to change.

  • Eager to learn: Whether you are new to pharmacy or already experienced, you are motivated to develop your skills.

You do not need to be the loudest person in the room or have years of experience to succeed here.

What matters is your work ethic, your attention to detail and your commitment to doing things properly.

About Montu

Montu is a leading medical cannabis company working to improve access to cannabis-based medicines for patients across the UK.

Through our specialist clinical services and pharmacy operations, we support patients receiving prescribed cannabis-based medicines for a range of eligible medical conditions.

Our multidisciplinary teams bring together clinicians, pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, dispensers and operational colleagues, all working towards the same goal: delivering safe, effective and patient-centred care.

We are a rapidly growing organisation, and our pharmacy is at the heart of what we do.

Every prescription represents a patient who is depending on us. From the moment a prescription reaches our pharmacy to the moment medication is dispatched, every member of our team plays an important role in that patient journey.

We are proud to be helping shape an evolving area of healthcare, and we want people who are excited to be part of that journey.

Why Join Montu?

Joining Montu means becoming part of a growing organisation where your work has purpose and your contribution makes a difference.

We offer:

  • Competitive salaries dependent on the position, qualifications and experience

  • Opportunities for training and professional development

  • Career progression within our growing pharmacy operations

  • A supportive and collaborative team environment

  • The opportunity to gain experience within a specialist area of healthcare

  • The chance to be part of a growing business helping improve patient access to prescribed medication

Further information about the benefits applicable to each role will be provided during the recruitment process.

Ready to Join Us?

Assessment Centre: Monday 2 November 2026

Location: Winnersh Triangle, Berkshire

If you are looking for an opportunity to begin a career in pharmacy, develop your existing skills or take the next step within a growing healthcare organisation, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now to be considered for a place at our Pharmacy Assessment Centre.

Following an initial review of applications, shortlisted candidates will receive further information about the assessment centre, including timings, location details and what to expect on the day.

title: Non-Destructive Testing Technician – Level 2
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing, producing and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital vehicle designed to carry cargo and, in the longer term, potentially crew.

To support the ramp-up of our production activities in Munich, we are looking for a Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) Technician - Level 2 with strong practical experience in radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT). Ultrasonic testing (UT) experience is an advantage.

You will perform and document inspections on critical space components and assemblies. In your day-to-day work, you will collaborate with Production, Quality and Engineering teams, as well as external providers and the appointed Responsible Level 3. Your rigor will directly contribute to the conformity, traceability and reliability of flight hardware.

Your mission

You will prepare and perform NDT inspections in accordance with approved procedures and acceptance criteria, assess results within the scope of your qualification, and alert the relevant stakeholders when you identify a discrepancy or technical concern.


What you will do

  • Perform radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT) on production parts, welds, structures and other hardware in accordance with applicable procedures.

  • Prepare parts, verify inspection conditions, and use the required equipment and consumables.

  • Interpret and evaluate indications within the scope of your qualification and against approved acceptance criteria; seek guidance or escalate complex or ambiguous cases.

  • Produce complete inspection reports and maintain traceability of results, equipment, parameters and applicable documents.

  • Check the condition and validity of inspection equipment, and report any need for maintenance, verification or replacement.

  • Coordinate with Production to schedule inspections at the right stage and help resolve inspection-related production blockers.

  • Raise non-conformities and contribute to root-cause investigations, corrective actions and their follow-up.

  • Contribute to updating work instructions, procedures, inspection plans and report templates, under the coordination of authorized personnel.

  • When needed, coordinate inspections performed by external providers and check that their deliverables and supporting documentation are complete.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of NDT practices and the development of internal capabilities, including UT where your experience allows.

  • Follow the site’s safety, quality and document-control requirements.


What you bring

  • Level 2 qualification in radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT) under EN 4179, NAS 410, ISO 9712; current qualifications are strongly preferred.

  • Professional experience in the space industry is required, ideally involving flight hardware or critical equipment.

  • Practical experience inspecting welds, metallic structures, pressure vessels, propulsion systems, machined parts or composite components.

  • Ability to read drawings, specifications, procedures and acceptance criteria, and produce accurate, clear inspection reports.

  • Good understanding of inspection traceability, equipment control and the handling of non-conforming results.

  • Ability to work within the scope of your qualification and consult the Level 3 or technical focal points whenever a decision falls outside that scope.

  • Professional working proficiency in English, both spoken and written, to operate in an international environment.


Especially valuable

  • UT qualification or practical experience, particularly inspecting critical parts or structures.

  • Experience with digital radiography, phased-array UT, automated inspection or composite inspection.

  • Experience working with a Responsible Level 3, external NDT providers or certification bodies.

  • Experience preparing or reviewing procedures, technical instructions or inspection plans.


How you work

  • Rigorous and detail-oriented, with a consistent focus on conformity and traceability.

  • Sound technical judgment and a pragmatic, production-focused mindset.

  • Autonomous and organized, with clear communication whenever a discrepancy or concern arises.

  • Comfortable collaborating with Production, Quality, Engineering and external providers.

  • Motivated to help build robust NDT capabilities for demanding space hardware.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

title: Offensive Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the AI Security Institute

The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.

We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.

The deadline for applying to this role is Sunday 15th November 2026, end of day, anywhere on Earth.

About the team

Security Engineering at the AI Security Institute (AISI) protects our people, partners, models, data and the research infrastructure that AISI's work depends on. We build secure-by-design platforms, automated governance and intelligence-led detection. We work closely with research units and technology teams so researchers can get on with their work. 

We're now building an offensive security team and have three roles available.

About the role

We're looking for an experienced offensive security engineer who builds and breaks. You should be able to find and exploit vulnerabilities across cloud, infrastructure and application layers, and want to apply that work to containing and evaluating frontier AI models. 

Offensive security testing is one of the key controls behind AISI's model evaluations. You'll run engagements against our evaluation and research infrastructure. That includes the sandboxes, Inspect (our open-source evaluation framework), and the supporting cloud, identity and platform services. Alongside testing, you'll build and own agent-assisted red-teaming harnesses that test this infrastructure continuously. 

You'll work directly with the engineers and with research teams on cyber ranges and evaluation tasks, and there's scope to publish and present your work externally. 

If you want to attack the systems frontier AI is tested in, use AI agents for offensive work on real targets, and see your findings change how those systems are built, we'd like to hear from you. 

What you'll be doing:

  • Attacking evaluation sandboxes. Testing the environments that contain frontier models during evaluations, including container and VM escape, egress controls, and attacking on the evaluation host from inside the sandbox.
  • Finding vulnerabilities in Inspect. Finding vulnerabilities in our open-source evaluation framework and the infrastructure around it, and coordinating fixes and disclosure with maintainers and downstream users.
  • Building and running agent-assisted harnesses. Building, operating and maintaining agent-assisted red-teaming harnesses end to end. Running them, along with manual testing, against every new sandbox and evaluation infrastructure release before evaluations depend on it.
  • Triaging and proving findings. Separating real issues from noise in what the agents find and confirming the real ones with working exploits.
  • Comparing agents and humans. Running agent and human red-teaming against the same targets, and feeding what you learn back into the tooling.
  • Running wider engagements. Planning and running scoped engagements against our cloud, identity, model-access paths and research platform, including joint exercises with our detection team.
  • Working with researchers. Helping to build and harden cyber ranges, reviewing evaluation tasks for realism and scoring, and providing human baselines.
  • Managing external testing. Scoping and reviewing external penetration tests.
  • Working within governance. Keeping model-assisted offensive work within AISI's internal safety governance and approval processes.
  • Sharing your work. Where appropriate, publishing research, writing blog posts and giving talks on sandbox security and AI-assisted offensive work.

Key competencies:

  • Finding and exploiting vulnerabilities in complex, fast-changing systems
  • Building tools that make offensive work repeatable
  • Judging which findings are real and worth fixing, including findings from AI agents
  • Operating safely and accountably under rules of engagement 

Who we're looking for

Essential experience:

You may be a good fit if you have some of the following skills, experience and attitudes: 

  • Substantial hands-on offensive security experience in red teaming, penetration testing, vulnerability research or exploit development, with findings you can talk through in depth
  • Depth in at least two of:
    • cloud and infrastructure (AWS preferred)
    • container, VM or sandbox escape
    • application security
    • vulnerability research and exploit development
  • Strong Python and/or another language such as Go, Rust or C, and a track record of writing tools that other people use and that you maintain
  • Experience testing live systems safely
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including findings that engineers can act on, and the ability to get issues fixed in teams you don't manage
  • A serious interest in where frontier AI is heading, and motivation to help make it safe 

Desirable experience:

We may also consider experience with: 

  • Building or using LLM agents, for security work
  • Linux internals, kernel or hypervisor security, and isolation technologies such as Kubernetes, gVisor, Firecracker or Proxmox
  • CTF challenge design, cyber range building or offensive training content
  • Published CVEs, research, conference talks or open-source security tools
  • Coordinated vulnerability disclosure
  • ML evaluation frameworks and AI/ML platforms
  • Mentoring other engineers and raising the technical level of a team 

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every point above. We care more about what you've broken, and how, than about certifications or job titles. 

Selection process

The interview process may vary from candidate to candidate, however, you should expect a typical process to include some technical proficiency tests, discussions with a cross-section of our team at AISI (including non-technical staff) and conversations with your team lead. The process will culminate in a conversation with members of the senior leadership team here at AISI.     

Candidates should expect to go throughsome or all of the following stages once an application has been submitted:   

  • Initial assessment
  • Initial screening call
  • Technical assessment 
  • Research interview
  • Behavioural interview
  • Final interview with members of the senior leadership team

Security Clearance

Appointment is conditional on successfully completing UK Government SC clearance. Prior clearance is not required - we will sponsor and support you. You should normally have been resident in the UK for the past 5 years. More detail on clearance eligibility can be found on the UK Government website: National security vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK.

What We Offer 

Impact you couldn't have anywhere else 

  • Incredibly talented, mission-driven and supportive colleagues. 
  • Direct influence on how frontier AI is governed and deployed globally. 
  • Work with the Prime Minister’s AI Advisor and leading AI companies. 
  • Opportunity to shape the first & best-resourced public-interest research team focused on AI security. 

Resources & access 

  • Pre-release access to multiple frontier models and ample compute. 
  • Extensive operational support so you can focus on research and ship quickly. 
  • Work with experts across national security, policy, AI research and adjacent sciences. 

Growth & autonomy 

  • If you’re talented and driven, you’ll own important problems early. 
  • 5 days off and annual stipends for learning and development, and funding for conferences and external collaborations. 
  • Freedom to pursue research bets without product pressure. 
  • Opportunities to publish and collaborate externally. 

Life & family* 

  • Modern central London office, or where applicable, option to work in similar government offices in Birmingham, Cardiff, Darlington, Edinburgh, Salford or Bristol. 
  • Hybrid working, flexibility for occasional remote work abroad and stipends for work-from-home equipment. 
  • At least 25 days’ annual leave, 8 public holidays, extra team-wide breaks and 3 days off for volunteering. 
  • Generous paid parental leave (36 weeks of UK statutory leave shared between parents + 3 extra paid weeks + option for additional unpaid time). 
  • On top of your salary, we contribute 28.97% of your base salary to your pension. 
  • Discounts and benefits for cycling to work, donations and retail/gyms. 
     

*These benefits apply to direct employees. Benefits may differ for individuals joining through other employment arrangements such as secondments. 

Salary

Annual salary is benchmarked to role scope and relevant experience. Most offers land between £65,000 and £145,000 made up of a base salary plus a technical allowance (take-home salary = base + technical allowance). An additional 28.97% employer pension contribution is paid on the base salary. 

This role sits outside of the DDaT pay framework given the scope of this role requires in depth technical expertise in frontier AI safety, robustness and advanced AI architectures. 

The full range of salaries are available below: 

  • Level 3: £65,000–£75,000 (Base £40,850 + Technical Allowance £24,150–£34,150)
  • Level 4: £85,000–£95,000 (Base £48,540 + Technical Allowance £36,460–£46,460)
  • Level 5: £105,000–£115,000 (Base £63,165 + Technical Allowance £41,835–£51,835)
  • Level 6: £125,000–£135,000 (Base £76,475 + Technical Allowance £48,525–£58,525)
  • Level 7: £145,000 (Base £76,475 + Technical Allowance £68,525)

Additional Information

Use of AI in Applications

Artificial Intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Use of AI tools in recruitment

We may use AI tools to help our hiring team review applications, for example by summarising application materials and helping us prioritise them against the published criteria. We do not use AI tools to find information about you from other sources, including online. People make every decision. We do not make solely automated decisions about candidates. Find out more, including your rights, in our recruitment privacy notice: https://www.aisi.gov.uk/careers/privacy-policy.

Internal Fraud Database 

The Internal Fraud function of the Fraud, Error, Debt and Grants Function at the Cabinet Office processes details of civil servants who have been dismissed for committing internal fraud, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned. The Cabinet Office receives the details from participating government organisations of civil servants who have been dismissed, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned, for internal fraud. In instances such as this, civil servants are then banned for 5 years from further employment in the civil service. The Cabinet Office then processes this data and discloses a limited dataset back to DLUHC as a participating government organisations. DLUHC then carry out the pre employment checks so as to detect instances where known fraudsters are attempting to reapply for roles in the civil service. In this way, the policy is ensured and the repetition of internal fraud is prevented.  For more information please see - Internal Fraud Register.

Security

Successful candidates must undergo a criminal record check and get baseline personnel security standard (BPSS) clearance before they can be appointed. Additionally, there is a strong preference for eligibility for counter-terrorist check (CTC) clearance. Some roles may require higher levels of clearance, and we will state this by exception in the job advertisement. See our vetting charter here.

Nationality requirements

We may be able to offer roles to applicant from any nationality or background. As such we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet the standard nationality requirements (opens in a new window).

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code (opens in a new window) sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants. The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we run a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) for candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria. The Civil Service also offers a Redeployment Interview Scheme to civil servants who are at risk of redundancy, and who meet the minimum requirements for the advertised vacancy.

Diversity and Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan (opens in a new window) and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy (opens in a new window). As part of the application process, we monitor statistics on D&I. You can see how we process this data here: Recruitment privacy notice - GOV.UK.

title: Office Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle

Als Office Manager (w/m/d) bist du das Herzstück unseres Berliner Offices. Du sorgst dafür, dass im Hintergrund alles funktioniert und sich Kolleg*innen, Kund*innen und Gäste rundum wohlfühlen.

Du denkst voraus, behältst den Überblick und packst selbst mit an – vom täglichen Office-Betrieb über Events bis hin zu größeren Projekten wie Umzügen oder Umbauten.

Was machst du dabei konkret?

Du hältst unser Office am Laufen. Du koordinierst Hausverwaltung, Handwerker und Dienstleister und kümmerst dich um alles, was einen reibungslosen Office-Alltag ausmacht – von Meetingräumen, Bestellungen und Post bis zu Dokumentationen, Reisebuchungen, Rechnungen und Belegen. Auch ausgewählte Themen für unser Münchener Office liegen bei dir.

Du bist Gastgeber*in und bringst Menschen zusammen. Du empfängst Kund*innen und Gäste, bereitest Meetings und Catering vor und sorgst dafür, dass unser Office ein Ort ist, an dem man gerne zusammenkommt. Dazu gehören auch unsere internen Events, All Hands sowie die kleinen Dinge, die unsere Office Culture ausmachen – von Geburtstagen bis Merchandise.

Du sorgst für einen großartigen Employee Lifecycle. Gemeinsam mit IT und den relevanten Teams organisierst du ein reibungsloses On- und Offboarding und kümmerst dich um organisatorische Themen rund um Wellbeing und Arbeitssicherheit.

Du übernimmst Projekte und packst an. Ob Event, Umbau oder Umzug: Du koordinierst Timelines, Budgets und Beteiligte und sorgst dafür, dass es läuft. Und wenn eine Glühbirne gewechselt oder ein Griff festgeschraubt werden muss, machst du das auch einfach selbst.

Das bringst du mit

Background
Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, eine Ausbildung in Hotellerie, Gastronomie oder Eventmanagement oder einen vergleichbaren Hintergrund. Entscheidend ist für uns aber nicht dein konkreter Abschluss, sondern dass du bereits relevante praktische Erfahrung mitbringst.

Skills und Qualifikationen:

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Office Management, Workplace Management, Hospitality, Eventmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle.

  • Du kommunizierst fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch und fühlst dich mit digitalen Tools wohl.

  • Du bist stark in Organisation und Koordination und kannst mehrere Themen gleichzeitig souverän steuern.

  • Erfahrung aus Hotellerie, Gastronomie oder Projektmanagement ist ein Plus.

Mindset

Hospitality & Service: Du hast Freude daran, dass sich andere willkommen und gut aufgehoben fühlen, und hast ein Auge für die Details, die den Unterschied machen.

Ownership & Hands-on: Du siehst, was zu tun ist, übernimmst Verantwortung und findest pragmatische Lösungen – selbst oder mit den richtigen Leuten.

Organisation & Ruhe: Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn fünf Dinge gleichzeitig passieren, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst dafür, dass nichts liegen bleibt.

Gut zu wissen:
Die Position ist in Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche) und wird vor Ort in unserem Berliner Office ausgeübt, so bist du mittendrin im Team und im täglichen Austausch mit deinen Kolleg:innen. Deinen Starttermin stimmen wir flexibel mit dir ab.

Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung!

Das bieten wir dir

 

Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten.

Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten.

Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen.

Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display.

Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern.

Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten Dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus.

So geht es für dich weiter

Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte.

 

  • Erstes Kennenlernen mit unserem Recruiting-Team via Videocall.

     

  • Videointerview mit deiner zukünftigen Führungskraft: Wir tauschen uns aus, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen.

     

  • Persönliches Kennenlernen: Du triffst das Team und erhältst praktische Einblicke in die Arbeit im Office Management

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem verwalteten Vermögen von über 3,8 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.

LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

descriptionHtml:
Mines Saint-Etienne est une Ecole de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe public d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France. L’IMT est un EPSCP (grand établissement) sous la tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté Industrielle et Numérique.

L’École Nationale Supérieure des Mines de Saint-Étienne (Mines Saint-Etienne) est chargée de missions de formation, de recherche et d’innovation, de transfert vers l’industrie et de culture scientifique, technique et industrielle.

Mines Saint-Etienne représente: 2 400 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation, 480 personnels (150 Chercheurs et Enseignants-chercheurs), un budget consolidé de 46 M€, 3 campus dédiés à l’industrie à Saint-Etienne et Lyon (région AURA), à la microélectronique et aux objets connectés à Gardanne (Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence, région SUD) et à l’ingénierie pour la santé à Saint-Etienne ; 6 unités de recherche ; 5 centres de formation et de recherche ; un centre de culture scientifique technique et industrielle leader en France « La Rotonde » (> 50 000 visiteurs / an).

Contexte scientifique et objectifs du stage :

Les dispositifs électroniques biorésorbables constituent une approche prometteuse pour le développement de systèmes électroniques temporaires, notamment dans le domaine biomédical. Ces dispositifs sont conçus pour assurer une fonction spécifique avant de se dégrader progressivement, ce qui nécessite le développement de matériaux adaptés et de solutions de stockage de l’énergie compatibles avec cette approche.

Dans ce contexte, ce stage porte sur le développement de matériaux d’électrode pour des batteries destinées aux dispositifs électroniques biorésorbables (resorbtronics). L’objectif est de préparer et de mettre en œuvre des matériaux d’électrode, puis d’étudier leurs propriétés électrochimiques afin de mieux comprendre leur comportement et d’évaluer leur potentiel pour le stockage de l’énergie.

Le/la stagiaire participera à la préparation des matériaux, à la réalisation des expériences électrochimiques ainsi qu’à l’analyse et à l’interprétation des résultats. Ce travail contribuera à identifier les paramètres influençant les performances des électrodes et à orienter leur optimisation.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous :

  • Préparer et mettre en œuvre des matériaux d’électrode pour des systèmes de stockage électrochimique de l’énergie.

  • Réaliser des mesures électrochimiques afin d’évaluer les propriétés et les performances des matériaux étudiés.

  • Analyser et interpréter les résultats expérimentaux, puis contribuer à l’optimisation des protocoles de préparation et de caractérisation.

  • Présenter les résultats obtenus et participer aux discussions scientifiques autour du projet.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre les Mines de Saint-Etienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l'excellence, avec la conviction qu'ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c'est l'opportunité de trouver :

  • Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un cadre de travail accueillant et un solide réseau international (T.I.M.E., EULiST).

  • Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle représentant 11 millions d'euros par an, principalement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique, La Rotonde, engagé depuis 25 ans dans la médiation scientifique et accueillant plus de 50 000 visiteurs par an.

  • Frais de transports en commun pris en charge à hauteur de 75% (sous conditions),

  • Foyer du personnel (activités sportives, culturelles, avantages CE sur des loisirs et temps de convivialité),

  • 1 jour de congé par mois (à poser sous réserve de l'accord du tuteur)


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Les principaux critères d’évaluation du candidat seront les suivants (liste non exhaustive) :

· Étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou en dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs, avec une formation en science des matériaux, électrochimie, chimie des matériaux ou dans un domaine connexe.

· Bonnes connaissances fondamentales en électrochimie et en propriétés des matériaux.

· Intérêt pour la préparation, la mise en œuvre et la caractérisation expérimentale de matériaux.

· Une expérience en laboratoire, notamment en synthèse de matériaux ou en caractérisation électrochimique, serait appréciée.

· Rigueur expérimentale, esprit d’analyse, autonomie et capacité à travailler en équipe.

📩 Postulez Maintenant !

· Durée du stage : 4 à 6 mois

· Début du stage : 01/01/2027

Modalités de candidature :

Les candidatures doivent être déposées sur la plateforme RECRUITEE, avant le 02/12/2026 (CV, lettre de motivation) :

Le poste est ouvert à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap. Dans le cadre de sa politique Égalité, Diversité et Inclusion, l’École des Mines de Saint Etienne est un employeur soucieux de l’équité de traitement entre les candidatures.

Les candidats retenus à une audition seront informés dans les meilleurs délais. Une partie des échanges s’effectuera en anglais.

title: Operational Excellence Lead
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is that we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region, including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

The Operational Excellence Lead – UK owns the operational backbone of BJAK's UK business. You'll make sure daily operations, internal systems, and customer-facing execution run smoothly, efficiently, and at a standard that supports scale.

This is not a P&L role, and it's not a "manage from a distance" role either. You'll partner closely with the CEO to turn business objectives into strong execution on the ground, building systems, leading teams, and stepping in directly when execution breaks.

 

What You'll Own

  • Define and execute operational strategies that support growth and align with BJAK's objectives in the UK market.

  • Run day-to-day operations across customer service, administrative operations, and internal workflows so execution stays frictionless.

  • Hire, lead, and develop a high-performing operations and admin team with a strong culture of ownership and accountability.

  • Own process improvement, finding bottlenecks, automating where possible, and implementing systems that cut cost and increase speed.

  • Lead the customer support function and step in hands-on during high-stakes or escalated cases.

  • Oversee company administration and internal operations, including office management, documentation, vendor coordination, and adherence to internal policies.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong background in operations, execution, or internal business operations in tech, fintech, or fast-scaling environments.

  • Proven experience leading operations and admin teams in high-expectation environments.

  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to solve problems directly, not just delegate them.

  • Strong organisational, execution, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing structure to fast-moving situations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally and drive execution without formal authority.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who want to direct operations from a distance instead of stepping in when things break.

  • Candidates who need fully-built systems and processes handed to them.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid escalations, messy cases, or hard conversations with vendors and staff.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

  • This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1-2 weeks from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

At ubitricity, we believe that diverse teams build better solutions. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and identities. Even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we're looking for.

Operations Specialist

This role sits within the Coach & Instructor Enablement Team the team exist to make the delivery organisation measurably better at retaining learners and delivering successful outcomes consistently, predictably and at scale. This team has six specialists supporting hundreds of coaches and instructors across all learner programmes.

Specifically, you will

  • Own enablement initiatives/projects end to end, ensuring the right coaches and instructors receive the right training and up-skilling at the right time to deliver customer programs. You manage every contributor and hold the central view across all enablement work.

  • Manage the shared Senior Coach and Instructor pool day to day, allocating their time across Technical Skills, EPA and other enablement work while the specialists direct the content.

  • Provide operational support to the enablement team. Make sure the data and enablement inputs are ready for the monthly quality calibrations led by senior leadership.

title: Organic Growth Manager (SEO & AI Search)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission

Cosuno is the AI construction platform connecting the European construction industry. We're reconnecting one of Europe's largest and still largely analogue industries with AI: general contractors publish their tenders on Cosuno and find the right subcontractors, and subcontractors find the projects that fit them and win more of them. As our Organic Growth Manager, you make Cosuno the answer when contractors and trade firms search, on Google and in AI assistants: through our blog, our website and Marketplace pages, and the sources AI answers rely on. And you join just in time for our biggest marketing project of the year, the website relaunch with our agency, which you'll use to grow organic traffic significantly. You'll be one of the first to join the marketing lead in a lean marketing team: you'll shape how it operates as it scales, not just execute inside a fixed setup.

What you'll do

  • You build our blog into a steady source of qualified sign-ups: an editorial plan from search data, sales calls and trade press, original research from our platform data, and customer stories, written to a high German standard with freelance writers and AI tools.

  • You own website SEO: public Marketplace pages, landing pages and programmatic trade and region pages, plus technical health, structure and speed.

  • You make Cosuno the source AI assistants cite (GEO and AEO): answer-first pages, structured content and a tracked set of the prompts our customers ask.

  • You start our content partnerships: guest posts, joint studies and collaborations with trade media and partners that earn links and mentions. Until our Partnerships & Social Manager joins in mid-2027, you also keep organic LinkedIn and our founders' posts running, then hand them over.

  • Your big project in year one: the website relaunch. Our agency builds the new site and owns sitemap and design; you are their SEO sparring partner and the owner of SEO for the move: you set the requirements, challenge the structure, own redirects and migration checks, and turn the relaunch into a clear jump in organic traffic. Until it goes live, you make the small changes on the current site that matter most.

  • You use AI to make organic faster and better: with our GTM & Growth Engineer you keep automating research, briefs, content and reporting, and test new formats, landing pages and free tools built on our platform data. You pick the smart solution, not the shiny one, and scale what brings sign-ups.

  • You measure the path from impression to qualified sign-up and demo request, and report what organic contributes.

What You Bring

  • You've owned SEO and content for a B2B or two-sided platform and can show growth in qualified sign-ups or pipeline, not just rankings.

  • Strong technical SEO: you've owned SEO through a site migration or relaunch and grown traffic through it.

  • Hands-on experience with AI search and how language models choose their sources.

  • You write excellent German, brief writers well and turn data into blog posts and stories that search, AI answers and journalists pick up.

  • You're data-driven and at home in Search Console, GA4, Semrush or similar.

  • You work AI-first: you set the strategy, automate what can be automated with our engineer and steer writers and the agency, rather than write everything yourself. You get things done and learn fast in a small team.

  • Native-level German and fluent English: most of our content is German.

Your Benefits

  • Room to shape and grow: You own organic growth from the ground up, including the website relaunch, our biggest marketing project of the year.

  • AI at the core: Our product uses AI to analyze millions of price data points and help construction companies bid better — and we invest in it just as much internally. You'll build with the latest tools and move fast, not wait for approval.

  • Competitive compensation: Salary above market average, permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

  • Work-life balance: Fully remote or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, flexible hours.

  • Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro.

  • A great team: Open, international, with regular off-sites and team events.

  • Growth & feedback: Open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

title: Partner Account Manager, Cabinet Intégrateurs (en télétravail depuis Nantes) (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !



Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ?

Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant.

Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action :

  1. Développer les comptes partenaires, en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs.

  2. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell, en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente.

  3. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.

  4. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.

  5. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires

  • Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.

  • Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.

  • Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.

  • Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.

  • Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.

2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell

  • Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.

  • Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.

  • Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.

  • Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.

  • Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.

3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs

  • Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.

  • Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.

  • Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.

  • Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.

  • Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.

4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes

  • Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.

  • Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.

  • Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.

  • Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.

  • Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.

5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation

  • Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.

  • Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.

  • Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.

  • Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.

  • Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.

6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships

  • Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées.

  • Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales.

  • Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires.

  • Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective.

  • Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires.

     

Profil recherché :

Compétences incontournables :

  • Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs;

  • Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes;

  • Tu sais élaborer et piloter des plans de croissance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et des équipes opérationnelles;

  • Tu as une approche commerciale orientée résultats, sais piloter un pipeline et transformer les analyses en actions concrètes;

  • Tu es à l’aise dans les rendez-vous terrain, les négociations, les présentations et les démonstrations produit;

  • Tu sais engager plusieurs parties prenantes chez un partenaire et construire une relation de confiance dans la durée;

  • Tu es proactif, créatif et résilient : tu sais prendre des initiatives et maintenir une dynamique même lorsque les résultats prennent du temps;

  • Tu es rigoureux dans le suivi des opportunités, le forecast et l’utilisation du CRM;

  • Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des fonctions commerciales, marketing, produit et opérations;

  • Tu maîtrises le français et peux participer à des échanges professionnels en anglais.

     

Atouts appréciés

  • Une connaissance des solutions de comptabilité, finance, gestion, ERP ou logiciels de gestion pour les PME;

  • Une expérience auprès d’intégrateurs, de revendeurs, de VAR ou d’éditeurs logiciels B2B.

  • Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de distribution logicielle et des enjeux de déploiement chez les clients;

  • Une expérience de gestion de grands comptes partenaires, de plans de migration de parc ou de cycles Resell et Cosell.

     

Ce que nous recherchons surtout :

Au-delà de ton expérience, nous recherchons une personne qui :

  • Sait créer rapidement de la confiance et de la crédibilité auprès de dirigeants et d’équipes terrain;

  • Aime être au contact des partenaires et transforme cette proximité en actions commerciales mesurables;

  • Sait conjuguer vision stratégique du compte et exécution opérationnelle au quotidien;

  • Est à la fois autonome, coachable et généreuse dans le partage de ses apprentissages avec l’équipe;

  • A envie de contribuer à la croissance d’un réseau historique tout en faisant évoluer ses pratiques.

 

Process de recrutement :

  1. Screening Talent Acquisition — 45 min : motivation, expérience en partenariats logiciels, connaissance de l’écosystème et disponibilité pour les déplacements.

  2. Entretien Hiring Manager — 45 min : réalisations concrètes, gestion de portefeuille, activation et développement de partenaires, approche terrain et collaboration.

  3. Étude de cas — environ 1 h : analyse d’un portefeuille d’intégrateurs, proposition d’un plan de croissance, priorisation du pipeline Resell/Cosell et présentation d’une approche de démonstration ou d’enablement.

  4. Entretien final — environ 45 min : vision du canal, contribution stratégique, collaboration transverse et adéquation avec les ambitions de Pennylane.

 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

title: Partnership Manager - Accountant Sector
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks.

The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams.

The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners.

The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel.

Here is how your key outcomes will look like:

  1. Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.

  2. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.

  3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

  4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are:

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment

  • Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

  • Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

  • A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Pentester Senior / Red Team
descriptionHtml:
Ballpoint, c'est 7 consultants à Paris répartis en deux équipes : une équipe attaque pentest / Red Team, et une équipe défense avec le développement de Trapster. Nous sommes certifiés ISO 27001 et en cours de qualification PASSI.

Avec l'IA, notre métier a changé. Trouver une vulnérabilité n'a jamais été aussi accessible : les outils et la technique ne suffisent plus à faire la différence.

Ce qui compte aujourd'hui, c'est de comprendre l'entreprise qu'on attaque : son métier, ses actifs critiques, ce qui la mettrait vraiment à genoux. C'est pour ça que le Red Team est au cœur de ce qu'on fait : un attaquant réaliste, avec de vrais objectifs, face à une organisation et ses vrais enjeux.

Notre raison d'être : faire progresser durablement le niveau de sécurité de nos clients, pas seulement leur lister des failles.

Nous cherchons donc notre Responsable Pentest / Red Team : la personne qui construira notre pôle Red Team et fera grandir l'équipe.

Nos valeurs

Chez Ballpoint, on accompagne nos clients dans la durée : Red Team, pentest continu, retests. Nos consultants connaissent leur SI autant que leurs enjeux métier, et c’est ce qui guide notre façon de travailler.

1. Curiosité : l'art de creuser au-delà des outils

Nous cultivons la curiosité insatiable pour explorer des technologies inconnues et décortiquer les métiers de nos cibles, car c’est dans cette compréhension fine que se révèlent les chemins d’attaque les plus pertinents.

2. Chacun fait la différence

Chez nous, une bonne idée n’a pas de grade. Un script qui fait gagner une demi-journée sur chaque mission, une meilleure façon de présenter un finding au COMEX, une idée d’offre : chacun peut faire évoluer nos méthodes, nos outils et nos offres. Et on attend de chacun qu’il le fasse.

Le poste

Tu prends la responsabilité technique de toutes nos missions offensives, en restant sur le terrain. Rattaché directement au fondateur, tu travailles avec l'équipe pentest / Red Team.

  • Porter la qualité des missions : cadrage technique, méthodologie, relecture et validation des rapports avant livraison.

  • Mener les opérations Red Team de bout en bout : scénario, infrastructure d'attaque, évasion, débrief au COMEX.

  • Rester un pentester actif : web, Active Directory, mobile, industriel, sur une partie significative de ton temps.

  • Faire grandir l'équipe : montée en compétence des juniors, parcours de certification, partage des techniques.

  • Faire évoluer nos offres et nos outils : pentest continu, templates de rapport, outillage interne, veille.

  • Appuyer l'avant-vente : calls techniques avec les prospects et chiffrage des périmètres.

Ton profil

Tu as au moins 5 ans de pentest derrière toi, dont de vraies opérations Red Team, et l'envie de faire progresser une équipe.

Indispensable

  • Solide expérience en compromission Active Directory et en pentest web.

  • Opérations Red Team menées en conditions réelles : C2, contournement d'EDR, ingénierie sociale.

  • Un français écrit impeccable.

  • La capacité à expliquer une chaîne d'attaque à un RSSI comme à un directeur général.

  • Modalités de télétravail flexibles mais présence à Paris nécessaire.

  • Un bon feeling avec l'équipe : on passe beaucoup de temps ensemble, en mission comme au bureau, et l'ambiance compte autant que le niveau technique.

Un plus

  • Certifications offensives (OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, OSWE ou équivalent).

  • Expérience d'un cadre PASSI ou d'environnements sensibles.

  • CVE, articles, talks, outils open source.

Avantages

Tu rejoins une équipe de 7 consultants où tes choix techniques deviennent la norme, avec un accès direct au fondateur et une mission claire : faire évoluer notre pôle Red Team. Les missions sont variées (web, Active Directory, mobile, industriel…), et comme on suit nos clients dans la durée, tu vois l'impact réel de ton travail d'une année sur l'autre.

Ballpoint évolue vite, et tu en es un acteur direct. Tes idées ont un effet visible dès la semaine suivante, pas après six mois de comités.

  • Temps de R&D : du temps dédié à tes outils, à la recherche de vulnérabilités ou à la préparation d'un talk.

  • Formations et certifications : un budget annuel (OSEP, CRTO, OSWE…), passées sur ton temps de travail.

  • Télétravail : possible, avec 2 à 3 jours par semaine dans nos bureaux à Paris.

  • Les classiques : CDI cadre, mutuelle, prévoyance, transport, tickets restaurant.

Le process

C'est le fondateur qui gère ce recrutement de bout en bout. Pas de cabinet, pas de tri automatique : chaque candidature est lue et étudiée avec attention. Ça peut prendre un peu de temps, alors n'hésite pas à relancer.
