title: People Operations Lead (Fixed term Contract)
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we're changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK's leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We're growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we're hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We're on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

About the role

You'll own the people engine room at Flock: the employee lifecycle, payroll input, benefits, the HRIS, the office and our in-person events. Your job is to design how a modern People function should work at a company where repetitive admin is automated out of existence and every process is simple, scalable and AI-native by default. You'll report to our Senior People Partner and work with everyone here, from a new joiner on day one to the CEO, who cares deeply about our culture. Please note this role is a 12-18 month fixed term contract.

What you'll be doing

People Operations

  • Own the full employee lifecycle: contracts, right-to-work, starter and leaver logistics, probations and changes. Shape the first day and first week alongside managers, delivering a strong employee experience across the lifecycle.

  • Be the first point of contact for people queries and audits. Own the People inbox and core HR templates, and drive every query to resolution.

  • Own the HRIS (HiBob) and people data: records, workflows, surveys and data integrity. Deliver monthly People reporting and metrics that spot and close gaps early.

  • Own payroll input end to end: collate, calculate and submit each month, including bonuses and comp changes. Manage the provider and partner with Finance on reporting and year-end.

  • Own benefits end to end as the main contact for providers, systems, data and employee advice, keeping policies and materials current.

  • Cut manual effort across the lifecycle by building AI-native workflows, so every routine people process is automated by default, then coach the business to use them. Own continuous improvement across People Ops.

  • Partner with IT on joiner and leaver access automation, and on cost and data audits.

Office Management & Socials

  • Run the office environment and vendor relationships, including routine upkeep like weekly snack orders and post. Cover health and safety as a trained First Aider and Fire Marshal, and provision hardware fast.

  • Own the company social calendar and rituals, from bi-weekly Flock o'Clock (working closely with the CEO) to quarterly Town Halls and larger events, keeping them engaging and on budget.

What you'll need

  • Hands-on People or HR Operations experience, ideally in a fast-moving scale-up, with real ownership of end-to-end processes. CIPD or equivalent experience required.

  • Hands-on payroll input and benefits administration. HiBob experience is a plus.

  • Strong HRIS skills across workflows, automations and integrations, plus confident data and spreadsheet ability.

  • Real evidence of building with AI: workflows or tools you've shipped and use, not ones you've only read about.

  • Exceptional organisation and judgement. You spot what needs doing and get ahead of it, you build the credibility that lets you influence without leaning on authority, and you treat confidential matters with discretion.

  • A quick, first-principles learner who is comfortable with pace, ambiguity and autonomy.

  • Working knowledge of UK employment law, compliance and people governance.

  • Low ego and high standards. You care most that the work is right and well run.

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that's a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

title: PPC Lead
descriptionHtml:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The Role

Our Performance Marketing team is growing! We’re looking for a PPC Lead to join our team in London.

In this role you will own paid search and display performance across our iGaming and Rewards brands, managing an external PPC agency while remaining hands-on enough to audit, restructure and optimise accounts directly.

You will be highly analytical with a proven ability to make data-driven decisions in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the PPC strategy for our aggregator brands, ensuring the channel delivers the required volume and ROI across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads

  • Manage the external PPC agency day-to-day, setting strategic direction, auditing account structure and ad copy, and holding performance to Quantum’s targets, not the agency’s defaults

  • Conduct hands-on account audits and restructures directly, with forensic knowledge of campaign architecture, bid strategy, keyword management, Quality Score and tracking implementation

  • Manage account budgets and ensure spend delivery and efficiency are in line with ROAS and CPA targets, making daily optimisation decisions with accuracy

  • Build and own a test-and-learn roadmap across keyword strategy, match types, ad copy, landing page alignment and audience targeting, and implement robust testing processes that produce repeatable improvements

  • Monitor competitor PPC activity to understand the market and identify opportunities to improve our position within it

  • Provide regular reporting and analysis, keeping stakeholders up to date with performance and translating data into clear commercial insight

About You

  • Established in a hands-on PPC role, with proven experience owning and optimising significant monthly budgets across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads

  • Forensic knowledge of campaign architecture, bid strategy, keyword structure, Quality Score, ad copy testing and tracking implementation including Google Tag Manager and GA4

  • Experience managing or closely overseeing an external PPC agency, with a track record of holding agency output to a high standard and knowing when to push back

  • Able to conduct deep-dive account audits and restructures independently, not just review agency work

  • Profit-focused and KPI driven, fluent in ROAS, CPA, CTR and CVR, and comfortable making data-led decisions at pace

  • Strong reporting skills with advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and experience of data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Looker Studio

  • Knowledge of pixel and conversion tracking implementation, attribution modelling and analytics software

  • Experience in iGaming, affiliate, comparison or another regulated, high-intent vertical is advantageous

  • Openness to building an in-house PPC function over time as the channel grows

  • You thrive when working as part of a team

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment

  • Have excellent written and verbal English skills

  • Last but not least, you’ll have no ego!

 

What You’ll Get

  • Private Health Care (Bupa)

  • Hybrid Working (3 days in office)

  • Travel Insurance

  • Competitive Base Salary

  • Company Bonus Scheme

  • Paid for AI Subscription (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini)

title: Principal, Product Analytics
descriptionHtml:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

We're looking for a Principal, Product Analytics who loves getting to the bottom of things. You'll do the deep investigative and technical work that explains why users and customers behave the way they do, and turn it into decisions that change the product and the business.

We're building a more proactive data function, and this role is its deep-investigation engine. You'll take ambiguous, high-stakes questions about user behaviour and customer experience and follow them wherever the data leads, across acquisition, activation, usage and the wider customer journey.

You'll work hands-on and independently, partnering with Product Managers, engineering managers and commercial teams, and working alongside a VP of Growth who will set the function's direction and build the team. Your findings will inform experiments, the roadmap and company strategy.

 

What you'll do

  • Go looking for what nobody asked about. This is the heart of the role. You'll notice when something looks off in a funnel, a cohort or a metric, disappear into it, and come back with a product issue, a cost leak or an opportunity nobody was looking for. You set much of your own agenda, and you don't wait for a request to start digging.

  • Lead deep investigations into user behaviour and customer experience across product and non-product touchpoints, including support, customer success and sales.

  • Find where activation breaks. Identify failure points in the user journey, including those that could become productised capabilities.

  • Understand acquisition and intent. Dig into acquisition channels, user use cases and what people are actually trying to achieve.

  • Do rigorous causal and statistical work. Go beyond correlation with regression, causal analysis and well-designed experiments, and be clear about what the evidence does and doesn't support.

  • Build models that drive action. Apply data science to real business problems, such as churn modelling that can trigger real-time product action, and explain clearly how models are applied and what impact they have.

  • Analyse unstructured and AI-specific data. Work with agent-user conversations, context layers and evaluation systems alongside structured product data.

  • Size opportunities. Produce market opportunity sizing that helps the business prioritise.

  • Measure how we build. Partner with engineering managers on organisational productivity metrics.

  • Communicate for impact. Translate findings into clear recommendations for product teams, management and executives.

What we're looking for

 

Must-haves

  • Deep product analytics experience across growth and broader product areas, with a record of investigations that changed decisions.

  • Data science and modelling experience, and the ability to explain how you applied it and what business impact it had.

  • Strong grounding in correlation, regression and causal analysis.

  • A proactive approach. You surface insights and shape the agenda rather than working to a brief.

  • Genuine curiosity. You notice what looks off and dig until you understand why.

  • Clear communication with management and executives about business impact, simplifying complex analysis into actionable recommendations.

Preferred

  • Experience with unstructured data.

  • Experience at an AI-native company, or with the added data complexity AI products bring.

  • Understanding of subscription businesses.

  • Understanding of the PLG motions in a B2B space.

Bonus points if you've…

  • Worked on multi-product platforms where upsells, cross-sells and bundling were a key revenue driver.

  • Worked alongside qualitative research, connecting the what (data) with the why (qual).

  • Done pricing and packaging work: willingness-to-pay, price testing, bundle performance.

How we work

We optimise for responsibility and freedom.

  • No ticket conveyor belt. We run on ownership and a small number of high-impact projects.

  • Close collaboration with Product, Engineering, Growth and commercial teams to ship real outcomes.

  • A bias toward pragmatic solutions that get used, measured and improved.

Why join

  • Do the hardest, most interesting analytical work in the company, with direct line of sight to product and strategy decisions.

  • Work across structured and unstructured data, customer conversations and AI evaluation, at the intersection of product usage, AI and revenue.

  • Independence and impact at principal level, without the management overhead.

This is an opportunity to shape the future of enterprise software at a pivotal moment for Anaplan. You’ll join a collaborative team of talented designers and researchers working on products trusted by many of the world's leading organizations.

You’ll have the opportunity to solve complex design challenges, influence product direction, and grow your career in a culture that values curiosity, collaboration, design excellence, and continuous learning. title: Product Engineer | Design Engineering Knowledge
descriptionHtml:
Product Engineer | Design Engineering Knowledge

Location: Cambridge (UK), hybrid with up to 2 remote days per week

Team: Product

Start date: ASAP

About Neural Concept

Neural Concept is the engineering intelligence platform used by leading manufacturers in automotive, aerospace, and energy. We combine geometric and physics AI with LLM-based agents so engineering teams can move from customer requirements to validated designs in a fraction of the usual time.

About the role

Design decisions depend on information that lives outside the CAD model: customer requirements, design rules, manufacturing and assembly constraints, and cost targets. This information is spread across specification documents, handbooks, ERP systems, requirements management tools, and system models. Engineers gather it by hand, often late in the process, and conflicts surface at design reviews or on the production line.

We call the capability that closes this gap Design Engineering Knowledge. It connects the design to the information ecosystem around it, so requirements, constraints, and trade-offs are available to engineers and AI agents while they work on the design itself.

As a Product Engineer, you will build this capability. Requirements are the first focus area: extracting them from customer specifications and requirements management systems, structuring them, and keeping them traceable. You will then extend the same foundation to design rule checks, Design for Manufacturing (DfM), Design for Assembly (DfA), and Design for Cost, and connect it to the enterprise systems where this knowledge already lives.

You will work with the Product Manager, solution engineers, and customer engineering teams, as the primary developer from the first customer conversation to the version running in production.

What you will do

  • Build the requirements foundation: ingest customer specifications and RFQ packages, extract requirements with LLM and agent-based pipelines, and keep each one traceable to its source document and page.

  • Extend this foundation to design rules, DfM, DfA, and Design for Cost, turning standards, handbooks, and company know-how into constraints that software and agents can use.

  • Bring requirements, constraints, and trade-offs into the design workflow, so engineers can check a design against them at any stage and see which ones apply to the part they are working on.

  • Build integrations with the systems around the design: requirements management systems, ERP (cost, materials, and supplier data), and system design and MBSE tools for architecture and system-level requirements.

  • Design the data model that links requirements, rules, and constraints to parts, design parameters, and simulation results.

  • Create evaluation sets and quality metrics with customers, so extraction and checking accuracy is measured and improves with every release.

title: Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: PRODUCT ENGINEER

Our hardest problems don’t stay in one layer. A customer issue can start in a web app and end in a Kubernetes scheduler, a container runtime or a GPU driver. We need engineers who can build the products, APIs and tools our customers use, and who understand the systems underneath well enough to make them work reliably in production.

This is a role for someone who takes a loosely defined problem, works out what the user actually needs, and owns the solution end to end. That means designing it, writing the code, shipping it, and debugging it when it breaks, without handing it off at the first layer boundary.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:

  • Own and drive user-facing products end to end, including web apps, APIs, backend services and CLI tools, mostly in Go. You’ll ship the simplest useful version first, then improve it based on how people actually use it.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering & DevOps, Infrastructure & Data Centre Operations, Security and Customer Support. You’ll turn real customer problems into practical solutions.
  • Build and maintain Kubernetes-based services, controllers and platform capabilities. This includes GPU scheduling and container runtimes.
  • Identify repetitive operational work and replace it with automation, so software handles it instead of people.
  • Investigate production issues across application code, Kubernetes, containers, Linux, networking, drivers and hardware. Each incident should end in a lasting fix, a guardrail or better tooling.
  • Design services that behave well under load and during failure. You’ll instrument them so anyone can debug them, and give them secure defaults from day one.
  • Contribute ideas and take ownership beyond your core remit. That includes product decisions on workflow and interface, such as whether a problem is best solved with a CLI, an API or a web experience.

ABOUT YOU

We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential:

  • Strong professional experience building, debugging and operating production software in Go. Deep experience in another systems language also works, if you can show you’d become productive in Go quickly.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containers, including how workloads are scheduled, how services communicate, and how to investigate when things misbehave.
  • Confidence in Linux environments: systemd, processes, signals, filesystems, permissions, networking, and CPU and memory diagnostics.
  • A track record of systems, products or tools you personally designed and built.
  • Solid engineering fundamentals: concurrency, API and interface design, and failure modes. You’ll also have practical experience troubleshooting production systems with logs, metrics and system-level tooling.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with the NVIDIA GPU ecosystem, such as drivers, CUDA, nvidia-smi, GPU-enabled container runtimes or Kubernetes GPU scheduling. This isn’t essential: strong systems debugging and a genuine interest in learning this area count just as much.
  • Experience with distributed and event-driven systems, such as queues, retries, idempotency and backpressure. Practical networking knowledge (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, load balancing) also helps.
  • Experience building Kubernetes controllers or operators, or developer tooling used by other engineers. A security-minded approach to auth, secrets and attack surfaces is a plus.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme
  • Employee wellbeing benefits
  • 25 days holiday, plus public holidays
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Enhanced Pension Scheme
  • Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)
  • Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment
  • Visible, meaningful impact as we scale
  • Clear career progression in a high-growth company
  • A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership
  • The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future

WHY APPLY

We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we’d like to hear from you.

MORE INFORMATION

Visit our careers page to learn more about us or follow us on LinkedIn and X to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.

Nice to have

  • Übernimm Verantwortung für eigene Initiativen und gestalte die digitale Transformation der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche aktiv mit.

Benefits

Wir bieten dir ein attraktives Benefits-Paket, das deine persönliche Entwicklung, dein Wohlbefinden und deine individuellen Bedürfnisse unterstützt:

  • Flexible Arbeitsmodelle: Hybrides Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitsmodelle sind abhängig vom jeweiligen Projekteinsatz möglich.

Inklusion bei Capco

Wir möchten unseren Bewerbungsprozess für alle Menschen zugänglich und unkompliziert gestalten. Solltest du während des Bewerbungsprozesses Unterstützung oder individuelle Anpassungen benötigen, sprich uns gerne an – wir helfen dir weiter.

Unsere #BeYourselfAtWork-Kultur fördert Individualität, gegenseitigen Respekt und Zusammenarbeit. Diese Werte prägen unseren täglichen Umgang miteinander sowie unsere Partnerschaften mit unseren Kunden.

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.
We are currently looking to add a Product Manager to join our new Munich, Germany office, specifically within the Product Engineering Group. This role will focus on building, enhancing, and managing our technical products, working with our team to define and deliver solutions that support our mission of seamless, out-of-the-box space communication systems. As a Product Manager at CesiumAstro, you will be at the forefront of managing the entire product lifecycle, from initial concept through to customer integration and support for the European market. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, sales, and marketing to develop product strategies that align with our customer needs and business objectives. This role requires a blend of technical knowledge and business acumen, enabling you to drive product decisions and ensure customer success in highly technical environments.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Work closely with senior leadership and engineering teams to define product strategies, ensuring alignment with CesiumAstro’s business objectives and customer needs.
  • Contribute to the development of product roadmaps, prioritizing features and enhancements based on market trends, customer feedback, and technological advancements.
  • Act as a liaison between product engineering, business development/sales, marketing, and customer support teams to deliver products that meet or exceed customer expectations.
  • Facilitate clear communication and collaboration across teams to drive product development cycles.
  • Engage directly with customers to understand their technical needs, challenges, and goals. Leverage this insight to inform product decisions and ensure that solutions meet customer expectations.
  • Oversee the launch of new products and features, working with the marketing team to drive product adoption and customer satisfaction.
  • Provide technical leadership and customer-facing support as needed to ensure smooth product integrations.
  • Lead the identification and implementation of continuous improvements for products and processes, ensuring that CesiumAstro’s products remain industry-leading and meet the evolving demands of our customers.
  • Create and maintain high-quality documentation, including user manuals, application notes, and white papers.
  • Ensure that customer-facing teams are well-equipped with the knowledge to support product offerings.

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in a relevant technical field such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or related discipline.
  • At least 7 years of experience in the design of communication electronics, technical product development, product management, or application support.
  • In-depth understanding of RF electronics, communication systems, and associated technologies such as digital systems, embedded software, FPGAs, and power electronics.
  • Proven experience working with technical customers, developing strong relationships, and translating their needs into actionable product requirements.
  • Working knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++ or Python.
  • Exceptional troubleshooting skills and ability to understand, diagnose, and solve complex product issues across hardware and software domains.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience with high-reliability electronics and systems, particularly in the aerospace industry.
  • Familiarity with small satellite systems and their unique requirements

    • PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

title: Product Manager, Pricing
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

We're looking for a Product Manager to own Pricing within our Growth team across Deliveroo and Wolt! This role operates across 40+ markets in EMEA, and sits at the heart of our marketplace: Our fee strategy directly shapes consumer conversion, order frequency, PnL outcomes - and connects deeply to rider earnings and merchant economics across the Globe. You'll be responsible for building a pricing strategy and experimentation roadmap that grows revenue and profitability sustainably, without compromising the customer experience.

This is a very high-visibility role. You'll partner closely with Leadership, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to design, launch, and iterate on pricing experiments across all markets, from delivery fee and service fee algorithms to 0-1 new ventures. You'll be expected to build a strong testing culture, translate ambiguous commercial questions into a rigorous experimentation agenda, and communicate results and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders. 

About the Team

Our ambition is simple: make our platform an affordable, daily habit for all users.

The Pricing team builds the systems and experiences that touch every single order — from delivery options to promotions, fees, and entirely new pricing models. Operating across 40+ markets, our work sits at the intersection of customer value, growth, and marketplace economics.

Small changes at this scale can change how customers perceive us, how often they order, and the economics of the entire marketplace. We bring together consumer psychology, experimentation, data science, economics, and product craft to answer one deceptively difficult question: How do we make every order feel like great value while driving sustainable growth?

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of global pricing products.
  • Identify and launch major growth opportunities across affordability, conversion, frequency, revenue, and profitability.
  • Drive 0 to 1 big bets through validation, launch, then scale them 100X.
  • Partner deeply with Data Science and ML Engineering to design pricing algorithms, experiments, and scalable platform capabilities.
  • Develop hypotheses, launch experiments, interpret results, and turn learnings into product strategy.
  • Define the metrics and decision frameworks used to evaluate customer value, growth, and marketplace economics.
  • Communicate strategy, results, and tradeoffs to senior leaders across DoorDash.

What We’re Looking For

You might be a great fit if you:

  • Have significant product management experience building complex consumer, marketplace, growth, or monetization products.
  • Are deeply analytical and comfortable using experimentation and data to make high-stakes product decisions.
  • Are comfortable working closely with Data Science and ML Engineering on algorithmic or optimization problems.
  • Can turn ambiguous commercial questions into clear and executable product hypotheses and roadmaps.
  • Can operate as a “conductor” — aligning technical, operational, and business stakeholders and stitching together strategy, execution, and influence across teams.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo and Wolt, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a product manager. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts. 

Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal.

Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.
We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.
Now we need someone to help decide what we build next. You’ll own the priorities for our data capture platform, from the aircraft to the sensors they carry. You’ll work side by side with customers in the field, Wingtra engineers and Wingtranauts across all business functions. Your job is to find the problems that matter most to our customers and turn good ideas into products people love. Inside Wingtra you’re the voice of the user. Outside you’re the voice of the product.
Responsibilities

title: Product & Regulatory Counsel
descriptionHtml:
Tired of meeting the product at the terms and conditions stage?

Most product lawyers see the flow once it's built and the launch date is set. Here, you're on the whiteboard at ideation, so compliant by design is the plan, not the clean-up.

The job

title: Product Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Become the person who knows Cosuno best, and the one our customers want in the room.

YOUR MISSION

Cosuno is the platform where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, compare the offers and award the contracts. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform.

Our customers run complex procurement processes on Cosuno, and our commercial teams need someone who knows the product in every detail. As our Product Specialist, you'll be that person. You'll know how every workflow behaves, which workarounds exist and where the product is heading. You'll lead the customer meetings that need deep product knowledge, from custom development projects to strategic conversations with our enterprise customers. You'll report directly to our Head of Product.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Be the go-to product expert. Sales, Customer Success and Account Management come to you first when a customer question goes beyond the standard. You answer all of them and turn recurring questions into answers everyone can find.

  • Lead customer meetings. Run feedback sessions, roadmap conversations and workshops with our customers, including our largest enterprise accounts.

  • Find solutions within the product. Sit down with customers, understand the problem behind the request and find creative ways to solve it with what we already have.

  • Turn feedback into decisions. Back customer requests with usage data, check them against our product principles and give our PMs clear, prioritized input. When we won't build something, you explain to the customer why.

  • Run custom developments. Project-manage custom developments for important customers: agree on scope, coordinate with Product and Engineering and deliver on time.

  • Support demos. Join Sales in complex demos and present our roadmap and product decisions to customers and prospects.

HOW WE WORK

  • Close to the customer. We're very close to our customers and talk to them every week.

  • Evidence over opinions. We decide what to build based on customer evidence and usage data, not on who asks loudest.

  • AI-first. We're an AI-first company. AI is at the core of our product, and we work with Claude Code and other AI tools every day.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 2–4 years in a customer-facing product role in B2B SaaS, e.g. as Product Specialist, Solutions Consultant, Customer Success Manager or Implementation Manager

  • You learn a complex product in depth, fast, and explain it clearly to people with very different backgrounds

  • You're confident in front of customers: you lead a meeting, handle tough questions and can say no with good reasons

  • You've managed projects with external stakeholders, including scope, timelines and expectations

  • You turn scattered customer feedback into clear, prioritized input, and you pull usage data yourself to back it up

  • You use AI tools every day in your own work

  • German at C2 level and fluent English: our customers work in German, our product and engineering team in English

Bonus points for experience in construction, construction tech or procurement, or with product enablement (help centre, webinars, product tours).

WHY US?

  • Real impact: You work directly with our Head of Product and shape what we build, based on what you hear from customers.

  • Work-life balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Germany, or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg.

  • Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Air.

  • A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events.

  • Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

  • Growth & feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

ABOUT US

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An inclusive work environment is a given for us.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

Compensation: €55K – €65K

title: Productmanager Parts & Tyres
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij commercieel ingesteld, analytisch sterk en heb je interesse in techniek en automotive? Krijg je energie van het ontdekken van nieuwe kansen en wil je zelf invloed hebben op het succes van jouw productgroepen? Dan is deze functie bij BAS Parts & Tyres iets voor jou!

BAS Parts & Tyres is een grote speler in de internationale handel van truckonderdelen en banden. We leveren nieuwe, gebruikte en gereviseerde onderdelen aan klanten in meer dan 100 landen. Van complete motoren met meer dan 700 pk tot truckcabines die in containers de hele wereld overgaan: bij ons draait alles op grote schaal!

Als Productmanager Parts & Tyres ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling en groei van jouw eigen assortiment. Je analyseert de markt, onderhoudt contact met leveranciers en bepaalt welke producten interessant zijn om in te kopen. Met jouw commerciële inzicht en analytische vaardigheden zorg je ervoor dat onze producten goed aansluiten bij de vraag van klanten wereldwijd.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid om initiatief te nemen, nieuwe ideeën uit te werken en direct bij te dragen aan het commerciële succes van BAS Parts & Tyres.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Productmanager ben jij het aanspreekpunt voor jouw productgroepen. Je combineert markt- en data-analyse met inkoop, assortimentsbeheer en samenwerking met verschillende afdelingen.

Je houdt ontwikkelingen binnen de markt in de gaten, onderzoekt welke producten goed verkopen en kijkt waar nieuwe commerciële kansen liggen.

Jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Je analyseert marktontwikkelingen, verkoopcijfers en klantbehoeften om jouw assortiment verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Je onderhoudt contact met leveranciers, onderhandelt over inkoopmogelijkheden en koopt zelfstandig onderdelen in;

  • Je signaleert kansen om het assortiment uit te breiden, aan te passen of juist producten uit te faseren;

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat productinformatie, zoals specificaties, omschrijvingen en kenmerken, volledig en correct online staat;

  • Je bewaakt de commerciële prestaties van jouw productgroepen en stuurt op omzet, marges en beschikbaarheid;

  • Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van inkoop, sales, e-commerce, marketing en IT om verbeteringen door te voeren;

  • Je draagt actief bij aan het behalen van persoonlijke en teamdoelstellingen.

Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid om jouw eigen productgroepen verder uit te bouwen. Daarbij combineer je analytisch werken met commercie en ben je dagelijks bezig met het ontdekken en benutten van nieuwe kansen.

Wat maakt deze functie zo leuk?

Bij BAS Parts & Tyres krijg je de kans om zelfstandig aan jouw eigen assortiment te werken. Je hebt direct invloed op welke producten we aanbieden, hoe we deze presenteren en hoe succesvol ze worden verkocht.

Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met uiteenlopende technische producten en krijgt volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Of je nu nieuwe leveranciers ontdekt, verkoopresultaten analyseert of samen met collega's verbeteringen doorvoert: geen dag is hetzelfde!

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris met een bonusregeling;

  • Een veelzijdige functie met veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief;

  • Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen via producttrainingen, taalcursussen en andere opleidingen;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen een internationaal groeiende organisatie;

  • Een jong, ambitieus en gezellig team waarin successen samen worden gevierd;

  • Een informele werksfeer met korte lijnen en ruimte voor ondernemerschap;

  • Deelname aan het BAS Fit-programma met sportactiviteiten zoals de marathon van Eindhoven, het BAS Voetbaltoernooi en het BAS Padeltoernooi;

  • Gezellige borrels, teamuitjes en natuurlijk de legendarische BAS-feesten!


Jouw specificaties

We zoeken een ondernemende en analytische collega die commerciële kansen herkent, initiatief neemt en graag verantwoordelijkheid draagt.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je beschikt over hbo-werk- en -denkniveau;

  • Je hebt interesse in automotive, techniek en truckonderdelen;

  • Je bent analytisch sterk en weet data om te zetten naar concrete commerciële kansen;

  • Je werkt graag met Excel en kunt verkoopcijfers en marktontwikkelingen analyseren;

  • Je bent commercieel ingesteld en krijgt energie van het ontwikkelen en laten groeien van een assortiment;

  • Je neemt initiatief, stelt kritische vragen en denkt in oplossingen;

  • Je kunt goed plannen en organiseren en houdt overzicht wanneer het druk is;

  • Je werkt graag samen met verschillende afdelingen.

Nog geen uitgebreide kennis van truckonderdelen? Geen probleem! Met jouw analytische vaardigheden, commerciële instelling en interesse in techniek kun je bij ons volop leren en jezelf ontwikkelen.

Een nieuwe locatie, volop groeimogelijkheden

BAS Parts & Tyres blijft groeien en investeert daarom in een gloednieuwe vestiging in Veghel. Hier vind je een modern kantoor met ruimte voor 100 collega's, een uitgebreide kantine en twee magazijnhallen met samen 2.500 m² opslagruimte en een hoogte van 15 meter.

Deze nieuwe locatie biedt volop mogelijkheden om onze internationale handel verder uit te breiden. Als Productmanager speel jij een belangrijke rol in deze groei en krijg je de ruimte om jouw assortiment verder te ontwikkelen.

Interesse?

Wij zijn BAS!

BAS Parts & Tyres is onderdeel van BAS Group, een internationaal familiebedrijf dat sinds 1962 actief is in de automotive sector. Met meer dan 1.000 collega's zijn we wereldwijd actief in de handel van vrachtwagens, trailers, machines, onderdelen en banden.

Bij BAS houden we van aanpakken, samenwerken en kansen benutten. Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap vormen de basis van onze organisatie. Samen blijven we groeien en onze dienstverlening verbeteren!

title: Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Taurus

Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you.

Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth.

Tasks

The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth.

This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Main Responsibilities

  • Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments.

  • Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion

  • Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations.

  • Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company.

Requirements

Your Profile

  • Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment.

  • Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.).

  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail.

  • Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner.

  • Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Willingness to travel to client locations as required

Benefits

What We Offer

  • An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions.

  • A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain.

  • A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit.

  • A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally

As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer.

Note

We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies.

title: Recruiting Sourcer - Europe
descriptionHtml:
We are an applied AI lab building end-to-end software agents.

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

About The Role

We are hiring a Recruiting Sourcer to join our EMEA Talent team, based in London. This is an in-office role.

You will own the top of the funnel for hiring across the region, partnering closely with recruiters and hiring managers to find, engage and convert exceptional people who aren't looking for us yet.

You will be expected to operate with urgency, creativity and high judgment. You will not simply run searches. You will build our outbound engine: mapping markets, mining our networks, showing up where great people are and turning cold prospects into engaged candidates.

The ideal person is a curious, resourceful hunter who measures success by pipeline quality, not volume, and knows how to create momentum in ambiguous, fast-moving markets.

What You’ll Do

  • Own outbound sourcing across our EMEA hiring priorities, with a focus on technical roles.

  • Build deep talent maps across enterprise software, AI, developer tools, cloud, infrastructure and high-growth technology companies.

  • Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to calibrate on profiles early, then iterate quickly based on feedback and conversion data.

  • Use the full sourcing toolkit (LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox, Boolean and X-ray search, GitHub, communities) and go beyond it with creative strategies that reach people others miss.

  • Run referral mining: work systematically through our team's, investors' and alumni networks to uncover warm paths to top candidates.

  • Plan, host and attend recruiting events, meetups and networking events, and turn them into qualified pipeline.

  • Write sharp, personalised outreach that represents Cognition's story with clarity, credibility and energy, and keep testing what works.

  • Engage passive candidates and run first-call qualifying screens, handing recruiters warm, qualified, well-briefed candidates.

  • Track and report on top-of-funnel metrics (response rates, pass-through rates, source of hire) and use them to keep raising pipeline quality.

  • Build and maintain talent pools in Ashby for recurring and future roles.

  • Work closely with international talent leadership to share what works and build scalable sourcing muscle across EMEA.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven sourcing experience at high-growth technology companies, ideally with a focus on technical roles.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise software, SaaS, AI, infrastructure, developer tools or cloud markets.

  • Mastery of modern sourcing tools and techniques (e.g. LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox), and the curiosity to keep adopting new ones, especially AI-powered tools.

  • Confidence running first-call qualifying screens and pitching the opportunity to passive candidates.

  • Creative instincts: you find candidates through communities, events, content, referrals and networks, not just databases.

  • Outreach that gets replies: concise, personalised and compelling.

  • Experience sourcing across multiple EMEA markets, with an understanding of local market dynamics.

  • A data-driven approach: you know your funnel numbers and use them to improve.

  • Strong partnership skills with the confidence to push back on and calibrate with recruiters and hiring managers.

  • High agency, high ownership and strong attention to detail.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-changing, 0 to 1 environment.

  • A builder mindset: you improve the system while delivering the work.

  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, London, and comfortable working from our London office.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have sourced for early teams in new international markets.

  • You have sourced for frontier AI, developer tools, infrastructure, cloud or enterprise software companies.

  • You have built or run a referral programme or recruiting event series that led directly to hires.

  • You already have a strong network in the London and European tech ecosystem.

  • You have built your own sourcing workflows or automations using AI tools.

  • You care deeply about quality, not just volume.

descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. We don’t pretend to have all the answers yet, and you will play a role in continuing to shape our offering.

Our Relationship Manager team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow with the Bank at pace. Providing every customer who opens an account with us with a Relationship Manager, to work alongside them and provide outstanding service, is core to our strategy.

In addition to providing outstanding service, our Relationship Managers build deep levels of understanding and trust with their customers, and get to understand their ambitions, goals and motivations. Allica Relationship Managers support their customers through the provision of appropriate Allica Bank products including Business Current Accounts, Savings Accounts, Commercial Loans, Asset Finance and Working Capital Facilities.

All Relationship Manager roles at Allica Bank carry a requirement for new business acquisition as we continue to build the bank. Where portfolios are held, they are built to allow capacity to do this. Relationship Managers will bring, and continue to build, a strong network of trusted SME advisors such as accountants, solicitors, business organisations and others (but not commercial finance brokers – these are looked after by our dedicated broker team). We expect our Relationship Managers to be recognised as valued partners and experts in business finance by their clients and in the communities they serve.

Principal Accountabilities

• Relationship Manage a portfolio of SME customers, understanding customer’s needs and business aspirations, and looking for opportunities to support them via Allica Bank services and through their own external networks

• Originating SME lending opportunities for both existing and new customers from initial enquiry through to completion, including writing credit papers in line with Allica’s credit policy and appetite.

• Delivering the business plan for your local area, and actively managing your objectives and personal development plan.

• Making your colleagues proud that you represent Allica in your local area, by ensuring excellent service for local SME customers, prospects and advisors.

• Working closely and collaboratively with all areas of Allica to ensure a seamless and professional service is always provided.

• Being a positive contributor to Allica’s culture, and always demonstrating the bank’s values

• Complying with all mandatory policies, and adherence to operational procedures to maintain internal controls.

Personal Attributes & Experience

• Highly capable Relationship Manager and Business Developer with a long-term track record of building high-value, trust based and long-lasting referral relationships.

• You will need to have a strong understanding of SME banking, which must include a background in commercial lending.

• You will be able to demonstrate a history of exemplary level of service, and of maximising the value with prospects and customers.

• You will be able to demonstrate a passion for SMEs, be a self-starter and bring an entrepreneurial mindset to your work.

• You will have excellent interpersonal and communication skills together with evidence of strong career progression and/or outperformance.

• You’ll be able to evidence an ability to work expertly with customers, colleagues and advisors to structure new lending proposals and write credit applications.

descriptionHtml:
Position summary

Prosci Executive Instructors are dynamic teachers and facilitators, with a passion for change management and our client’s success. With deep business expertise, and a thorough understanding of Prosci’s change management research, methodologies, and tools, you will not only deliver a variety of programs designed to build the client's change management capabilities, but you will also help to establish Prosci as a valuable, long-term partner to organizations as they navigate their most critical change initiatives.

Scope & Responsibilities

Deliver a variety of programs on Prosci change methodology, tools, and research:

  • Instruct clients in Prosci’s proprietary change management methodology virtually, or at client locations or Prosci-selected venues across the Europe and EMEA
  • Maintain up-to-date mastery of Prosci’s change management offerings
  • Combine career experience with Prosci methodology to illustrate real-world change management application and answer clients’ questions specific to their individual change initiatives
  • Prepare thoughtfully for sessions to provide incredible learning experiences for all participants
  • Serve our client relationships to establish Prosci as a valuable, long-term partner to organizations as they navigate their most critical change initiatives

Driving and Influencing Change:

  • Foster a culture of adaptability and resilience within colleagues, customers, and program participants
  • Drive digital transformation by engaging in new technologies and processes to improve efficiency and competitiveness
  • Operates as a recognized expert to orient work in a workflow to plan, organize, and execute the steps it takes to achieve a goal to achieve higher efficiency. Typically known as a subject matter authority
  • Applies expertise to act as an authority to quickly identify and accurately articulate why a client does or does not want a change based on their business objectives and challenges

Managing Critical Relationships

  • Develop a thorough understanding of the customers specific needs, objectives and challenges related to organizational change initiatives. Actively listen and ask pertinent questions to uncover potential barriers or resistance factors
  • Offer expert advice, guidance and recommendations to clients based on your in-depth knowledge and experiences with Prosci tools and methodologies
  • Understand complex topics and processes required to mentor clients in applying Prosci methodologies within their environment
  • Actively seek feedback from colleagues and customers to identify areas for improvement and enhance the client experience

Business Development

  • Collaborate with Product Development and Advisory to develop new offerings or enhance existing products
  • Craft compelling value propositions that highlight unique benefits of Prosci products or services
  • Engage in collaborative content creation and thought leadership opportunities such as white papers, articles, blog posts and webinars to actively engage current and former course participants
  • Assist the Growth team in addressing industry specific questions, objections, or concerns for prospective clients
  • Apply your industry expertise to identify and engage potential clients
  • Identify and cultivate strategic partnerships with other businesses and organizations

Requirements

Technical/Functional Skills

  • Change and Project Management experience in dynamic growth/change cultures (PMBOK, Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, Waterfall etc.)
  • Intermediate MS Office skills with the ability to navigate a virtual learning environment
  • Demonstrated expertise in the Prosci portal tools including Proxima and Hub Suite is a strong plus
  • Proficient working in Zoom, Teams, WebEx, Salesforce and M365

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and advanced degree preferred, or equivalent years of experience
  • Diverse industry experience leading change from a consultative, project, program, or executive level in multiple industries (for-profit and not-for-profit), CDP industry
  • Demonstrated experience successfully engaging with employees undergoing change, practitioners leading change and senior leaders who sponsor change

Additional Preferences

  • Engaging presentation and facilitation skills (both in-person and in virtual settings)

  • Ability to incorporate relevant career experience and expertise into the learning environment

  • Language: Native French and fluent in English (full professional proficiency), fluency in Spanish and/or Italian are a strong plus
  • Travel expectations: 50% of travel anticipated

About Prosci

Founded in 1994, Prosci is a global leader in change management and the provider of choice for 80% of Fortune 100 companies. Prosci combines scientific research with the people side of change to deliver results-focused solutions that enable clients to achieve change outcomes and grow organizational change capability. Prosci maintains the industry’s largest body of change management research—the basis for the company’s tools, methodologies, advisory services, and role-based development programs. To date, Prosci has certified over 100,000 change management practitioners worldwide.

The company is headquartered in Fort Collins, Colorado, with offices in Europe, Australia, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Colombia and Mexico , plus a number of Prosci Partners around the globe. Prosci is continually expanding directly and through its global partner network to ensure change success for clients no matter where they are located.

We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

This role carries real weight. You'll be responsible for a book of enterprise accounts where the deals are complex, the buying committees are large, and the technical bar is high. There's meaningful room here to shape how your territory gets built, not just execute against someone else's plan.

As an Enterprise Account Executive III, you'll own the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, working alongside sales engineering, customer success, and leadership to get complex deals across the line. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large, strategic accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

  • Build and drive strategic account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and executive buyers.

  • Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure a smooth handoff after close.

  • Represent Camunda's value to senior leaders and technical buyers, tailoring the pitch to what each audience actually cares about.

  • The ability to sell technical products credibly. Experience with process automation, integration platforms, middleware, or similar technical software is a real advantage here, since you'll regularly be in the room with engineering and IT buyers.

  • Negotiation experience under genuine pressure. You know where to hold firm and where to flex, and you can explain your reasoning either way.

  • A relationship-building style that goes beyond the transaction. You've had customers treat you as an advisor, not just a vendor, and you know what it took to earn that.

title: Fintech Onboarding Manager & Consultant (w/m/d) - Buchhaltungs- und Steuerthemen
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

 

Deine Mission

Als Stimme unserer Kunden in Deutschland bist du verantwortlich für ihren Erfolg mit der Pennylane-Plattform.

Deine Kernaufgaben:

- Kunden-Onboarding: Du übernimmst die vollständige Einarbeitung (Onboarding) neuer Kunden – sowohl Unternehmen als auch Steuerberaterkanzleien – in die Pennylane-Plattform. Du stellst sicher, dass sie schnell den größtmöglichen Mehrwert aus unserer Lösung ziehen.

- Bestandskundenbetreuung: Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für unsere bestehenden Kunden. Du pflegst eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung, identifizierst Upsell-Potenziale und stellst sicher, dass die Kunden Pennylane optimal nutzen, um ihre Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

- Proaktive Beratung: Du führst regelmäßige Health-Checks und Reviews durch, um die Kundenzufriedenheit und -bindung zu maximieren und Churn vorzubeugen.

- Interne Projektarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem deutschen Sales-Team und dem Management zusammen, um Prozesse zu optimieren, Feedback zu Produktanforderungen zu liefern und zum strategischen Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland beizutragen.

- Expertentum: Du entwickelst dich zum Produktexperten für die Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft in Deutschland und teilst dieses Wissen mit unseren Kunden.

  

Das bringst du mit

- Erfahrung: 2-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, Account Management oder einer ähnlichen kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise im Kanzlei-Umfeld oder alternativ im SaaS- oder Fintech-Bereich.

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, Steuerfachwirt oder Steuerberater oder Studium im Finance-Bereich

- Branchenwissen: Ein tiefes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse von Unternehmen und/oder Steuerberatern in Bezug auf Finanzen, Rechnungsstellung und Buchhaltung ist notwendig.

- Soft Skills: Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Empathie und ein Talent dafür, komplexe Sachverhalte einfach zu erklären.

- Hands-on Mentalität: Als Teil eines Early-Stage-Teams in Deutschland bist du proaktiv, lösungsorientiert und bereit, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

- Reisebereitschaft: Für das Onboarding im Pariser HQ und für regelmäßige Besuche bei unseren Kunden innerhalb von Deutschland (ca. 1mal im Monat

- Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau oder Muttersprache) und fließende Englischkenntnisse (für die Zusammenarbeit mit dem internationalen Team).

  

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.
