title: Senior CRO & Funnel Marketing Manager (m/w/d) · Remote
descriptionHtml:
Du hast schon Onlineshops zum Wachsen gebracht und suchst ein Umfeld, in dem du auf höchstem Niveau arbeiten kannst? Dann übernimm bei EVOLVE die Conversionrate-Optimierung und Funnelentwicklung von E-Commerce-Brands, von der ersten Analyse bis zum messbaren Ergebnis.

Über EVOLVE

Wir sind ein ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum. Jedes Jahr verwalten wir über 60 Millionen € Adspend und denken jedes Projekt von der Ad über den Funnel bis zur Marge. Unser Name ist Programm: Wir entwickeln uns, unsere Dienstleistung und unsere Kunden ständig weiter. Das spiegelt sich auch in unserer Mitarbeiterbewertung auf kununu mit 4,8 von 5 Sternen wider.

Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann schau dir an, was dich bei uns erwartet.

Das wirst du tun

Du bist verantwortlich für verkaufsstarke Shopseiten und Funnels, die dafür sorgen, dass unsere Kunden den Markt outperformen.

  • Analyse: Du analysierst Shops, Landingpages und Funnels ganzheitlich und leitest daraus priorisierte Hypothesen und Maßnahmen ab

  • Positionierung: Du deckst die entscheidenden Hebel in der Customer Journey auf und entwickelst Positionierungen, die Marken klar vom Wettbewerb abheben

  • Konzeption: Du erstellst conversionstarke Shop- und Landingpage-Konzepte und steuerst die Umsetzung mit UX-Design und Copywriting

  • Kunden und Projekte: Du führst Kunden eigenständig durch den Optimierungsprozess und verantwortest Projekte bis zum messbaren Ergebnis

  • Trends: Du verfolgst die aktuellsten Trends im Brand- und Direct-Response-Marketing und bringst sie in unsere Methodik und Standards ein

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen: Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung für deine eigenen Projekte, stehst damit aber nicht allein: Unsere Experten für UX-Design, Copywriting und Performance Marketing setzen deine Konzepte mit dir um. Dich erwartet ein Team, das für Ergebnisse, Verlässlichkeit und kreative Exzellenz steht, mit flachen Hierarchien und einer offenen Feedbackkultur.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in CRO, E-Commerce oder UX, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder einem Shop mit relevantem Traffic

  • Sicherer Umgang mit GA4, Hotjar/Clarity und A/B-Tests

  • Fundiertes Verständnis für Positionierung, Customer Journey und Conversion-Psychologie

  • Klare Kommunikation, schriftlich wie im Kundengespräch

  • Hohe Eigenständigkeit: Du priorisierst konsequent und gibst klare Empfehlungen

Der Rahmen

  • 100 % Remote, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • Vollzeit mit einer 38-Stunden-Woche

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Zweimal jährlich Team-Events und Workations

  • Wöchentliche Team-Recaps und Coffee Chats, damit Remote nicht heißt, den ganzen Tag allein zu arbeiten

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, JobRad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Steuerfreier Sachbezug von 50 € monatlich als Gutschein deiner Wahl

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

Vielleicht fragst du dich gerade …

„Wie viele Projekte betreue ich parallel?“ Wenige, dafür aber in der Tiefe. So kannst du dich wirklich in jede Marke reindenken. Du arbeitest nicht am Fließband, sondern begleitest deine Kunden langfristig und siehst, was aus deinen Konzepten wird.

„Welche Rolle spielt AI bei euch?“ Eine große. ChatGPT und Claude werden deine besten Freunde, denn mit den modernsten AI-Workflows optimierst du deine Arbeit und das Ergebnis für deine Kunden. Dafür hast du vollen Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack. So bleibt mehr Zeit für das, was wirklich zählt: die richtigen Ideen für deine Kunden.

„100 % Remote, verliere ich da den Austausch?“ Nein. Wir sind eine Remote-Agentur, aber Persönlichkeit und Teamspirit bleiben erhalten. Du hast das Gefühl eines Office-Teams, nur ohne Lärm und ohne Fahrt ins Büro. Dafür sorgen regelmäßige Projektabstimmungen, unsere wöchentlichen Team-Recaps und Coffee Chats.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Vanessa, unsere HR-Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (German-speaking)
descriptionHtml:
Are you a German-speaking Customer Success professional with a passion for learning and technology? Do you thrive on building strong customer relationships, spotting opportunities for growth, and helping customers succeed? Then the Senior Customer Success Manager role at Kahoot! might be just the right fit for you. Come join us in making learning awesome!

The Role

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will play a key role in helping medium to large enterprise customers succeed and getting the most out of our products. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will help customers achieve tangible business results with our products while identifying opportunities to strengthen relationships, drive retention, and grow accounts.

You will be part of our International Customer Success team, working with customers across one or more products in the Kahoot! Group's portfolio.

Fluency in German is essential for this role, as you will work closely with customers in DACH.

This role can be based in Copenhagen, Denmark; Oslo, Norway; or work remotely in Germany. You will report to the regional Manager, Customer Success.

Responsibilities

Portfolio Ownership and Customer Outcomes

  • Own a portfolio of mid-sized to large Enterprise customers and drive measurable progress towards their business objectives.
  • Manage the full customer lifecycle: handover from Sales, onboarding, adoption, value realisation, business reviews (QBRs/EBRs) and renewals (in collaboration with Account Management, where applicable).
  • Build and maintain success plans and account plans with clear, customer-agreed success metrics and ROI.

Strategic and Commercial Impact

  • Use strong business acumen and our MEDDIC-based methodology to run discovery, uncover customer pain points and their business impact, and map stakeholders, champions and decision-making processes.
  • Build multi-threaded relationships, including at executive-sponsor level.
  • Own or support renewals and retention targets (GRR/NRR), forecast renewals accurately, and identify expansion opportunities in partnership with Account Managers and Account Executives.

Risk and Health Management

  • Monitor customer health and product usage data to spot risks early, and lead mitigation and retention plans.
  • Act as the customer’s escalation point, coordinating with Support, Product and leadership to resolve critical issues.
  • Analyse customer churn and losses, and share key learnings.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the Role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Ledgy, you'll build the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably. You'll join our Platform team, collaborating with engineers and InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure for a product that helps companies manage equity.

Our challenge is to make delivery faster, production easier to operate, and AI-assisted development safer - while keeping complexity and costs in check.

Location: We hire remotely across Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania.

The team you'll join: Platform - Builds the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably, working with InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure.

What You'll Work On

  • Cloud infrastructure. Evolve our GCP and Kubernetes cloud architecture and setup with Terraform, improving reliability, simplicity, and cost visibility and enabling scaling to multiple availability regions.
  • CI/CD and developer experience. Speed up feedback loops, reduce flaky builds, and turn recurring support requests into self-service tooling.
  • Observability. Reduce alert noise, define meaningful SLOs, and make production issues easier to diagnose.
  • Security and automation. Partner with InfoSec on secure delivery, access controls, and guardrails for AI-assisted workflows.

You'll also join our incident-response on-call rotation during working hours and help prevent recurring issues. As we expand our servicing of public companies and jurisdictions, this on-call might evolve to compensated 24h/7 hour rotation.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.

  • Have strong DevOps / SRE background designing and operating cloud infrastructure and production systems
  • Have worked with Kubernetes and infrastructure as code, ideally GCP and Terraform
  • Enjoy building fast, reliable CI/CD pipelines and improving developer experience
  • Can diagnose issues across networking, infrastructure, and application code
  • Write maintainable code and bring a practical approach to observability and security
  • Value collaboration, mentorship, and thoughtful trade-offs between reliability, complexity, and cost
  • Are curious about supporting AI-assisted development safely - no AI specialism required

Experience with Node.js, MongoDB or Temporal is a plus.

Our Tech Stack

We work in TypeScript: React, Tailwind CSS, and tRPC on the front end, and tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. Infrastructure runs on GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, and GitHub Actions. For observability and incident response we use Grafana, Sentry, and PagerDuty.

You don't need to know all of it. We don't expect proficiency in every part of this stack. Strong infrastructure fundamentals and the ability to learn matter more than knowing every tool already.

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First 30 days:

  • Get to know Ledgy, the Platform team, and our internal users with an onboarding buddy
  • Explore our infrastructure and delivery workflows, and ship your first improvement
  • Analyze current state of our cloud infrastructure and propose meaningful enhancements

First 3 months:

  • Independently deliver improvements to CI/CD, observability, or infrastructure design
  • Share operational ownership and help reduce recurring friction for engineers
  • Contribute to architecture discussions and document what others need to operate our systems

First 6-12 months:

  • Own DevOps and SRE function and DevOps initiatives from problem definition through rollout and adoption
  • Deliver measurable improvements to developer experience, reliability, or cost
  • Help shape our platform's direction and mentor other engineers

The interview process

  • Getting to know you (45 min): Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role
  • Live Coding (60 min): An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.
  • System Design (60 min): A system design session where you will design an architecture for a problem from the Ledgy domain using a visual tool of your choice
  • DDSA (45 min): A Deep Dive into real System Architecture that you have built, owned and monitored.
  • Culture Interview: A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy's mission and values
  • Offer 🎉

Being part of Ledgy means

  • Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.
  • We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.
  • This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.

title: Senior Electronic Warfare Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
What you'll do 

  • Own the system architecture of Hypersonica's Electronic Warfare (EW) capability, ensuring electronic support (ES), electronic attack (EA), and electronic protection (EP) functions operate as a coherent and mission-effective system.

  • Define, maintain, and manage EW system requirements, ensuring full traceability from operational needs through system architecture, subsystem allocation, verification, and validation.

  • Lead the development of EW system architectures, performance budgets, interface definitions, and mission integrations across airborne platforms and payloads.

  • Conduct threat, signal, and electromagnetic environment analyses to assess system effectiveness against representative adversary capabilities and operational conditions.

  • Lead the integration of RF sensors, receivers, transmitters, antenna systems, signal processing functions, mission computers, and platform interfaces into a coherent operational capability.

  • Define and oversee system-level modelling, simulation, laboratory testing, ground trials, and flight trials, using evidence-based analysis to drive design improvements and risk reduction.

  • Produce and maintain critical systems engineering artefacts including system specifications, interface control documents (ICDs), verification strategies, test plans, and design review materials.

  • Apply model-based systems engineering (MBSE) principles to ensure traceability between requirements, architectures, analyses, verification activities, and operational outcomes.

  • Identify and mitigate system-level risks, particularly around electromagnetic performance, interoperability, survivability, cybersecurity, verification, and platform integration.

  • Act as the technical authority for EW system engineering, working across RF, software, hardware, mission systems, cybersecurity, safety, and platform engineering disciplines to deliver robust operational capability.


Who you are 

  • An experienced Systems Engineer with 8+ years of experience delivering complex Electronic Warfare, RF, mission systems, avionics, aerospace, defence, or other mission-critical systems.

  • Strong background in systems architecture, requirements development, requirements decomposition, verification, and validation throughout the engineering lifecycle.

  • Deep understanding of Electronic Warfare concepts, including electronic support (ES), electronic attack (EA), electronic protection (EP), threat systems, and electromagnetic spectrum operations.

  • Experience integrating RF sensors, receivers, transmitters, antennas, signal processing systems, and mission computers into operational platforms.

  • Strong knowledge of electromagnetic environments, system performance analysis, modelling, simulation, and test methodologies.

  • Familiar with MBSE approaches and capable of applying systems engineering rigour to complex, multidisciplinary defence programmes.

  • Experienced supporting major design reviews, platform integration activities, flight trials, qualification programmes, and operational capability development.

  • Technically credible across multiple disciplines, capable of influencing decisions, challenging assumptions, and driving technical direction confidently.

  • Comfortable operating within fast-moving, high-accountability environments where ambiguity is high and execution speed matters.

  • Motivated by solving nationally significant defence challenges and building capabilities that directly contribute to European security and technological independence.


What we offer 

  • A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.

  • A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from testing and operational activities drives real decisions.

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.


Security and Eligibility Requirement 

Due to the nature of the work done at Hypersonica, applicants must be an EU/Nato/German citizen and be eligible for Security Clearance.

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

At Stark, our embedded engineering team is responsible for bridging cutting-edge autonomy with resilient, real-world execution. We design and deliver the embedded control architecture, sensor integration, and secure communications backbones that keep our platforms connected, responsive, and safe.

YOUR MISSION

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer with strong low-level C/C++ skills and practical experience integrating software, electronics, and communications in embedded control systems.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Assemble control hardware and configure firmware. Test with launchers and C2 systems
  • Design and improve control system hardware taking it from prototype system to hardened field ready and mass producible product
  • Manage software code base and move towards certifiable system
  • Produce custom PCBs and enclosures to better package control system and increase reliability
  • Produce documentation for system and produce build/operation manuals

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Strong low-level C/C++ development skills, proficiency in Python, and experience working with Linux.
  • Experience programming and configuring embedded microcontrollers, PLCs, and single-board computers such as Raspberry Pi.
  • Experience developing, integrating, and debugging drivers for hardware devices and peripherals.
  • Strong ability to read and interpret hardware schematics, and produce clear interface schematics and system diagrams.
  • Practical experience configuring network infrastructure, routers, and connected devices using Ethernet, TCP/IP, CAN bus, and UART.
  • Familiarity with MAVLink, PX4, drone flight controllers, and autonomous systems.
  • Experience with secure data streaming and encrypted communications over internet and satellite links, including Starlink.
  • Proficiency with hardware debugging equipment, including logic analysers and oscilloscopes.
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues across software, hardware, and communications interfaces.
  • Strong hands-on experience with ARM-based embedded platforms and low-level interfaces, particularly Ethernet, CAN bus, SPI, I2C, and UART.
  • Demonstrated experience writing, integrating, and validating low-level Ethernet and CAN drivers on ARM architectures.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with custom PCB design, manufacturing, and board bring-up.
  • Practical skills in cable harness assembly, soldering, and power-system wiring.
  • RF communications experience.
  • FPGA development or integration experience.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

title: Senior Engineer II, Chromium
descriptionHtml:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Data Security & AI Engineering team. In this role, you will bring strong systems engineering skills—ideally with hands-on Chromium experience across core layers—to build, expand, and harden the runtime capabilities that power Menlo's next-generation AI security platform. You will work at the intersection of browser engine internals, systems architecture, and AI security, expanding our detection surfaces to safeguard enterprise workforces and AI agents against modern threats like Prompt Injection (PI) and Shadow AI usage. The role blends deep C++ browser engineering with work on Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), and the cloud infrastructure supporting them. You’ll collaborate closely with engineers across Chromium, AI, and security disciplines to ship high-performance, evasion-resistant protections, leveraging AI-assisted development tools to move fast while maintaining an uncompromising bar for quality and security.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain Chromium-based browser components in C++, working across layers such as content, browser, core, compositor, skia, and networking, that power Menlo's security and AI-driven capabilities.

  • Architect and embed controls for detecting Prompt Injection (PI) and managing Shadow AI activity directly within browser execution and agent workflows.

  • Apply strong networking fundamentals and HTTP security expertise to harden Menlo's browser isolation, proxy/gateway intercepts, and network-facing infrastructure.

  • Partner with the MARS and AI teams to build and integrate AI agent capabilities and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers into Menlo's security platform.

  • Use Python or Rust to build supporting tooling, detection microservices, and prototypes alongside core C++ systems work.

  • Deploy and operate the cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and orchestration (Kubernetes, Terraform) needed to run agent/MCP and threat-detection workloads reliably.

  • Debug and optimize performance-critical, high-scale systems across the browser and supporting backend infrastructure.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, security, and AI engineering teams to ship capabilities end-to-end.

  • Apply AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate development, testing, and code review as part of your daily workflow.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering with strong C++ systems programming skills.

  • Strong networking fundamentals, including solid knowledge of HTTP security, web protocols and / or client-side security architecture.

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Preferred / Nice to Have:

  • Experience across Chromium layers such as content, browser, core, compositor, skia, and networking (or equivalent large-scale, high-performance C++ systems experience).

  • Experience or strong interest in AI/LLM security / guardrails domains (e.g., Prompt Injection defense, Shadow AI detection, intent classification, context aware DLP/PII detection, and agentic workflows).

  • Python or Rust experience.

  • Experience building or integrating AI agents, Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers.

  • Experience with AWS, GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Linux.

Follow us on LinkedIn!

Why Menlo?

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership, Straight Talk, United Impact, Elevated Talent, and Customer-Compelled. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

TO ALL AGENCIES: Please, no phone calls or emails to any employee of Menlo Security outside of the Talent organization. Menlo Security’s policy is to only accept resumes from agencies via Ashby (ATS). Agencies must have a valid services agreement executed and must have been assigned by the Talent team to a specific requisition. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security. In the event a candidate submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment will be paid.

title: Senior ERP Specialist
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior ERP Specialist to lead the integration of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (F&O) across the company and build the ERP team. You will own the target process design, the implementation roadmap and the integration with production, procurement and finance, and you will build the ERP function as we scale from pilot plant to series production.

This is a broad, high-ownership role. The ERP is the backbone that connects orders, materials, production and money. You will decide how that backbone is built, and you will be accountable for it working on day one of series production.

About us

We're a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are building our first production facility in Steyerberg, Lower Saxony, and are applying our knowledge toward serial production of solid rocket motors.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you're excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you're ready to rise to the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the implementation of Dynamics 365 F&O across finance, procurement, inventory, production control, sales and project accounting.

  • Own the target process design (to-be) and run process workshops with finance, operations, engineering, quality and supply chain.

  • Define the integration architecture between Dynamics 365 F&O, the MES/PLC layer, and third-party systems (e.g., Power BI, CRM, banking, tax).

  • Lead data migration and master data design: items, bills of materials, routings, batches, suppliers and customers.

  • Define configuration, security role and authorization concepts, and the internal control requirements of the company.

  • Manage the ERP project team, implementation partners, budget and timeline.

  • Establish governance for change control, release management, testing and user training.

  • Ensure the ERP meets regulatory requirements for regulated energetic materials: batch and lot traceability, stock of hazardous materials, and the records required under German explosives law.

What we are looking for

  • Several years of experience leading ERP implementations or large process changes, ideally with Dynamics 365 F&O (or Dynamics AX).

  • Functional expertise in at least two of the following: production control, procurement, inventory and warehouse management, finance (GL, AP, AR), project accounting.

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end manufacturing processes (order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, plan-to-produce, record-to-report).

  • Experience with integration architectures (APIs, middleware, data management) and with shop-floor or manufacturing execution systems.

  • The ability to lead cross-functional teams and to communicate with executives and external partners.

  • A degree in business informatics, industrial engineering, business administration, computer science or a related discipline; equivalent experience may also be relevant.

Desirable experience

  • Dynamics 365 F&O certification or a Microsoft functional or solution architect certification.

  • X++ development, Data Management Framework, Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Service Bus) or Power Platform.

  • Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment (chemicals, pharmaceuticals, aerospace or defence).

  • Knowledge of German commercial and tax requirements (HGB, GoBD) and e-invoicing.

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment where processes are built from scratch.

  • Working proficiency in German.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

title: Senior Field Enablement Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Team

Our GTM Enablement team plays a critical role in helping Datadog's Sales and Customer Success teams succeed by equipping them with the right skills, knowledge, and tools at the right time. We partner closely with teams across Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Curriculum, and Operations to ensure enablement programs translate into real performance in the field.

If you like adding value and seeing the direct impact of your work, and you thrive in dynamic environments where you can roll up your sleeves and get things done, this role is for you.

The Opportunity

Datadog's Enterprise business across EMEA continues to scale, and we're looking for a Field Enablement Manager to deliver ongoing ramp and everboarding enablement for Enterprise sellers across key EMEA markets (including the UK, DACH, France, Benelux, and the Nordics) — ensuring global enablement programs land effectively amid complex, multi-country Enterprise deals.

You'll serve as a trusted partner to Enterprise Sales leaders, adapting global programs to the realities of the EMEA Enterprise motion — longer sales cycles, multi-stakeholder buying committees, and a diverse regional footprint — while staying tightly aligned with our global Field Enablement organization.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives operating independently, builds strong relationships in the field, and enjoys adapting enablement programs to meet the needs of a fast-growing, sophisticated Enterprise segment.

What You'll Do

  • Deliver live and virtual enablement sessions and implement training programs focused on ongoing ramp and everboarding that improve the performance and productivity of Enterprise sellers and leaders across EMEA.
  • Administer program certifications — score and evaluate submissions against established rubrics and provide structured feedback.
  • Conduct ongoing field listening (shadows, 1:1s, syncs with first-line leaders) to maintain a strong pulse on Enterprise business needs, gaps, and strengths across EMEA markets; share insights with the broader enablement team to shape programs and priorities.
  • Lead reinforcement and coaching to drive post-program adoption, including designing activities (role plays, deal clinics, skill practice sessions) that connect training to measurable behavior change in real, complex customer scenarios.
  • Partner with Curriculum, Program Management, and Operations to share field insights and pilot or co-build content, and work closely with first-line Enterprise Sales leaders to build trusted relationships, diagnose challenges, and deliver ad hoc training in response to emerging needs.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate delivery and reinforcement — including synthesizing field feedback and surfacing patterns — and model effective AI use for the teams you train.

Who You Are

  • 4–5 years of experience in sales enablement, field enablement, training, or a related GTM role, with a proven delivery track record supporting Enterprise Sales and/or Customer Success teams in a SaaS or technology environment; multi-country EMEA experience is a strong plus.
  • Strong understanding of Datadog and/or the broader technology industry, including foundational knowledge of Datadog's core product pillars (Infrastructure, APM, Logs) and the ability to connect product capabilities to Enterprise customer value.
  • Strong facilitator with experience delivering engaging live and virtual training sessions to senior, sophisticated audiences, and familiarity with Enterprise sales methodologies/frameworks such as MEDDICC, Command of the Message, Challenger, Sandler, etc. (certification a plus).
  • Solid business acumen and comfort using performance data, field feedback, and qualitative insights to inform enablement decisions; experience with Asana or similar project management tools is a plus.
  • Highly collaborative and relationship-oriented — you build trust quickly with sellers, managers, and cross-functional partners.
  • Organized, adaptable, and comfortable operating independently across a large, diverse region.
  • Fluent in English, with proficiency in one or more additional European languages a plus; willing and able to travel approximately 25% across EMEA.

Why This Role Matters

As a Field Enablement Manager supporting Datadog's EMEA Enterprise business, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring our global enablement programs translate into local impact for some of our most strategic sellers and customers. You'll help accelerate ramp, build seller confidence, and enable Enterprise teams to succeed with customers across one of Datadog's fastest-growing and most complex regions.

About Datadog: 

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

title: (Senior) Forward Deployed Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Empower every employee.

AI has changed how office workers get things done. For the 80% of the global workforce that doesn't sit at a desk, it has barely arrived. Flip AI is changing that.

Flip AI is the #1 Frontline Agentic Operating System (OS) to build, automate and orchestrate any frontline use case on a foundation of secure identity and comms with strong UX. In practice, that means one app where frontline workers in retail, manufacturing and logistics access their systems, run their processes, and use AI.

More than 1,000 brands trust Flip AI, and over two million people use it worldwide, at companies like Bosch, REWE, FORVIA HELLA and Greif. In August 2026, Notion Capital and HV Capital doubled down with a new $25M round, bringing our total funding to more than $85M.

Our mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.

Job Description

As a Customer Engineer you sit on the edge of the product, inside the customer's environment: their identity stack, their HR systems, their security review, their AI roadmap. You take a tenant from nothing from nothing to hundreds of thousands of live users and you decide how the technical side gets solved, sometimes by designing the integration and enabling the customer's IT to build it, sometimes by building the first version yourself and handing it over. That includes where our AI goes live: agents in the frontline app, tool access over MCP, and the authentication questions underneath them that nobody has solved yet.

What you can expect

  • Technical ownership end to end: You own the technical side of enterprise onboardings, from the first architecture conversation to a stable live rollout at scale.

  • Integrations that make Flip AI load-bearing: You design and land identity and authentication (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), user provisioning (SCIM), REST APIs and connections into HR and ops systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG.

  • Advise and enable instead of absorb: You bring the customer's IT, their partners and our external development partners to a solution you would sign off on, and you make sure they can run it without you.

  • Build where building unblocks: Where building is the fastest way to prove an approach or to unblock a rollout, you build the first version and then hand it over cleanly, with the documentation and the handover conversation that make it stick.

  • AI where it meets the customer: You lead how agents, MCP-based tool access and agent-to-agent scenarios land at enterprise customers, including the auth and data boundaries that have to hold around them.

  • Technical authority in the account: You work with customer project management, IT, security, functional departments and works councils, you decide the technical questions, and you feed the gaps you see back into our product and engineering teams. Expect regular travel to customer sites, roughly 10 to 30 percent of your time.

What you bring to the table

Must-haves

  • Around 3 to 5 (or more) years in IT or tech consulting, customer engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering or SaaS implementation, with real enterprise exposure.

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise integration and identity: SSO and authentication (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID or comparable), REST APIs and API-based integrations delivered inside real enterprise IT environments.

  • Customer-facing technical responsibility in enterprise projects, where you made the technical calls together with IT, security and functional departments rather than only coordinating them.

  • Genuine technical depth without being a full-time production developer: you read code, review a design, debug an integration and build a working prototype.

  • German at C1 level or above and fluent English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Provisioning experience (SCIM) and integrations into HR or workforce systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG.

  • An informed, current view on where agentic AI is heading: MCP, A2A, EMA and the authentication questions underneath them. We are looking for someone who follows the field closely and has an opinion, not for years of experience that cannot exist yet.

  • Prior work as a Customer Engineer or Forward Deployed Engineer at a product company, rather than in classic consulting only.

  • Workflow automation tooling (n8n or similar), comfort with logs, metrics and dashboards, or experience with German co-determination and enterprise data protection.

What we offer you

  • Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices - always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview.

  • Work-Life-Balance: We don't want you to grow roots to your desk chair. That's why we cover the costs of your E-Gym-Wellpass membership and offer job bike leasing.

  • Celebrating success: Expect highly motivated and committed people in a relaxed working atmosphere.

  • Be part of something bigger: You actively shape Flip AI in your role. Along the way, you are an enabler of the rapid growth process of a young tech company and grow towards your goals, fun is guaranteed.

  • Happy to be a Flipster: Stay tuned for regular team events and culture days that bring us together as Flipsters.

  • Working abroad: At Flip AI you can also work abroad in the European Union. Let's talk about remote work in the interview.

At Flip AI, everyone is welcome - no matter what gender you identify as or how old you are. Sexual identity, origin, religion, world view and disabilities do not influence your potential job at Flip AI. The most important thing is that YOU fit in!

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Credit Cards
descriptionHtml:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Credit Cards

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer.

You’ll build features on iwoca’s business credit card and own each one from the first line of code to the moment a customer makes their first spend.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

iwoca launched its business credit card in 2026. It gives small businesses a fast, flexible way to pay for what they need and control their cash flow, alongside iwoca’s loans. The card is a core part of iwoca’s long-term growth.

The Credit Cards team builds what business owners use to sign up, get their card, and manage it, on the web and in the iwoca Mobile App. It’s cross-functional – engineers collaborate with product and design.

The role

As a senior full-stack engineer, you’ll work mostly on the backend, and build the frontend for your features too.

  • Ownership. You’ll shape what the team builds next, starting from what customers need. You’ll decide how each of your features works, from the data model and API to how you test, release, and monitor it.

  • Impact. Business owners use your work every time they check their cashback, set spend controls, or freeze a lost card. The team releases often, and your changes reach them quickly.

  • Variation. You’ll write Python and FastAPI services backed by PostgreSQL, and React and TypeScript for the web. You’ll also work in React Native on the iwoca Mobile App, and on the Credit Cards CRM that operations staff use, when a feature needs it.

  • Card expertise. You’ll learn how card transactions work – from the card processor to the card scheme – alongside the engineers who build iwoca’s payments platform.

  • AI-first engineering. You’ll build with AI coding tools as standard. On the iwoca Mobile App, for example, the team writes a spec for each feature and reviews it before building it with Claude Code.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Backend engineering. You've built well-tested Python services for customer-facing products, and kept them working once people relied on them.

  • Data models and APIs. You've designed relational data models, ideally in PostgreSQL, and built and integrated APIs.

  • Frontend. You've written enough React and TypeScript to build and ship customer-facing features.

  • Product ownership. You've taken features from an idea to production and owned them once they were live. You've challenged a plan when it didn't meet a customer need, and offered a better one.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone, at work or in your own projects. You judge when to use it and when not to, and you check its output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Mobile. You've developed iOS or Android app features, ideally in React Native.

  • Fintech. You've worked on financial products, especially card payments.

  • FastAPI. You've built and run production services with FastAPI.

  • Internal tools. You've written software for operations or support staff.

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £90,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

title: Senior Integrated Media Director
descriptionHtml:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

The Integrated Media Senior Director is a senior leadership role accountable for the effective delivery, performance, and integration of all paid media activities across an assigned account or portfolio of accounts. Acting as the operational and strategic lead for media investment, this role ensures that media budgets are planned, deployed, optimized, and measured effectively to drive client growth and business outcomes.

The Integrated Media Senior Director oversees the full spectrum of paid media activity, including Search, Social, Programmatic, Direct Buys, Retail Media, Retail Operations, Media Strategy, and Investment Analytics. The role is responsible for ensuring strategic alignment, investment effectiveness, operational excellence, and cross-channel collaboration across the client portfolio.

While channel specialists remain directly managed within their respective functions, they maintain a dotted-line relationship with the Integrated Media Senior Director to support client-centric accountability and integrated media delivery.

 

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Governance

  • Serve as the primary point of accountability for paid media delivery and performance across assigned accounts.

  • Translate client business objectives into integrated, cross-channel media strategies.

  • Establish clear performance goals, KPIs, and measurement frameworks to evaluate media effectiveness.

  • Drive operational excellence through consistent implementation of processes, infrastructure, workflows, pacing disciplines, and optimization routines.

  • Ensure alignment and coordination across all paid media functions to deliver a seamless client experience.

Strategic Investment & Planning

  • Partner with Strategy teams to define roles, responsibilities, and planning approaches based on client needs and organizational structure.

  • Lead cross-channel media planning and investment allocation to maximize business outcomes.

  • Collaborate with Client Teams to identify optimization opportunities and innovative media solutions.

  • Oversee forecasting, budget pacing, and performance reporting across assigned accounts.

  • Partner with Investment Analytics to improve the adoption and effectiveness of reporting and pacing solutions.

  • Champion the use of data, automation, and platform capabilities to maximize return on investment and efficiency.

Cross-Functional Integration

  • Foster collaboration and alignment across all relevant media and client-facing teams.

  • Partner with Channel Leads to ensure best practices, standards, and operational consistency are implemented across accounts.

  • Facilitate cross-channel planning, learning, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

  • Promote continuous capability development and client education on media investment and performance.

Client & Partner Leadership

  • Act as a senior client contact for media investment, planning, and performance discussions.

  • Build trusted relationships with clients and key partners.

  • Translate complex media performance data into actionable business recommendations.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve media effectiveness and client outcomes.

 

Success Measures

The success of the Integrated Media Senior Director will be evaluated against the following key performance indicators:

Performance Efficiency

  • Achieve or exceed client spend and performance targets.

  • Ensure budget pacing and optimization activities align with client objectives and agreed benchmarks.

  • Measured through quarterly and annual business reviews.

Client Satisfaction & Retention

  • Achieve a client Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 9 or higher within the first year.

  • Drive proactive performance insights and continuous improvement in client communications.

  • Assessed through semi-annual client feedback and satisfaction surveys.

Operational Excellence

  • Deliver media plans, forecasts, and pacing reports accurately and on schedule.

  • Maintain greater than 95% accuracy in forecasting and less than 2% variance against agreed projections.

  • Evaluated through monthly performance and delivery reviews.

Team Alignment & Capability Development

  • Facilitate quarterly cross-channel planning and learning sessions.

  • Lead monthly performance review discussions with relevant stakeholders.

  • Measured through participation levels, stakeholder feedback, and business impact.

Innovation & Growth Contribution

  • Develop and implement innovation initiatives, automation solutions, or process improvements that enhance client results or team efficiency.

  • Demonstrate measurable business impact within 12 months.

  • Reviewed as part of annual performance and goal-setting processes.

Reporting Structure

Reports To: Integrated Media VP

Direct-Line Relationships:

  • Search Directors

  • Social Directors

  • Programmatic Directors

  • Retail Media Directors

Key Stakeholders & Partnerships:

  • Client Leadership Teams

  • Strategy Teams

  • Project Management

  • Investment Analytics

  • Partnership Teams

  • Channel Leadership Teams

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

📈 Growth, Your Way: Accumulate one paid day each month (2 hours per week) for self-development and access to Jellyfish Learn.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work.

title: Senior Inventory Operations Manager, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role overview:

The Senior Inventory Operations Manager, EMEA will be responsible for leading inventory control, reconciliation, and governance activities across SIE’s B2B and D2C (PlayStation Direct - PSD) distribution centre operations in the EMEA region. 

This role will ensure inventory accuracy, system integrity, audit readiness, and operational control across warehouse and SAP processes, with a strong focus on service excellence, root cause resolution, and continuous improvement. 

Working closely with Warehouse Operations, Planning, Sales, PlayStation Direct (PSD), Finance Governance, Supply Chain, and external warehouse partners, this role will act as the key escalation point for inventory management matters across the region. 

What you’ll be doing: 

  • Lead daily, weekly, and monthly inventory reconciliation across B2B and D2C (PSD) operational locations, working with warehouse partners to identify root causes, resolve discrepancies, and drive continuous improvement. 
  • Compile and review inventory comparisons across systems, partnering with Planning, Sales, and PSD teams to resolve systematic inventory issues. 
  • Investigate and process daily iDoc errors, ensuring inventory transactions are corrected accurately and in a timely manner. 
  • Own end-of-month system-to-system reconciliation activity, ensuring balances are audited, validated, and clearly explained. 
  • Coordinate monthly physical counts across B2B and PSD operations, ensuring count processes are controlled, documented, and aligned to business requirements. 
  • Partner with the SIE Finance Governance team to support audit coordination, evidence gathering, inventory controls, and compliance activity. 
  • Coordinate end-of-year wall-to-wall inventory counts with Warehouse Operations and relevant internal stakeholders. 
  • Act as the primary point of contact for inventory management escalations, ensuring issues are managed with urgency and clear communication. 
  • Validate warehouse cycle count adjustments and route approvals internally in line with SIE’s Table of Authority. 

Key areas of focus: 

Inventory Control & Reconciliation 

  • Maintain strong inventory accuracy across B2B and D2C operations. 
  • Oversee daily, monthly, and year-end reconciliation routines. 
  • Investigate variances between warehouse systems, SAP, and operational records. 
  • Ensure corrective actions are tracked, owned, and completed. 

Warehouse & Systems Governance 

  • Work closely with warehouse partners to ensure inventory processes are followed consistently. 
  • Manage iDoc exceptions, SAP inventory transactions, and EDI-related issue resolution. 
  • Ensure system data is accurate, timely, and aligned across operational platforms. 
  • Support improvements to inventory processes, controls, and reporting. 

Audit, Compliance & Controls 

  • Partner with Finance Governance on inventory audits and control reviews. 
  • Coordinate physical counts, cycle counts, and year-end inventory activities. 
  • Ensure inventory adjustments are reviewed and approved in line with governance requirements. 
  • Maintain clear documentation and evidence for audit and compliance purposes. 

Continuous Improvement 

  • Identify recurring inventory issues and lead root cause analysis. 
  • Develop improvement actions with Warehouse Operations, Planning, Sales, and PSD teams. 
  • Support process standardisation across B2B and D2C inventory operations. 
  • Use data and operational insight to improve accuracy, reduce defects, and strengthen service performance. 

What we’re looking for: 

  • 8+ years’ experience in Inventory Management, Inventory Control, Planning, Supply Chain Operations, or a related field. 
  • Strong experience working with warehouse inventory processes, reconciliation, cycle counts, physical counts, and audit controls. 
  • Strong SAP experience, with knowledge of iDocs and EDI transactions preferred. 
  • Good understanding of B2B and D2C distribution centre operations. 
  • Strong Excel capability, ideally at medium to advanced level. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and drive practical solutions. 
  • Experience working with Finance, Planning, Sales, Warehouse Operations, and external 3PL partners. 
  • Process improvement or Lean experience preferred. 
  • BA/BS in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Operations, or equivalent experience preferred. 
  • APICS, Inventory Control, Quality Management Systems, or Project Management certification desirable. 

Benefits:

  • Discretionary bonus opportunity
  • Hybrid Working 
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Dental Scheme
  • 25 days holiday per year
  • On Site Gym
  • Subsidised Café
  • Free soft drinks
  • On site bar
  • Access to cycle garage and showers

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice (where applicable) for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.

Du entwickelst Integrationen zwischen der Power Platform und Dynamics 365 (CRM/ERP) sowie anderen Backend-Systemen, arbeitest mit REST-APIs, OData, virtuellen Entities, Custom Connectors und Azure Web APIs und sorgst dafür, dass Daten sicher, performant und zuverlässig fließen. Du konzipierst Integrationsarchitekturen, entwirfst Datenflüsse und stellst sicher, dass Power Platform und Dynamics nahtlos zusammenarbeiten.
  • Governance, Landing Zones & ALM
    Du hilfst Kunden dabei, eine stabile und zukunftsfähige Power-Platform-Umgebung aufzubauen. Dazu gehört das Ausarbeiten von Governance-Konzepten, die Planung und Umsetzung von Landing Zones, die Strukturierung von Environments sowie die Definition von Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards. Gleichzeitig treibst du strukturiertes Application Lifecycle Management voran, baust durchdachte Solution-Strukturen auf und nutzt DevOps-Pipelines, um Entwicklungs- und Deploymentprozesse zu professionalisieren.
  • Geschäftsprozessanalyse & Lösungsdesign
    Du analysierst Kundenprozesse, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und entwickelst daraus skalierbare technische Designs. Im engen Austausch mit Stakeholdern übersetzt du fachliche Anforderungen in saubere Datenmodelle, Logiken, Automatisierungen und Integrationsarchitekturen. Dabei kombinierst du Low-Code- und Pro-Code-Ansätze so, dass Lösungen nachhaltig wartbar und technisch fundiert sind.
  • Datenmanagement, virtuelle Entities & Dataflows
    Du arbeitest mit relationalen Datenbanken, entwirfst Datenmodelle und entwickelst Datenarchitekturen, die optimal zu den Geschäftsanforderungen passen. Du bindest externe Systeme über virtuelle Entities an, nutzt Dataflows und Power Query für ETL-Prozesse und sorgst für konsistente und saubere Datenstrukturen innerhalb von Dataverse. Die Kombination aus Datenmodellierung, technischer Integration und Plattformwissen ermöglicht dir, komplexe Datenlandschaften ganzheitlich zu gestalten.
  • Workshops & Enablement
    Du führst Workshops durch, schulst Fachbereiche und ermöglichst Kundenteams, die Power Platform kompetent und sicher einzusetzen. Dabei vermittelst du Best Practices, erklärst Lösungsansätze verständlich und baust eine langfristige Kompetenz bei den Nutzern auf.

Qualifikationen

  • Power-Platform-Erfahrung (≥ 2 Jahre)
    Du entwickelst professionelle Model-Driven Apps, modellierst Dataverse-Strukturen, setzt Geschäftslogiken mit Power Automate um, arbeitest mit Power Pages und nutzt Custom Connectors, AI Builder und erste Funktionen aus Copilot Studio. ALM und Solution-Management sind dir vertraut.

    Du hast Power-Platform-Lösungen idealerweise an Dynamics 365 oder andere Enterprise-Systeme angebunden, arbeitest sicher mit REST-/OData-APIs, virtuellen Entities und Dataflows und entwickelst stabile Integrationen. Erfahrung mit Azure Web APIs, Functions oder Logic Apps ist ein Plus.
  • Starke Datenbank- & Datenmodellierungskenntnisse

    Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie die Motivation, dich in Themen wie Dynamics 365, Power Platform, AI & Copilot weiterzuentwickeln.

Vorteile & über HSO

  • Self Determination: Bei uns steht die Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe im Mittelpunkt - mit deinen Ideen und Erfahrungen kannst du dich bei uns einbringen, eigenständig agieren und damit den Unternehmenserfolg aktiv mitgestalten
  • Team Spirit: Da Menschen bei HSO den Unterschied machen, kannst du dich auf eine unterstützende, vertrauensvolle und wertschätzende Arbeitsatmosphäre freuen
  • Learning & Growth: Wir werden dich mit Trainingsangeboten durch unsere hauseigene HSO Academy und externe Schulungspartner in Kombination mit einem individuellen Karrierepfad fördern
  • Onboarding@HSO: Wir heißen dich in unserem Office in Böblingen willkommen - du startest deine ersten Onboarding-Tage bei uns vor Ort, um dich mit unserer Unternehmenskultur, unseren Prozessen und Tools vertraut zu machen
  • Hybrid Workforce:  Ohne festgeschriebene Kernarbeitszeit hast du die Möglichkeit flexibel bei Kunden vor Ort, aus deinem Homeoffice oder in unseren Offices in Böblingen, München, Nürnberg oder Chemnitz zu arbeiten
  • Appreciation: Ein attraktives Gehaltsmodell inklusive 20 % Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiterangebote, Bikeleasing, Gesundheitsförderung durch EGYM Wellpass, Geburtstagsgutscheine und außergewöhnliche Events runden dein HSO-Feel-Good-Paket ab
  • Workation:  Wir möchten unseren Mitarbeitenden mehr Flexibilität und Freiräume bieten, damit sie ihre Work-Life-Balance aktiv gestalten können. Daher hast du die Möglichkeit, bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr unter Einhaltung der rechtlichen Bedingungen aus der EU, dem EWR und der Schweiz zu arbeiten.

title: Senior Key Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense. Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale.

Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…).

Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous renforçons l'équipe Sales de Vertical Expense. Tu y prendras en charge le développement de grands comptes publics et privés, sur des ventes complexes à forts enjeux.

Tu auras pour mission de :

  • Piloter le cycle de vente de bout en bout : qualification des opportunités, proposition de valeur différenciante, accès aux décideurs, négociation et closing.

  • Développer de nouvelles opportunités par une prospection ciblée, en complément des leads apportés par le Marketing et par nos équipes Alliances & Channel.

  • Analyser les besoins de tes prospects et présenter la solution, avec l'appui de l'avant-vente sur les projets complexes.

  • Rédiger les réponses aux appels d'offres publics et privés (dont le mémoire technique), en t'appuyant sur les équipes internes.

  • Assurer une passation fluide vers les équipes projets et CSM, et suivre les projets en appui après la signature.

  • Participer aux réflexions stratégiques : veille concurrentielle, tendances du marché, différenciateurs produit.


Ce qu'on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu as une expérience significative et récente en vente complexe SaaS B2B auprès de grands comptes.

  • Tu as déjà mené des cycles de vente longs, dans des organisations multi-décideurs, en travaillant avec des partenaires et des influenceurs.

  • Tu as un vrai goût pour la chasse : aller chercher de nouveaux clients te motive.

  • Tu es à l'aise face à des interlocuteurs C-level et tu sais adapter ton discours à chacun (idéalement DAF, DRH, Travel Manager, DSI…).

  • Tu sais répondre à un appel d'offres avec rigueur, de la réponse au mémoire technique.

  • Tu comprends les solutions SaaS, web et mobiles.

  • Tu es autonome, organisé(e) et tenace, et tu sais rebondir face à un deal perdu.

  • Tu aimes travailler en équipe avec le Marketing, l’équipe Alliance/Channel, les équipes projets et le Produit.

  • Tu es à l'aise avec des déplacements réguliers chez les clients (environ une fois par semaine).

C'est un plus si :

  • Tu connais l'univers des notes de frais ou du voyage d'affaires.

  • Tu parles anglais.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Un poste stratégique, au cœur de notre développement sur les grands comptes publics et privés.

  • Pas que de la prospection à froid : une partie des leads vient du Marketing et de nos partenaires.

  • Une vision complète du cycle de vente, jusqu'au suivi du projet client.

  • Une équipe stable, fière de ses grands comptes, avec le sens du service et de l'excellence.

  • Une ambiance où l'on ne se prend pas au sérieux : team building réguliers…

Processus de recrutement :

  • Entretien téléphonique RH.

  • Entretien avec le manager.

  • Mise en situation : étude de cas sur un compte client fictif.

  • Entretien final avec la Direction.

Localisation : Montagnat (01), avec 2 jours par semaine sur site et des déplacements ponctuels à Aix-en-Provence.

Rémunération : fixe : 60K € - 80K€ + variable

title: Senior MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a talented Senior MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer to help us in our mission by taking technical ownership of the electrical test equipment and automated functional tests required to verify our spacecraft, engineering models and test beds, to ensure that our mission will succeed and our system will work in space!

Key Responsibilities

In your role as a Senior MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer, your role will include the following responsibilities:

  • Take technical ownership of electrical test equipment and functional-test capability for flight hardware, engineering models and test beds, from early definition through delivery, use and maintenance

  • Establish and maintain a practical development and readiness plan so that test equipment and software are available for early engineering-model testing and subsequent flight-hardware testing

  • Define and assess electrical test-equipment and functional-test needs, making requirements, interfaces, safety constraints, risks and dependencies visible and driving their resolution

  • Translate system and subsystem requirements into complete, traceable functional-test strategies, procedures, sequences and objective pass/fail criteria

  • Lead the electrical design, integration, build, troubleshooting and maintenance of test equipment and its software, including power, signal, communication and measurement interfaces

  • Develop and review automated functional-test software, data acquisition and test sequences in LabVIEW and/or VeriStand, with clear interlocks, limit checks, safe-stop behaviour and maintainable test records

  • Define and review test-equipment architecture, instrumentation, cabling, schematics, interface definitions, configuration and verification evidence

  • Plan and support test readiness reviews, ensuring that hardware, test equipment, software, procedures, safety controls and acceptance criteria are fit for use before testing begins

  • Support and perform unit-, subsystem- and system-level electrical and functional tests on engineering and flight hardware, including hands-on test preparation and execution

  • Lead technical investigation of test anomalies, assess test data, distinguish unit-under-test issues from test-system issues, and support non-conformance disposition, retest and closure

  • Coordinate electrical test activities and technical interfaces with MAIT, design, systems, software, quality and other relevant teams

  • Provide technical guidance and review to other engineers and technicians, sharing good practice in test design, execution, troubleshooting and evidence capture

  • Manufacture and assemble test-equipment components where required

  • Participate in environmental tests and launch campaigns.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of Senior MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer, ideally you will bring the following skillset, mentality and experience:

  • Degree in aerospace engineering, electrical engineering or comparable qualification

  • Significant hands-on experience with electrical/electronic components and systems, ideally in spacecraft AIT or functional verification

  • Demonstrated ability to independently plan and deliver electrical or functional tests for complex hardware, from requirements and interfaces through test execution and evidence review

  • Strong practical experience developing functional tests from requirements, including test strategy, procedures, acceptance criteria, traceability and test-data review

  • Theoretical understanding as well as practical experience with electrical test equipment and test interfaces:

    • Electrical design and integration of test equipment, including instrumentation, cabling, connectors, and power and signal interfaces

    • Physical assembly and commissioning of test equipment (building racks, routing cables, etc.)

    • Familiarity with network configuration and network protocols (TCP/IP) used by test systems

  • Ability to develop and review software for test equipment and automated functional tests in LabVIEW and/or VeriStand; experience with Python or similar is an asset

  • Experience with data acquisition, test automation, measurement-chain verification and systematic troubleshooting on electrical test equipment

  • Experience preparing hardware and test systems for controlled testing, including safety controls, configuration management and objective test records

  • Ability to lead technical anomaly investigations, communicate uncertainty and risk, and agree evidence-based retest or closure actions

  • Experience providing technical guidance, reviewing work or sharing good practice with colleagues

  • Exposure to Mission Control Software platforms like CCS5, COSMOS or similar; experience with COSMOS is a plus

  • Experience with communication and power test equipment is an asset

  • Ability to read, understand and apply technical manuals, data reports, electrical schematics and design specifications

  • Willingness to work hands-on with flight hardware

  • Joy in embracing technical problems and the process of solving them

  • Sense of responsibility and a clean and organized way of working

  • Fuent in written and spoken English

  • Willingness to travel worldwide for test and launch campaigns.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.
