title: Senior Marketing Manager, Channel Sales
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Not every seller comes to Square directly. A growing number reach us through resellers who sell Square on our behalf, and through independent contractors who represent Square in their own communities. Together these two motions make up our channel sales function.

As Senior Marketing Manager, Channel Sales, you will own marketing for both motions worldwide. You will be the primary marketing point of contact for the global channel sales team, turning what they need into programmes that scale. Most of your time will go into building scalable solutions that equip every reseller and contractor to sell Square well. The rest will be spent working shoulder to shoulder with our highest-performing resellers on activity that grows both their business and ours.

You will partner closely with channel sales leadership, events, content and regional marketing teams.

You Will

  • Serve as the marketing point of contact for the global channel sales team, triaging incoming requests, prioritising them and shaping them into a coherent programme of work.
  • Build and run a scaled co-marketing hub that gives resellers and independent contractors the campaigns, content and guidance they need to sell Square in their own markets.
  • Partner directly with our top-performing resellers on demand generation campaigns that grow and convert their pipeline.
  • Equip both motions to sell effectively, including through content and events.
  • Work with our independent contractor and reseller network to extend Square's brand presence and build awareness / credibility in the communities they serve.
  • Review incentive programmes that reward the strongest-performing resellers and contractors, partnering with the cross-functional teams who deliver different components of the programme to ensure and report back on success against objectives.
  • Define how co-marketing funds work for this channel, setting out how funds are allocated, spent and measured.
  • Work with sales to define an effective recruitment programme for resellers and independent contractors.
  • Build a valued community that our resellers and independent contractors are proud to be a part of.
  • Measure and report on programme performance.

You Have

  • 8+ years of relevant marketing experience.
  • Direct experience marketing through a channel, reseller, distributor or independent sales model.
  • A strong background in B2B marketing, ideally within technology companies.
  • Experience building enablement and co-marketing programmes that partners adopt and use at scale.
  • Proven ability to own programmes end to end, from design through to execution and measurement.
  • Experience designing incentive or reward programmes in partnership with a sales team.
  • Experience working across international markets and with globally distributed teams.
  • Strong stakeholder, communication and project management skills.

Application Guidelines

Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. 

Contact us here with hiring practice or data usage questions.

Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want. Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering. Check out our other benefits at Block.

Block, Inc. (NYSE: XYZ) builds technology to increase access to the global economy. Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mechanical Engineer at Black Semiconductor to lead the mechanical design, upgrading, and installation of facility plants and mechanical systems.

The role covers critical facility infrastructure, including chillers and heat pumps, compressors, Make-up Air Handling Units (MAHUs), HVAC systems, exhaust systems, water distribution systems, and steam generators.

You will coordinate engineering companies, vendors, and suppliers to ensure the successful execution of mechanical engineering activities and contribute to the continuous improvement of facility plants and systems.

To join our team, you should be excited to

  • Lead the mechanical design, upgrading, and installation of facility plants and mechanical systems.

  • Coordinate engineering companies, vendors, and suppliers throughout design, upgrading, and installation activities.

  • Prepare and upgrade plant procedures, control plans, and Out-of-Control Action Plans (OCAPs).

  • Lead the preparation, modification, and improvement of FMEAs.

  • Lead root cause analysis investigations and prepare reports using methodologies such as 8D, Fishbone diagrams, and 5 Whys.

  • Drive problem-solving activities and improvements related to mechanical plants and systems.

  • Act as an expert in mechanical engineering and be recognized as a technical reference within the organization.

Your Qualifications

  • 7–10 years of experience in Mechanical Engineering within structured companies, working with significant and critical HVAC systems.

  • Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, cleanroom HVAC systems, chillers, boilers, heat pumps, Make-up Air Handling Units (MAHUs), gas and liquid flow and pressure, mechanical plants, and exhaust systems.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to calculate pipe dimensions and mechanical plant capacities.

  • Fluent communication skills in English and German.

  • Basic knowledge of AutoCAD.

  • Demonstrated experience in cleanroom HVAC systems and complex mechanical plants.

  • Proficiency in reading and preparing technical schematics, engineering calculations, and blueprints.

  • Understanding of BMS (Building Management Systems) software.

  • Experience in FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) and resilience-oriented mechanical system design, ensuring reliability and robustness of critical facility infrastructure.

      

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

title: Senior Product Analyst  (M/F/X)
descriptionHtml:
Join a French Foodtech Superstar!

At HelloFresh, we're shaking up the way people eat in France with our meal kits!

Our ambition? To revolutionise our subscribers' everyday lives by promoting a more sustainable way of cooking and introducing them to delicious, creative and balanced recipes. The perfect blend of technology and gastronomy, with plenty of flavour!

HelloFresh operates in more than 15 countries. France is one of our youngest markets, launched in 2019, where we've experienced tremendous growth, establishing ourselves as the market leader. Joining our team means having a real impact within one of France's most promising scale-ups!

How do we make all this happen? Through a talented and dynamic team, strong values rooted in kindness and diversity, and an inspiring, stimulating work environment.

If you'd like to be part of this exciting human, international and entrepreneurial adventure, come and join us!

The Role : What’s in the Box

The France Marketing & Product Analytics team is a small team at the core of HelloFresh France's performance management. It measures marketing and product performance, keeps the underlying data reliable, and supports the Growth and Product teams with analyses that guide daily and long-term decisions. ROI and customer lifetime value (CLV) sit at the center of marketing decisions.

The team works closely with Marketing, Product, Finance, Operations and Global Analytics (Berlin).

The Senior Product Analyst divides their time equally between Product and Marketing. On the product side, they are the analytical reference for product decisions in France, working with the Culinary, Menu Planning and Strategy & Product Development (SPD) teams. On the marketing side, they shape growth strategy with data, weighing investment allocation and acquisition versus retention trade-offs, and explaining what drives marketing performance.

Cross-cutting responsibility: design and maintain internal analytical tools (scripts, dashboards, automations) that support the Culinary, Menu Planning, SPD and marketing workflows, and sponsor agentic analytics and AI tools across both areas.

What You'll Do : The Recipe

Product responsibilities (50%)

  • Product performance reporting: present regular summaries on menu performance, recipe adoption and assortment rotation to feed management reviews, with key KPIs defined and tracked.
  • Customer analytics through a product lens: analyze menu and recipe performance together with customer behavior and preferences (satisfaction, repurchase, retention by menu or recipe choice) to inform assortment decisions, and identify high-impact opportunities to feed the product strategy.
  • Strategic projects: lead the analytical and operational side of strategic projects that improve the product.

Marketing responsibilities (50%)

  • Strategic analyses: collaborate closely with our CMO and marketing leadership to drive strategic decisions (analyses on growth strategy, investment allocation and acquisition versus retention trade-offs).
  • Top line performance deep dives: investigate the root causes behind changes in marketing performance, and explain them from a customer and purchase behavior perspective (customer segmentation, discount applied, box taken, purchase behavior over time).
  • Management summaries: turn these deep dives into concise, top-level insights for management review.

What You'll Bring

  • You have graduated from a top-tier engineering or business school, or hold a university degree in Data, Statistics or a related field.
  • You have at least 4 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence or data science, ideally in an e-commerce, FMCG or food-tech environment.
  • You have advanced SQL skills; Python is a plus.
  • You have experience with BI tools (Tableau preferred) and excellent command of Google Sheets.
  • You have experience using AI/ML tools for exploratory analysis (e.g. anomaly detection), as well as leveraging LLMs to boost analytical productivity.
  • You can turn complex analyses into clear, concise and actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
  • You are organised, rigorous and detail-oriented, with the ability to prioritise multiple topics while giving each the attention it deserves.
  • You are proactive: you know how to ask the right questions, not just find the answers.
  • You are fluent in French and have a good command of English, both spoken and written.
  • Bonus: You have a genuine passion for food and an interest in culinary or FMCG-related topics.

What we offer

  • A dynamic and international environment, with a strong corporate culture and DNA
  • Delicious discounts on HelloFresh meal kits
  • A steep learning curve guaranteed!
  • A supportive, passionate, proactive, and dynamic French team
  • Central Paris offices (1st arrondissement)
  • Employee benefits (Alan Blue healthcare, transport discount, Gymlib, training budget)

Our recruitment process:

We'll review your CV and cover letter. If your profile looks like a good match, we'll invite you to a series of interviews and ask you to complete a case study. We'll do our best to keep the process moving quickly, so we can hopefully welcome you to HelloFresh soon!

Your first steps at HelloFresh:

When you join us, we'll put together a tailored onboarding programme to help you meet each manager and get to know how HelloFresh works. You'll also have time to get to know your team before diving into your new role!

Your day-to-day:

International customer and competitor expertise

Market performance and opportunities

title: Senior Property Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Buena

Buena baut die Technologie, auf der die Immobilienbranche läuft. Wir machen jeden Teil der Immobilienwirtschaft so nahtlos und transparent wie möglich, vom Finden über das Finanzieren bis zum Verwalten.

Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und bauen sie zu Technologieunternehmen um. In den letzten drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 30 Leuten im HQ zu Deutschlands zweitgrößtem Immobilienverwalter geworden.

Du kennst den Alltag einer Hausverwaltung und weißt, wie du Ordnung reinbringst, wenn Abläufe stocken, Aufgaben liegen bleiben oder Verantwortlichkeiten unklar sind.

Genau dort setzt du bei Buena an. Jeden Monat übernehmen wir neue Hausverwaltungen, und du überführst sie in den Buena-Betrieb. Deine Basis ist unser Büro in Berlin, deine Einsätze finden in unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland statt. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich in funktionierenden Abläufen und in Teams, die mit der Buena App besser arbeiten als vorher.

  • Du kennst unsere Software in- und auswendig und trainierst die Teams an ihren konkreten Aufgaben.

  • Du bringst deine Erfahrungen aus dem Verwaltungsalltag zurück ins Product-Team. Was du vor Ort siehst, macht unsere App besser.

Du passt gut, wenn du

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Immobilienverwaltung mitbringst und das Tagesgeschäft eigenständig beherrschst.

Warum jetzt einsteigen

title: Senior Propulsion Engineer - Electric Engine (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As a Senior Propulsion Engineer – Electric Engine, you will drive the development of the electric engine for the VÆRIDION Microliner. You will act as VÆRIDION’s internal technical expert for the complete electric engine, including the motor and controller. You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements.

Working closely with the engine supplier, you will critically review and challenge the engine architecture, detailed design, technical analyses, test results and certification evidence. You will maintain a holistic technical overview of the complete electric engine, including the electric machine, engine controllers, power electronics, thermal management, mechanical interfaces, control functions and supporting hardware and software.

As a senior member of the Propulsion team, you will play a key role in technical decision-making, supplier management, testing and certification activities, helping to bring one of the world's most advanced electric aircraft propulsion systems into service.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the development and certification of the electric engine throughout its complete lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and certification

  • Act as VÆRIDION’s electric engine subject-matter expert and primary technical counterpart to the external engine supplier.

  • Define, maintain and manage electric engine requirements, interfaces, operating limitations and verification strategies.

  • Review and challenge supplier architectures, designs, calculations, simulation models, and substantiation reports, identifying technical gaps and proposing solutions.

  • Evaluate the electric engine performance across its operating envelope, including efficiency, dynamic response, control stability, thermal limits and performance margins.

  • Contribute to system safety activities, including Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA), Failure Mode Effect Analyses (FMEA) and System Safety Assessments (SSA), in accordance with applicable airworthiness and safety standards.

  • Identify and assess applicable certification requirements, means of compliance and industry standards, including relevant aspects of EASA SC E-19, and ensure that certification considerations are addressed throughout the development cycle.

  • Coordinate the electric engine development and qualification test campaigns, in collaboration with the testing team, including the definition of test plans, objectives, and success criteria.

  • Review and assess test results, identify technical risks and deviations, and coordinate the resolution of issues encountered during testing.

  • Prepare and review technical documentation, including specifications, interface documents, design reviews, qualification reports, and compliance statements.

  • Support prototype build, aircraft integration and ground/flight testing activities throughout the maturation of the propulsion system

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related technical field.

  • At least 8 years of relevant professional experience in the development, integration or testing of electric motors, engine controllers/inverters or integrated electric-drive systems.

  • Strong knowledge of electric machines and power electronics, including motor topologies, inverter architectures, operating characteristics & limits, losses & thermal behaviour, motor control strategies & protection functions, and manufacturing processes.

  • Broad understanding of electric engine development, including thermal management, insulation systems, high-voltage systems, EMC, mechanical integrity, reliability & durability, and system integration.

  • Experience defining and managing technical requirements, specifications, interfaces and verification strategies for electric engines or electric-drive systems.

  • Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers.

  • A high degree of self-motivation, resilience, reliability and precision, combined with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Strong analytical, technical-writing and written communication skills.

  • Excellent verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is an asset.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.

  • Previous experience as a Certification Verification Engineer or in a comparable compliance-related role is a plus.

  • Familiarity with EASA SC E-19 and its application to electric or hybrid propulsion systems would be an advantage.

  • Experience in verification, validation and qualification of electric engines, including performance, thermal, endurance and environmental testing, would be a plus.

  • Previous experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or an international equivalent is a plus.

  • Knowledge of systems engineering and safety assessment methodologies, such as SAE ARP4754A and ARP4761, would be beneficial.

  • Specialized expertise in thermal management, high-voltage insulation systems, EMC, electric machine mechanics and vibration, or propulsion-system integration is an advantage.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Senior Prototyping Engineer (f/m/d) – Thermal Systems & Cooling Integration
descriptionHtml:

Reliant combines exceptional endurance, modularity, and operational flexibility to deliver mission-critical capabilities in the most challenging environments.

In this role, you will be responsible for the integration, development, and validation of thermal management and cooling systems for the aircraft. You will develop efficient cooling concepts for hybrid propulsion components, power electronics, avionics, and other heat-generating systems by optimizing airflow, aerodynamic cooling, and thermal integration. Working closely with mechanical, propulsion, and systems engineering teams, you will ensure reliable operation across demanding flight and environmental conditions.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Lead the integration and development of thermal management and cooling systems for UAVs.

  • Design and optimize cooling concepts for combustion engines, generators, power electronics, avionics, and other onboard systems.

  • Develop aerodynamic cooling solutions, including airflow management, ducting, air inlets and outlets, heat exchangers, and passive and active cooling concepts.

  • Define thermal system architectures balancing cooling performance, weight, packaging, reliability, and manufacturability.

  • Design, build, and commission prototype cooling test rigs and instrumentation for system validation.

  • Plan and execute thermal, environmental, endurance, and performance test campaigns.

  • Analyze thermal performance, airflow distribution, and system efficiency, implementing improvements based on test results.

  • Collaborate closely with propulsion, mechanical, structures, and systems engineering teams to optimize thermal integration within the aircraft.

  • Strong understanding of heat transfer, fluid dynamics, cooling system design, airflow management, and thermal testing.

  • Familiarity with CAD tools (CATIA preferred); experience with CFD or thermal simulation tools is advantageous but not essential.

title: Senior Quality Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
What you'll do

  • Stand up and run a lean, effective Quality Management System suitable for a fast-iterating hypersonic hardware programme, aligned to an AS9100 pathway without adding bureaucracy.

  • Own the nonconformance process end to end: containment, root cause, corrective actions, and prevention (NCR, MRB, concessions) with tight turnaround times.

  • Build the quality backbone for prototype to flight hardware, including inspection planning, traceability, and documentation discipline that supports test and readiness reviews.

  • Drive supplier quality for critical components: onboarding criteria, audits (as needed), incoming inspection standards, supplier performance tracking, and rapid resolution of escapes.

  • Partner with engineering and manufacturing to embed DFM/DFA + quality by design early, so we don’t “inspect quality in” later.

  • Define and maintain pragmatic measurement and calibration controls (as appropriate) and ensure controlled processes for special processes where relevant.

  • Create simple quality dashboards that leadership actually uses: escape rate, NCR cycle time, top defect drivers, supplier OTD/quality trends.

  • Be hands-on in the build. When something is off, you are on the floor with the team finding the truth and driving the fix.


Who you are

  • Quality engineer with 4+ years experience in aerospace, defence, advanced manufacturing, motorsport, or other high-consequence hardware environments.

  • Deeply practical: you can run a QMS, but you care more about real outcomes than paperwork.

  • Experienced in NCR/MRB/concessions and closing corrective actions fast with strong root cause discipline.

  • Comfortable operating around flight-critical / safety-critical hardware with traceability and evidence requirements.

  • Supplier-quality capable: you can hold suppliers to a high bar without slowing the programme.

  • Strong judgement: you know when to apply rigor and when to keep it minimal so the team stays fast.

  • Comfortable in ambiguity and pace: you will build systems from scratch and improve them as we learn.


What we offer

  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.

  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.

If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. title: Senior R&D Engineer Trainingssystemen (m/v/x)
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een ervaren bèta-academische professional die klaar is voor een nieuwe uitdaging? Wil je bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van 's werelds meest innovatieve simulatie- en trainingssystemen binnen de militaire (en civiele) luchtvaartwereld? Wil jij je technische kennis en ervaring inzetten voor het initiëren en realiseren van complexe, multidisciplinaire projecten in een high-tech omgeving? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Als senior R&D Engineer Trainingssystemen richt je je op het initiëren en realiseren van innovatieve, multidisciplinaire ontwikkelingen en het opzetten, uitvoeren en managen van grote, complexe projecten. Een belangrijk onderdeel van deze functie is het optreden als Subject Matter Expert (SME) in je vakgebied, waarbij je je kennis en expertise deelt met collega's, klanten adviseert en bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling van innovatieve oplossingen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het leiden van projectteams, het adviseren van klanten en het opbouwen en onderhouden van een extern nationaal en internationaal relatienetwerk.

Je takenpakket omvat onder andere:

  • Het initiëren en realiseren van innovatieve, multidisciplinaire ontwikkelingen, waaronder het genereren van ideeën voor nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en het realiseren van samenwerking met andere disciplines;

  • Het opzetten, uitvoeren en managen van grote, complexe projecten, waaronder het uitwerken van projectplannen, het inventariseren en analyseren van projectrisico's en het adviseren van klanten over alternatieven;

  • Het leiden van projectteams, waaronder het geven van leiding aan projectmedewerkers, het bewaken van de voortgang en resultaten van de projecten en het zorgen voor de kwaliteit van de uitvoering;

  • Het opbouwen en onderhouden van een extern nationaal en internationaal relatienetwerk, waaronder het initiëren en onderhouden van samenwerkingsverbanden, het creëren van mogelijkheden en het uitbrengen van proposals;

  • Het adviseren van klanten, waaronder het opbouwen van een zodanige relatie met de klant dat de klant kan worden ondersteund bij een verscheidenheid aan vraagstukken en het geven van advies over alternatieven;

  • Het bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van afdelingsbeleid, waaronder het realiseren van innovatieve, multidisciplinaire ontwikkelingen en het adviseren van afdelingsmanagement en businessmanager.

Je werkt samen met collega's uit andere teams aan diverse soorten projecten die hoogwaardige technologische simulatie- en trainingsoplossingen leveren aan eindgebruikers in de luchtvaartoperatie. Je hebt frequent contact en interactieve werksessies met hen om tot grensverleggende totaaloplossingen te kunnen komen.

Jouw enthousiasme en de wil om je te verdiepen in de operationele wereld van deze gebruikers is daarbij een must. Dat doe je niet enkel vanaf je bureau maar ook bij de operationele gebruikers op locatie, en regelmatig samen met industrie en kennispartners wereldwijd!

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een afgeronde WO-opleiding in Informatica, Lucht- en Ruimtevaarttechniek, Technische Natuurkunde, Werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbare studierichting;

  • Ruime (>10 jaar) werkervaring in een technische of wetenschappelijke discipline, met een focus op simulatie, training of een verwant gebied, zoals luchtvaart, ruimtevaart, defensie of andere industrieën waarin complexe systemen en processen worden gesimuleerd. Sterke affiniteit en ervaring in het militaire domein is een pre;

  • Affiniteit met innovatieve M&S technologie, zoals real-time simulatie technologie, AR/VR/MR, IoT, data- en softwarearchitecturen en netwerken;

  • Interesse of ervaring in het verbinden van systemen en het waarborgen van interoperabiliteit, bijvoorbeeld door het werken met netwerkprotocollen of architecturen;

  • Kennis van softwareontwikkeling (zowel de implementatie als procesmatig);

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, in de Nederlandse en Engelse taal;

  • Ervaring met projectmanagement, leidinggeven aan projectteams en het schrijven van proposals.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten.

Naast dit alles bieden wij jou:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5400 en €7100 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

  • 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer.

  • Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

title: Senior Revenue Ops
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

Learn more about the exciting challenges tackled by the team by reading this article about Carlos Targhetta's role at Alan 👀

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in RevOps / Sales Ops / Sales Effectiveness, several of them spent hands-on building the sales machine. You own initiatives end-to-end (scope, design, build, measure);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Can write and own SQL queries yourself (joins, basic data modeling), not just read them.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did.

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Madrid, Barcelona or Brussels.

For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

title: Senior RF Engineer (All Gender)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

A

ABOUT THE TEAM

Ground Test & Prototyping. We are the engineering enabler turning theoretical concepts into battle-proven hardware through rapid prototyping, comprehensive environmental qualification, Hardware-in-the-Loop simulation, and physical testing.

YOUR MISSION

As our Senior RF & EMC Qualification Engineer, you will own Electromagnetic Environmental Effects (E3), Radio Frequency (RF) performance, and EMC qualification across our autonomous airframe fleet. You will bridge hardware design, in-house pre-compliance screening, and external military qualification campaigns (MIL-STD-461, VG 95373, DO-160) to ensure our unmanned systems reliably execute their missions in intense electronic warfare (EW) environments.

  • WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK
  • EMC & E3 Qualification Strategy: Define, execute, and own the formal electromagnetic environmental effects (E3) and EMC qualification roadmap across all STARK airframe platforms.
  • Pre-Compliance Testing: Establish and operate an in-house pre-compliance screening bench (near-field probes, conducted emissions, ESD testing) to troubleshoot issues rapidly during early design.
  • Test Plan Authoring: Author formal EMC Test Plans (ETP), test procedures, and qualification reports (ETR) aligned with MIL-STD-461G (RE102, RS103, CE102, CS114/115/116), VG 95373, and RTCA DO-160G.
  • External Campaign Leadership: Serve as the technical lead and authority during formal qualification test campaigns at accredited external test facilities (e.g., IABG).
  • Design-for-EMC Guidance: Collaborate with electrical and mechanical engineering teams to optimize PCB grounding, harness shielding, enclosure bonding, and antenna co-site isolation.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Education & Experience: Degree (B.Sc., M.Sc., or Dipl.-Ing.) in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or equivalent with 5+ years of hands-on experience in EMC testing and qualification.
  • Defence / Aerospace Standards: Deep practical working knowledge of military and aerospace EMC standards: MIL-STD-461 (preferred: Methods RE102, RS103, CE102, CS114/115/116), VG 95373, or RTCA DO-160G Section 20–22.
  • Lab Instrumentation Mastery: Expertise configuring and operating spectrum analyzers, EMI receivers, signal generators, power amplifiers, LISNs, current probes, and near-field sniffers.
  • Root-Cause Troubleshooting: Demonstrated track record of diagnosing and resolving complex EMI/RFI issues (common-mode noise, ground loops, aperture leakage, harness radiation).
  • Language Skills: Fluent English proficiency; German language proficiency is a strong advantage for interfacing with local external test houses.

NICE TO HAVE

  • RF System Integration: Experience with antenna placement, co-site interference mitigation, RF link budgets, or GNSS anti-jam architectures on unmanned airframes.
  • High-Intensity Radiated Fields (HIRF) & Lightning: Familiarity with HIRF testing and indirect lightning effects (DO-160 Section 22 / MIL-STD-464).
  • Automotive / Space Background: Prior qualification experience from aerospace, defense primes, space systems, or high-voltage automotive.

title: Senior Sales Recruiter
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

Let's be honest: 2026 is a strange time to be in Talent Acquisition. Most recruiters are currently looking at their own internal dashboards with a sense of unease. They're seeing the pivots, the shrinking req loads, and the 'doing more with less' memos. If you're currently at a startup that's struggling to find its footing, or a business where the hiring bar has dropped just to fill seats, you know exactly how fragile that 'growth' story feels.

Samsara is the exception. We are a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy.

And we aren't just stable—we're expanding. Our UK Mid-Market team grew 70% year-over-year last year, and we need the talent engine to match that velocity. We aren't looking for someone to manage inbounds; we're looking for a recruiter who wants to move from a shaky seat into a high-conviction, high-growth environment where the fundamentals actually make sense.

The Challenge:

  • Self-Sourced: You own your destiny. You will be expected to find, engage, and convert your own pipeline using best-in-class tools like HireEZ, Juicebox, and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • The High Talent Bar: We aren't looking for CV pushers. You will be expected to act as a rigorous gatekeeper, ensuring that only the top 1% of gritty, A player sales hunters make it into our process.
  • Technical Assessment: You aren't checking vibes. You will be conducting deep-dive sales assessments, evaluating discovery mechanics, and ensuring every candidate has a structured methodology for success.

In this role, you will:

  • Execute & Deliver: Your mission is to fuel the Sales Account Executive engine. You will deliver high-quality, targeted pipelines at pace across EMEA, including the UK, France, Germany, and the Netherlands.
  • Own the Data: You are the CEO of your funnel. You will have total ownership of your response rates, passthrough rates, and talent market mapping. We make decisions based on data, not gut feel.
  • Partner with Sales Heavyweights: Work directly with our Sales VP and GTM leaders to align on hiring strategies that move the needle. You are a consultant, not an order-taker.
  • Master the Craft of Strategic Talent Acquisition: We hire for execution but develop for mastery. You will be mentored by some of the most sophisticated talent leaders in SaaS, learning how to move beyond execution to becoming a strategic talent partner who can influence the trajectory of an entire region.

Strong Backgrounds successful in this role:

  • The Agency Foundation: You started your career in a fast-paced recruiting agency. You still have that hunter DNA and the resilience to handle a relentless quarterly pace.
  • In-House Impact: In-house SaaS sales recruiting experience within a high-talent bar GTM organisation. You've proven you can translate agency grit into internal success.
  • EMEA Experience: You've successfully closed reqs in the UK and at least one other European market.
  • Technical Acumen: You can speak the language of sales. You know the difference between an order-taker and a territory owner. You have experience hiring for a scaling playbook environment and understand how to identify the elite within this market from the B players.

The Ideal Candidate is:

  • Foundational Mastery: The goal is to bridge the gap between execution and influence. You are here to build the bulletproof foundations of an exceptional recruiter—learning how to own a region, influence high-level stakeholders, and use data as a weapon.
  • Focused & Structured: You understand that structuring your inputs—sourcing volume, message personalization, and rigorous screening—is the only way to get consistent output.
  • Data-Minded: You study your own conversion rates and market talent availability to stay ahead of hiring needs.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You iterate on your outreach and your screening questions based on what the data tells you.

What's in it for you?

  • Build the Foundation for Leadership: We believe leadership is a set of skills, not just a job title. In this role, you will develop the data literacy to lead a boardroom with metrics, the strategic insight to advise VPs on market conditions, and the technical acumen to assess elite GTM talent.
  • Elite Exposure: You will be exposed to a broad range of international roles and learn from some of the best sales and recruiting leaders in the industry.
  • The Fortress Stability: NYSE-listed, GAAP profitable, and essential to the global economy. We are building for the long term, which means your career development here is backed by real revenue, not just a VC's hopes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

descriptionHtml:

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are looking for a Senior Seeker Systems Engineer (EO/IR & Radar) to define and develop the sensing capabilities of our next-generation autonomous systems. You will lead the selection, integration, and optimization of onboard sensors, including daylight cameras, thermal imagers, radar, and other targeting payloads, ensuring reliable target detection, tracking, and engagement.

Your Roadmap to Make an Impact

  1. Lead new EO/IR sensor designs in collaboration with hardware and systems engineering teams.

  2. Evaluate and select EO, IR, radar, laser, and multi-sensor solutions.

  3. Develop sensor fusion, target detection, tracking, and classification algorithms.

  4. Specify sensor performance requirements, including range, field of view, stabilization, and SWaP constraints.

  5. Drive integration of sensors into gimbals, payloads, and autonomy systems.

  6. Conduct trade studies, system performance analyses, and supplier evaluations.

  7. Support in ground testing, validation, and flight trials.


  1. Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Optics, Mechatronics, or similar.

  2. Experience in missile seekers, guided weapons, EO/IR payloads, targeting systems, gimbals, ISR sensors, or defense electronics.

  3. Strong knowledge of:

    • Electro-optical (EO) cameras

    • Thermal / IR imaging systems

    • Radar and RF sensing

    • Sensor fusion and target tracking

  4. Experience translating mission requirements into sensor architectures and payload designs.

  5. Hands-on mindset with the ability to take ownership of critical technical decisions.

Ideal Candidate?

You have worked on missile programs, loitering munitions, ISR payloads, targeting systems, or stabilized gimbals and understand how to answer key questions such as:

  • What sensor suite is required for the mission?

  • EO, thermal, radar, or multi-mode seeker?

  • How should sensors be integrated into the autonomy stack?

  • How can detection performance be maximized within strict size, weight, and power constraints?

You'll play a key role in shaping the sensing and targeting capabilities of our next-generation autonomous systems.

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

descriptionHtml:

Given our continued growth, we always have room for more intellect, energy, and enthusiasm - join our global team and see why it's so special to be a part of Mitratech!

Job Overview 

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer specialising in Generative AI and Large Language Models, with a strong focus on agentic systems, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and AI evaluations, to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering production-grade AI solutions that meet complex business objectives effectively. This position requires a blend of expertise in modern AI technologies and software engineering, along with a passion for staying at the forefront of  advancements.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate multi-agent workflows and tool-enabled agents, implementing orchestration logic, state management, safety guardrails, and fallback strategies for resilient production pipelines.
  • Architect and maintain end-to-end RAG systems, covering document ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector retrieval, reranking, and answer synthesis with a focus on quality, attribution, and latency.
  • Evaluate and integrate LLMs and GenAI services across cost, performance, and privacy dimensions, selecting the right mix of managed and in-house models.
  • Develop, version, and optimise prompting strategies; implement automated prompt testing and regression tracking to maintain output quality and reliability.
  • Define and own evaluation frameworks for generative outputs, including automated metrics, LLM-as-judge approaches, human evaluation protocols, hallucination detection, and drift monitoring.
  • Apply classical NLP techniques where appropriate and maintain awareness of data distribution shifts that could impact model behaviour in production.
  • Build and operate scalable, secure AI infrastructure on AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, OpenSearch), following well architected principles and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Own the full deployment lifecycle: CI/CD for models and agents, testing strategies, observability, and rollback procedures.
  • Ensure data quality through rigorous validation and augmentation, and proactively source datasets for training, fine-tuning, and evaluation.

Requirements & Skills:

  • Agent Orchestration: Production experience designing multi-agent systems with tool use, memory/state management, and fault-tolerant routing. Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom orchestrators.
  • RAG & Retrieval: Hands-on experience building RAG pipelines end-to-end: chunking, embedding models, vector databases, retrieval tuning, and answer synthesis at production scale.
  • Evaluations: Strong experience defining and running evaluation pipelines for generative AI — automated scoring, human evaluation design, hallucination mitigation, and drift monitoring. LLM-as-judge patterns are a plus.
  • LLMs & GenAI: Demonstrated experience with foundation models and GenAI providers (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta). Comfortable with fine-tuning, instruction tuning, and prompt engineering at scale.
  • Traditional NLP: Solid grounding in classical NLP techniques (NER, text classification, intent detection, topic modelling) and good judgement on when to apply them alongside or instead of LLMs.
  • AWS Bedrock: Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock: foundation model APIs, Bedrock Agents, Knowledge Bases, and Guardrails. Experience with Bedrock Model Evaluation is a plus.
  • AWS Ecosystem: Proficiency with SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, OpenSearch, IAM, CloudWatch, and VPC networking.
  • MLOps & CI/CD: Familiarity with model registries, CI/CD for ML, feature stores, canary deployments, monitoring, and rollback.
  • IaC: Experience with Terraform or AWS CDK for reproducible infrastructure provisioning.
  • Python: Production-quality Python: packaging, testing (pytest), type hints, async programming, and clean ML pipeline abstractions.
  • ML Frameworks: Familiarity with traditional ML frameworks and fine-tuning workflows.
  • Experiment Tracking: Experience with Langfuse, Arize or Langsmith, or equivalent for tracking runs, metrics, and artefacts.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business goals into concrete technical solutions and communicate tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong collaborative instincts — comfortable working across engineering, product, and data teams.
  • A rigorous, evidence-driven mindset: you ship with confidence because you measure, test, and monitor thoroughly.

Education:                         

  • A Master’s degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science with a preference for specialization in the NLP domain.

descriptionHtml:

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. Role Overview:

As a Senior / Staff Data Scientist, you will help shape how PlayStation measures the impact of products, features and commercial initiatives through world-class experimentation, causal inference and applied data science.

Working at the intersection of data science, machine learning, product and commercial strategy, you will develop innovative measurement methodologies, define best practices, and provide technical leadership that enables teams across PlayStation to make faster, more confident business decisions.

This role goes beyond traditional A/B testing. You will solve complex measurement problems where controlled experiments are difficult or impossible, applying modern causal inference, statistical modelling and machine learning techniques to generate robust business insights. You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, analytics and business teams to raise the standard of experimentation and evidence-based decision-making across the organisation.

This is an opportunity to influence strategic decisions impacting millions of PlayStation players while helping establish best-in-class measurement practices across one of the world's leading entertainment companies.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Apply advanced data science and machine learning techniques where appropriate to complement experimentation and support complex business decisions.
  • Define and promote best practices for experiment design, statistical analysis and causal measurement across multiple product and business teams, helping scale experimentation across PlayStation.

title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Pricing
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

🏅 The Role:

Rosso is tem's core IP, the transaction infrastructure that prices electricity for thousands of businesses, balances portfolios in real time, and sits on the critical path for every deal tem closes. Machine learning is at the heart of Rosso, combining forecasting, optimisation and classical ML to process billions of data points and drive thousands of automated decisions a day. Every inference shapes the prices our customers see, so you can immediately see the impact of your work.

We have proved the concept with MVPs and POCs to grow to 2% of the UK market. Now we want to take it to the next level and build towards a state of the art solution, to fuel our expansion in the UK and take Rosso international.

We're looking for a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer to lead pricing ML within Rosso, building a platform that proactively drives growth by targeting the right customers to sign at the right time. Your primary focus will be the pricing engine, which sets the fees added to every quote tem serves, carefully balancing growth and margin. You will also contribute to the systems which manage both short and long-term imbalance decisions to determine how tem deals with its exposure across its portfolio.

This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role. You own the technical direction of pricing by building it: most of your week is writing and shipping production code. It is not a people leadership role, and not an architecture role where others do the implementing.

The right person is energised by the greenfield environment: comfortable taking on ambiguity and able to make progress before the path is fully defined. They have built pricing, trading or optimisation systems that worked, ideally in energy or another market-driven domain, and have learned from the times they haven't. They'll bring that hard-won judgment to a system where the foundations are still being laid, and where early decisions compound. Success will be turning our current reactive system into a pricing engine which proactively drives growth by targeting the right customers to sign at the right time.

🚀 Responsibilities:

  • Own the technical direction for pricing ML: Define what to build and how within the pricing engine, setting the strategy and roadmap for pricing machine learning as a core piece of tem's IP.

  • Build ML systems for price optimisation: Design and implement models that dynamically set prices, balancing the trade-off between signing probability, portfolio balance and margin maximisation.

  • Solve imbalance problems: Develop probabilistic models to optimise risk management and short-term balancing decisions in a highly dynamic environment.

  • Bridge modelling and production: Own the modelling and data layer while working closely with software engineers and MLOps to ensure models are architected for production, contributing to system design decisions that affect performance and reliability.

  • Communicate pricing decisions clearly: Articulate model behaviour, assumptions, and trade-offs to other technical stakeholders so that pricing decisions are understood across the teams that depend on them.

🎯 Requirements:

Must-haves:

  • Deep experience building ML systems for pricing, revenue optimisation, or decision-making under uncertainty, with a track record of models that went from concept to production and delivered measurable commercial impact.

  • A quantitative background in a domain where prices, forecasts and risk interact: energy markets, power trading, batteries and flexibility, market making, or similar. Energy is strongly preferred and where our strongest fits have come from.

  • Strong foundation in stochastic optimisation and probabilistic modelling, with the judgement to formulate ambiguous business problems as the right mathematical approach rather than reaching for familiar tools.

  • Proven first-principles reasoning: you choose between stochastic programming, classical ML, reinforcement learning, or a simple heuristic based on the problem, not the technique you know best.

  • The engineering craft to match your modelling depth: production-grade Python, a high bar for code quality and system design, and the ability to work alongside software engineers as a technical peer across the full ML lifecycle.

  • Breadth across the full lifecycle: you carry the modelling and quant work and the productionising (deploying, monitoring, reasoning about the software systems around your models), and you would rather ship the whole thing to a good standard and iterate than perfect one component. You reason at the level of the outcome, the portfolio and its levers, not a single model.

Bonus points:

  • Experience with reinforcement learning or causal inference in applied, commercial settings.

  • PhD or equivalent research depth in a quantitative discipline (statistics, applied mathematics, physics, operations research, or similar).

  • Ability to reason about the trade-offs between optimisation solvers (Gurobi etc) and gradient-based ML methods (PyTorch etc), and the judgement to know when to reach for each.

  • Experience working with high data throughput systems in production.

✨ Benefits & Perks:

  • Salary: Competitive. We are looking to pay £127,000 or equivalent in local currency.

  • Stock Options: everyone on the team has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday + public holidays. Swap public holidays for ones that matter most to you. Plus, get an extra day off for your birthday 🎉.

  • Remote working: we're fully remote, distributed across Europe

  • Home working & wellbeing budgets:

    • Up to £1,200 / €1,200 annually to upgrade your remote setup (co-working passes, equipment, etc.).

    • Up to £150 / €150 monthly on anything that supports your wellbeing, from therapy to gym memberships to meditation apps.

🗣️ Interview Process:

Our processes normally take around 2-3 weeks from first call to offer. Please let us know about any adjustments to timelines that may be required.

  1. First call with our Talent Team (30 mins). This is to understand your experience, motivations, and discuss the role in more detail.

  2. Behavioural interview with our Rosso GM, hiring manager for this role (30 mins). This is your chance to really understand the role, the expectations, and ensure alignment on ways of working.

  3. Technical interview with the Team (90 mins). You'll meet with potential peers in this session and work through a live technical exercise.

  4. Bar Raiser interview with Stakeholders (45 mins). The final session will be with two cross-functional stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.
