title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Moonpay Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.


The role

We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most.

Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform

Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) verification flows, risk scoring, sanctions and AML screening, case management, and integrations with identity and compliance vendors. The challenge is making rigorous compliance feel invisible: fast, automated, and globally scalable, without ever compromising on regulatory obligations.

Track 2: New Product Lines, starting with Custody

Join us at the ground floor of new enterprise products, beginning with Custody. You’ll design the backend for secure digital asset storage and management for institutional clients: key management workflows, policy engines, transaction authorization, ledger integrity, and audit trails. This track suits engineers who love ambiguity, greenfield architecture, and building products from zero to one with enterprise-grade security requirements.

Track 3: Blockchain, Stablecoin Issuance & On-Chain Infrastructure

Work directly with blockchain protocols to power our stablecoin issuance business and on-chain products. You’ll build and operate services for minting, burning, and managing fully reserved stablecoins across chains, develop smart contract integrations on EVM chains and Solana, and design the indexing, monitoring, and reconciliation systems that keep on-chain and off-chain state in sync. Prior Solana (Rust) or Solidity development experience is a strong plus here.

Across all tracks, experience with fiat rails, banking integrations, or payments systems is very welcome. Much of our hardest work happens where traditional finance and crypto overlap.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and operate backend services written in Rust that process high volumes of financial transactions with strong guarantees around correctness, idempotency, and auditability
  • Own features end to end, from shaping the product spec through technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. You won’t just receive work from product: as a domain expert, you’ll help define what we build and propose the work you consider most useful
  • Integrate with external partners such as banks, payment processors, blockchains, and identity and compliance vendors, and build the abstractions that make those integrations reliable
  • Improve engineering quality across observability, incident response, security practices, and API design
  • Collaborate closely with product, compliance, and other engineering teams across MoonPay’s global network
  • (Staff level) Set technical direction for your area, mentor other engineers, and drive architectural decisions that span multiple teams

About you

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience (8+ for Staff), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale
  • Strong backend experience with a statically compiled language (e.g. Rust, Go, C#, C++) is a must. Deep fundamentals matter more to us than your specific language history
  • Prior professional Rust experience is not required, but interest in Rust and motivation to become an expert in it are very welcome, since our services are written in Rust
  • Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, and asynchronous processing
  • Comfort working in domains where precision matters, such as financial systems, double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, or similarly correctness-critical software
  • A pragmatic, autonomous, ownership-driven mindset. You care about outcomes, communicate clearly, and thrive on high throughput: on this team, features ship in hours to days and products in days to weeks
  • Strong critical thinking, including in how you use AI tools. You know how to drive AI-assisted development productively while staying firmly in control of correctness, security, and design quality
  • Interest in crypto, stablecoins, and the future of payments. Prior crypto experience is a plus rather than a requirement, except for Track 3, where hands-on blockchain development experience is expected

Bonus points

  • Professional or hobby experience writing Rust (open-source contributions count!)
  • Experience in fiat payments, banking integrations, card networks, or PSPs
  • Familiarity with KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, or regulated financial products (Track 1)
  • Background in custody, key management (MPC/HSM), or institutional-grade security (Track 2)
  • Smart contract development in Solidity (EVM) or Rust (Solana), and experience with on-chain indexing or node infrastructure (Track 3)
  • Experience working in regulated, multi-jurisdiction environments

How we work

MoonPay Enterprise operates like a startup inside a scale-up: small, senior, high-throughput teams with real ownership, direct access to customers and decision-makers, and the backing of MoonPay’s global licenses, banking relationships, and distribution network. We move fast and expect engineers to act as product owners for their domain, not just implementers. This role is open as a hybrid position from our Berlin, London and New York offices.

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

About the Role

We are a social-first business, revolutionising how retail marketing is approached, and we are looking for a Senior Retail (Trade) Marketing Manager to lead our Pureplay vertical across the UK & ROI. Leading a team across our five pureplay retail channels, all three of our brands (Shark, Shark Beauty and Ninja) and a portfolio of 39 product categories, you will own Retail Media Planning and Trade Marketing Strategy for the vertical, bring a sharp commercial lens to everything we do, be our senior marketing relationship for the retailers, and partner closely with Sales and the wider marketing community to unlock growth. Social-first collaboration is a growing and exciting part of the remit. If it is not yet your strength, we will help you build it.

Here are some of the EXCITING things you’ll get to do:

Strategy & Planning

• Lead the Pureplay vertical against ambitious growth targets, owning the number and advising the business on how that growth will be unlocked across retail media and trade marketing.

• Lead Retail Media and Trade Marketing strategy and planning for the vertical across the full marketing funnel: setting the standard for what good looks like, guiding your team’s planning, calendar and prioritisation, aligning UKI execution with global objectives, and deploying investment where it drives the strongest commercial return.

• Be the senior, retailer-facing marketing lead for the vertical, building and progressively deepening relationships with the senior marketing contacts within your retailers, and using them to shape joint plans, unlock opportunities and position SharkNinja as a priority partner.

• Act as the sense-check on the viability of what the Strategy, Sales & Analytics (SSnA) and Sales teams propose: probing, collaborating and keeping a helicopter view to ensure full-funnel plans (including promotional and launch events across the year) are joined up, deliver the commercial volume objectives set by SSnA, align to the SKUs and volumes secured by Sales, and keep marketing investment where it needs to be. Develop and own the digital-channel Joint Business Plans with Sales.

• Align plans with the Brand Media and Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC) teams to maximise the efficiency and impact of total marketing investment, working with them to adjust plans where necessary due to commercial or operational blocks.

• Champion data- and AI-driven commercial planning to sharpen investment decisions, forecasting and prioritisation.

Commercial, Social & Growth

• Bring a commercial lens to everything the team does, spotting opportunities and gaps, developing retailer campaigns and propositions that turn existing and incremental marketing budget into substantial uplifts in product orders and strong return on investment, and partnering and leading with your Sales counterparts (including the Senior Sales Director, Pureplay) and retailers on these conversations.

• Champion social-first collaborations with our retail partners (influencer, organic social and affiliate), amplified through wider full funnel (on and offsite) retailer-owned media activations to build reach, engagement and conversion.

• Own the digital shelf and content excellence agenda (PDPs, brand stores, search and content) and ensure flawless GTM and NPD support, with assets, listings and launch readiness delivered in time and aligned to launch dates.

• Lead the vertical’s presence at selected physical retailer events, partnering with Retail Excellence (Field & Branded Display) and agencies to deliver brand experiences that add commercial value.

Budget & Performance

• Own your vertical’s multi-million-pound marketing budgets, both contracted A&P (Co-op) and any incremental budget secured, ensuring your team plans and deploys them effectively and adjusting at pace to maximise every pound.

• Set the standard for measurement and reporting, ensuring your team reports spend and performance accurately and on time each week to the Head of Retail Marketing and the wider UKI Leadership team, where it feeds into regional and global visibility.

Leadership & Collaboration

• Lead, motivate and support your team (two Trade Marketing Managers and two Retail Marketing Executives across the five pureplay channels, plus a dotted-line Manager), leading from a place of empathy, owning individual development plans, setting clear objectives and building an unstoppable team.

• Work closely with the other vertical leads, and partner end-to-end with Sales, Brand/Category Marketing, SSnA, Studio, Brand Media, IMC and Retail Excellence (Field & Branded Display) to deliver joined-up, best-in-class activation.

• Act as the bridge between local execution and global strategy, connecting UKI pureplay activity to global brand media workstreams and representing UKI in cross-market and EMEA forums.

• Embody the SharkNinja Outrageously Extraordinary mindset and values, living our leadership principles (including ‘winning is a team sport’), comfortable with ambiguity, energised by rewriting the rule book, and bringing retailers, agencies and colleagues on the journey with you.

What You'll Need:

• Strong commercial acumen and aptitude with the ability to bring a commercial lens to everything the team does, see the opportunities and the gaps, and partner and lead confidently with Sales counterparts and retailers on commercial conversations.

• Experience in retail, trade or channel marketing, ideally within pureplay, e-commerce or marketplace environments (consumer electronics, FMCG or durable goods a plus).

• Proven brand-side experience, having worked in-house for a brand or manufacturer. Retailer and/or agency background alongside this is welcome and valuable.

• A strong working understanding of full-funnel retail media planning and the digital shelf to enable leading a team of specialists, define what good looks like and challenge the plans guiding where adaptions are needed.

• Proven people-leadership experience: managing, coaching and developing a team with empathy, including building individual development plans that grow your people.

• Strong budget planning skills, with experience owning and reporting on significant (multi-million-pound) marketing budgets;

• Excellent stakeholder management, able to manage upwards to local, regional and global leadership and outwards to senior retail and agency partners with equal confidence.

• Confident with fast-paced, test-and-learn ways of working (fail fast and small) and the agility and ambiguity that comes with it - we pivot plans hourly or daily across our three brands and 37 categories on the back of commercial, market, consumer and operational data, and act on it. This is the SharkNinja Outrageously Extraordinary mindset.

• Strong analytical, presentation and communication skills at leadership level, with a high level of ownership, entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to keep a helicopter view in a fast-paced, fast-changing environment.

Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day.  Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

What We Offer

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.  

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.

title: Senior UX Strategist & Researcher (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
The role

HelloFresh is going AI-first. Join us in leading the shift and shaping the global customer experience. As a Senior UX Strategist & Researcher on our UX team, you'll own work from ambiguous brief to strategic outcome and implementation — defining project needs, using innovative research approaches, prototyping direction instead of presenting findings, and walking into executive meetings with a decision artifact, not a summary. The most valued teammates today aren't the ones who run the most studies. They shape which questions get asked, challenge business assumptions before money is spent, and stay in the room to drive the decision. 

You'll use AI fluently as a genuine creative and strategic partner throughout the product design lifecycle. Strategy and research are your deepest strengths, but you’ll also work across the wider UX practice. We’re looking for people who go deep in one area and can take interface design, service design, and content to a solid minimum quality standard on their own, using AI to move fast, and who know when a problem needs a specialist’s depth.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • Lead strategic research for insights to action: Own the end-to-end research and strategy work streams, from scoping through execution to insight delivery and application, balancing primary, secondary, qualitative and quantitative methods.
  • Shape experiences across the ecosystem: Partner with product, design, marketing, operations, and business teams to understand and shape experiences across the full customer and service ecosystem.
  • Shape the agenda, not just respond to it: Proactively identify which bets need de-risking before anyone has asked. Challenge briefs before executing them. Connect findings to business decisions, market context, and KPIs.
  • Influence at strategic altitude: influence decision-makers— often VP/SVP — presenting in formats that force a decision in the room, not a follow-up meeting. Build visual directions, opportunity frameworks, and concept artifacts that make choices tangible.
  • Design and lead workshops: Own co-creation and alignment sessions end-to-end — the room, the agenda, and the output. Move teams from findings to direction.
  • Make insight visible: Build prototypes, concept visualizations, and service scenarios — using AI where needed to close the gap between insight and expression. 
  • Apply the right method for the moment: Select methods based on what the problem demands, not what's most familiar. Apply foundational, generative, or evaluative methodologies, rightsized to the context and the level of speed and rigor required.
  • Work AI-native across strategy and research: Apply AI from framing the problem and scoping studies through analysis, synthesis, and strategic recommendations. Use it to prototype directions and create decision-informed content, turning findings into executive-ready narratives and visual frameworks that compress the insight-to-action cycle. Experiment with novel methods, bring what works into live projects, and apply critical judgment throughout, knowing when to override the model.
  • Break down barriers across UX: Use AI to flex into interface design, service design, and content, producing work that meets a clear minimum quality bar on your own, and knowing when a problem needs a specialist’s depth. Help the team do the same by sharing what works, so AI removes execution barriers between disciplines and scales across the UX organization.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in UX research, UX strategy, Service Design or a closely related field within a product or tech environment
  • Mixed-methods toolkit with strong judgment for when to apply which approach
  • Experience influencing VP/SVP-level stakeholders — changing decisions, not just informing them
  • Ability to design and lead workshops and co-creation sessions with cross-functional teams
  • Ability to prototype and visualize strategic direction independently — through concept sketches, lo-fi prototypes, service blueprints, or AI-assisted artifacts
  • Strong strategic storytelling and visual communication; deliverables built to move people, not just inform them
  • Genuine AI native workflows and outputs in a research or strategy context — demonstrated point of view on how AI should change our workflows and where its limits are, as well as practical experience applying AI in real project contexts
  • Business acumen: able to connect research to trade-offs, market context, and commercial implications
  • Depth plus breadth: Deep strategy and research skills, plus working knowledge of interface design, service design, and content craft. You can produce work that meets a defined quality bar with AI support, and you’re comfortable handing off when the depth required goes beyond that.

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

title: Silicon Infrastructure Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create and support Python tooling and silicon verification and physical design workflows centred around silicon EDA tooling, which will require coding and build-system knowledge to assist with tasks faced by different teams.

  • Bazel build system support for new silicon EDA tools required for throughout the chip lifecycle

  • Create and improve Python developer tools across frontend and backend silicon teams

  • Improve existing workflows to make them cacheable and reproducible

  • Work with the engineering team to build and optimise their workloads

It would be great if you have:

  • Experience of silicon EDA tooling

  • Experience working with build systems tooling, such as Bazel.

  • Experience working with workload management tools, such as Slurm.

  • Experience working with container orchestration tools, such as Docker, and Kubernetes.

  • Experience working with infrastructure as code, such as Ansible, or Terraform and maintaining compute infrastructure

  • Experience of setup and monitor observation tooling for resource utilisation, machine failures, and more (e.g. Prometheus/Zabbix)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proficient in modern software development language(s) especially Python

  • Proficient dealing with modern build systems e.g. Bazel, Pants

  • Past experience with diagnosing and resolving network/storage/CPU/RAM bottlenecks across complex workloads.

  • Experience deploying and managing a grid compute system (Slurm/LSF/SGE).

  • Proficiency with containerisation frameworks (Docker/Singularity)

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

title: Software Engineer Fullstack - Stage de fin d'études Paris - Secteur Public - Theodo GovTech
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Chez Theodo GovTech, nous accompagnons nos clients - ministères, collectivités territoriales et grands opérateurs publics - dans la conception, le développement et la maintenance de produits numériques accessibles, durables et utiles pour la société. Rejoindre notre aventure, c'est partager une ambition commune : utiliser le numérique pour augmenter l’efficacité de l'action publique et améliorer le quotidien des agents et des usagers.
Ton équipe : Tu rejoindras une communauté tech : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien. Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.

Le tech lead a pour objectif de te faire réussir : il te fait réfléchir aux problématiques que tu rencontres et en t’aidant à te débloquer. Tu pourras le solliciter à tout moment pour t’aider à progresser !

Tes futures missions :
  • Écrire du code selon les meilleurs standards de qualité pour t’assurer que ta solution soit rapide, sécurisée et stable, peu importe la techno employée.
  • Challenger les problèmes clients et proposer des solutions simples
  • Prendre du recul sur les bugs et les potentiels d’amélioration de ton projet pour apprendre de tes erreurs et améliorer le fonctionnement de ton équipe.
Tu vas apprendre à produire un code de qualité 3 à 5 fois plus vite avec l'IA grâce à notre partenariat avec Anthropic ! Toute la dynamique de l’entreprise repose sur l’engagement des Theodoers dans un apprentissage permanent. C’est pour cette raison que ton quotidien ne se limite pas aux projets clients : chaque Theodoer contribue à rendre l’entreprise meilleure en développant de nouvelles connaissances pour tous, qu’il partage via des conférences en interne et en externe, des articles de blog, des groupes d’expertises avec d’autres passionnés au sein de Theodo France… Exemple de projets : Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :
  • La plateforme Altitude développée en 6 mois pour AXA Climate permettant aux sociétés de gestion d'évaluer en moins de 10 min les risques liés au climat, à la transition carbone et à la biodiversité. Par exemple, Altitude est capable d’identifier des risques de montée des eaux et d’érosion côtière des bâtiments grâce à son algorithme et aux bases de données scientifiques d’AXA Climate. Toute la code base est en typescript, avec du React en frontend et du Serverless en backend.
  • L’application Cargo Readiness développée pour CMA CGM centralise la vérification de la conformité des containers avant onboarding (poids, documentation, normes). Auparavant dispersé entre plusieurs outils, ce suivi générait erreurs et retards. La nouvelle solution a permis de réduire de 90 % les annulations de dernière minute (<2 jours avant départ) et d’améliorer la fluidité logistique. L'application, en React, a été livrée en 4 mois, sur une API Rest en Spring Boot ingérant et consolidant des événements venant d'un broker centralisé. Dans un second temps l'IA de Mistral AI est venu se brancher à notre API pour améliorer l'expérience utilisateur.
Ton parcours de progression : Notre ambition est de former les leaders de la tech de demain. Grâce au coaching et formations que l’on propose, tu pourras :
  • Devenir un expert en développement en étant formé aux meilleurs standards de qualité
  • Développer des compétences transverses : coaching, recrutement, commercial, management et marketing technique
  • Participer à des groupes d’expertises avec d’autres passionnés (Cybersécurité, Serverless, Performance, GreenIT…)
  • Construire ton parcours sur-mesure pour atteindre tes objectifs : tech lead, senior architecte, CTO ou fondateur d’une entité..
Profil recherché : Pas besoin d’être déjà expert en développement : ce qu’on cherche, c’est ton potentiel !
  • Tu es étudiant en école d’ingénieur et tu cherches un stage de fin d’étude de 4 à 6 mois
  • Tu as un bon relationnel, tu aimes travailler en équipe avec des profils et des métiers différents
  • Tu aimes travailler sur du concret et impacter directement les utilisateurs
  • Tu es désireux d’évoluer dans un environnement qui encourage au quotidien l’envie de progresser, l’esprit d’équipe et la prise d’initiatives
Si ton stage se passe bien et que les conditions sont réunies, nous sommes ouverts à poursuivre en CDI avec toi ! Le processus de recrutement :
  • Un échange de 30 minutes avec un recruteur pour échanger sur tes motivations et comprendre ton profil.
  • Un entretien avec le même recruteur d’une heure pour rentrer plus en détail sur ton parcours.
  • Un test de refactoring libre (1h30 de préparation) suivi d'un entretien dans nos locaux de debriefing avec un(e) tech expérimenté(e).
  • Un entretien technique de debugging avec un(e) tech expérimenté(e).
  • Un entretien avec un membre de l’équipe dirigeante.
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🚇 Remboursement de 50% de l'abonnement de transport ou mobilité durable 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Software Engineer II - Embedded Platform
descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We’re looking for an Engineer II to join our Platform squad working on one of Hudl’s most innovative products: next-generation, fully automated sports cameras. These autonomous cameras use edge AI to automatically track the action and upload to the cloud, giving our customers seamless access to vital, real-time video and insights.

The Platform squad builds the foundation our hardware teams rely on - the build systems, tooling, update pipeline and security processes that take our cameras from development through manufacturing and into the field. As we bring up our next-generation hardware platform, you’ll help shape how it’s built, tested, shipped and kept secure.

As an Engineer II, you’ll:

  • Support our hardware squads. You’ll help hardware squads integrate their work into our CI/CD pipelines, so every change is built, tested and delivered reliably.
  • Build development tools. You’ll create and improve the tools our engineers use every day to build, flash, debug and test devices.
  • Keep our infrastructure running. You’ll maintain our CI/CD infrastructure, including the regression testing that runs in manufacturing.
  • Ship updates to the field. You’ll roll out software updates to our customers’ cameras safely and predictably.
  • Enable manufacturing. You’ll provide the tooling our contract manufacturers use to flash, provision and test devices on the production line.
  • Own the problem. You’ll work in an autonomous squad that has the freedom and expertise to deliver the best solution.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of Den Bosch. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

  • Yocto experience. You’ve worked with Yocto and are comfortable building and customizing images.
  • CI/CD know-how. You’ve built or maintained CI/CD pipelines (for example, GitHub Actions, GitLab or Jenkins), including build automation and automated testing.
  • Scripting and tooling skills. You write clean, maintainable tools and automation in Bash and Python, and you’re comfortable with Docker and Linux system administration.
  • Comfortable withAI-assisted development. You work fluently with AI coding tools and can evaluate their output critically.

Nice-to-Haves

  • OTA update experience. You’ve worked with over-the-air update frameworks.
  • Manufacturing experience. You’ve built flashing, provisioning or end-of-line test tooling for production environments.
  • Embedded platform experience. You’ve worked with SoC vendor BSPs, flashing tools or secure boot on platforms.
  • Low-level development. You’re comfortable reading and debugging C/C++ code, from user space down to kernel drivers.
  • Security vulnerability management. You have experience identifying, triaging and resolving security vulnerabilities in embedded Linux systems.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.  Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.  
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
  • Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range€51.000—€85.000 EUR

title: Software Engineer (Infrastructure)
descriptionHtml:
Thought Machine's mission is bold – to properly and permanently rid the world's banks of legacy technology. To achieve this, we have developed the foundations of modern banking through core and payments technology which run natively in the cloud. What we are attempting is hard and means we need great people working together to build great technology.

We have grown rapidly in the past few years – growing our team to more than 550 individuals across offices in London, New York, Singapore, Sydney and our newly established Engineering Hub in Lisbon. We have raised more than £500m in funding and our investors include Molten Ventures, Eurazeo, Intesa Sanpaolo, Temasek, Nyca Partners, JPMorgan Chase Strategic Investments, Standard Chartered Ventures, and more.

We have created a culture that enables our team to produce the best work in the industry while ensuring we have fun along the way. We're regularly cited as having a fantastic workplace culture and have been recognised by Sifted magazine as having one of the highest Glassdoor ratings for a UK fintech company and the industry's most generous employee share package. Named one of the world's most innovative fintechs by Global Finance Magazine, we were also recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe's fastest-growing companies for two consecutive years—and a UK Best Employer for 2026.

At Thought Machine, our Software Engineers specialised in Infrastructure play a crucial role in deploying and maintaining our cutting-edge software, developing tools and integrations with third-party infrastructure components used in our customers’ environments. The role spans across building mechanisms to automate and streamline deployment processes, to facilitating infrastructure changes in the data and streaming platforms which support our products, among other things. We build automation to provide an intuitive and reliable user experience to operate and integrate with Vault for Thought Machine engineers and bank SREs.


Duties

  • Support the engineering team in building reliable, scalable applications

  • Help design and build tools to make our services scalable and highly available, automating wherever possible

  • Develop observability and orchestration tooling to allow our customers to monitor and manage their deployments

  • Contribute to disaster recovery, backup and redundancy tooling and strategy

  • Assist in improving the quality of our codebase by building new tools and processes

Essential

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a similar technical field

  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience

  • Experience developing production-ready infrastructure management tooling with either Python or Golang

  • Familiarity with at least one of the following:

    • Observability Tools (e.g. Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana)

    • Databases (e.g. Postgres, DuckDB)

    • Event Streaming platforms (e.g. Kafka)

    • Container Orchestration (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes)

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP

  • Experience with CI/CD systems (e.g. Jenkins, CircleCI, GitLab, GitHub Actions)

     

Desirable

  • Experience supporting production systems in high-consistency transactional environments

     

Benefits

  • Highly competitive salary and commission

  • Pension plan (match up to 5%)

  • Life insurance (3x annual salary)

  • Competitive maternity (six months fully paid) and paternity leave (four weeks fully paid)

  • Shared parental leave (matched to our maternity leave for the same point in time)

  • 25 days holiday and bank holidays

  • Flexible working hours

  • Cycle-to-work scheme

  • Electric car scheme

  • Season ticket loan

  • Access to outstanding learning materials and courses

  • Sports and hobby clubs, subsidised by Thought Machine

  • All the latest tech you need

  • Start the day properly with fresh fruit and cereals

  • Huge range of healthy (and not-so-healthy) snacks, smoothies and drinks

  • A talented and experienced team as your colleagues

  • An environment where we encourage learning and progress

  • Two charity days a year

  • Weekly food pop-up

     

We actively hire candidates who demonstrate technical excellence in their field and welcome people of all ages and backgrounds, providing everyone with equal access to professional development. You are encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't accurately match the job description. We also encourage applications from those with different abilities, including candidates with ADHD, autism, dyslexia or dyspraxia.

title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.

The role

MasonOS coordinates our factory network across four countries. This role builds the part of it that makes decisions: which site takes an order, which supplier fills a gap, how the schedule changes when a machine goes down.

It is backend engineering with physical consequences. When the routing is wrong, metal sits still.

What you'll do

  • Build order routing across the sites in our network.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions.

title: Sr Agent Architect (Germany)
descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience - one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role

As a Sr Agent Architect at Parloa, you will act as a solution architect for enterprise AI Agent deployments. You will design end-to-end system architectures that connect Parloa's platform to complex enterprise environments, solve multi-system integration challenges, and apply systems thinking to build reliable, scalable AI solutions for global enterprise clients.

You will also shape the conversational experience layer, using prompt engineering and your knowledge of LLMs to translate customer requirements into agent behavior. Architecture and integration depth are the core of this role. Conversational design skills are valued and can be developed on the job.

Areas of ownership

  • Design end-to-end solution architectures for AI Agent deployments, mapping how Parloa's platform integrates into customers' enterprise systems (CRMs, ERPs, ticketing systems, contact center platforms).
  • Build and configure integrations using integration platforms and APIs, applying systems thinking to solve complex, multi-system data flows.
  • Collaborate with Forward Deployed Engineers on complex or custom integration scenarios that go beyond standard integration capabilities.
  • Apply structured testing approaches to validate architecture, integration reliability, and AI agent performance under real-world conditions.
  • Identify and resolve blockers together with other departments at Parloa (e.g., Product, Solution Engineering, Sales) and the customer.
  • Scope AI Agent deployments, providing strategic architecture advice and execution support to customers and partners.
  • Use your knowledge of LLM internals (e.g., embeddings) to analyze customer requirements and design prompts for reliable, user-aligned agent behavior.
  • Translate complex customer workflows into structured conversational components that LLMs can execute reliably.
  • Fine-tune conversational flows and voice output (e.g., SSML, Lexicons, Regex) to align with customer brand standards.
  • Document best practices, how-to guides, and product capabilities for internal and external audiences, representing the expertise of the Agent Architect team.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of experience in enterprise customer-facing roles, with proven expertise in solution architecture, systems architecture, or enterprise integration.
  • Strong systems thinking, with a track record of solving complex technical problems across multiple systems and data sources.
  • Experience with complex SaaS implementations at scale (CRMs, ERPs, contact center platforms, ticketing systems).
  • Proficiency in REST API design, JSON/XML data structures, API testing tools (e.g., Postman), and API authentication patterns (OAuth, API keys, JWT).
  • Experience reading and consuming API documentation across enterprise SaaS platforms, including data transformation and field mapping logic.
  • Analytical and critical thinker with expertise in risk assessment and problem-solving.
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with a passion for meeting milestones and effective communication.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with initiative, results orientation, and ability to identify opportunities for impact.
  • Ability to analyze customer requirements and translate them into LLM prompts and conversational flows, with attention to subtle conversational nuance and A/B testing to assess agent performance. 
  • Prior conversation design, prompt engineering (e.g., chain-of-thought, few-shot learning), or A/B testing experience is a plus, not a requirement - we will train this.
  • Fluency in German and English is required 

Our Recruiting Process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

title: Sr. Specialist Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:

As a Senior Specialist Solutions Architect (Sr. SSA) for AI/ML, you will be the go-to technical expert for Databricks' AI platform across our customers. You will help them move from AI experiments to governed, cost-efficient agents and ML systems running on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.

You will work with Account Executives and Solutions Architects to win strategic opportunities. You will design architectures for advanced agent and ML use cases and lead hands-on proofs of concept and MVPs. You will act as a trusted advisor to customer technical leaders on AI strategy, governance and economics. You will also shape our AI go-to-market in the region, enable the wider field team, and feed what you learn from customers back to Product and Engineering.

This role reports to the Manager, Specialist Solutions Architects – Switzerland, Austria & Eastern Europe.

The impact you will have

  • Win the technical decision for AI on Databricks. Lead discovery, architecture design, demos, proofs of concept and MVPs for agent, GenAI and ML use cases in competitive evaluations.
  • Design production-grade agent systems. Architect agents and multi-agent applications using Agent Bricks, Databricks Apps, MCP tools, Lakebase, AI Search and the Foundation Model APIs. Govern assets under Unity Catalog
  • Make agent quality measurable. Help customers build evaluation and observability into everything they ship, using MLflow tracing, domain-specific LLM judges, labelled evaluation datasets, release gates and production monitoring.
  • Govern AI at enterprise scale. Position the AI Gateway as the central control point for model access, guardrails, PII protection, usage tracking and rate limiting.
  • Scale your expertise. Enable SAs and partners with workshops, reusable assets and reference architectures. 
  • Influence the product. Bring structured customer feedback and requirements specific to the market to Product Management and Engineering.
  • Be a visible voice. Represent Databricks at customer executive briefings, meetups, conferences and in written content.

What we look for

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning, AI engineering or data science, including customer-facing technical work (pre-sales, consulting or technical leadership).
  • A track record of shipping LLM and agent systems to production, not just prototypes, including evaluation, monitoring and cost management.
  • Deep knowledge of agent architecture: tool use and function calling, MCP, agent memory and state, orchestrating multiple agents, and retrieval and context design.
  • Strong practical experience evaluating GenAI systems: tracing, LLM-as-a-judge, building evaluation datasets, regression testing and observability in production.
  • Hands-on with at least one modern agent framework (e.g. LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, DSPy). You should be framework-agnostic in how you design.
  • Solid understanding of the foundation-model landscape (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, open-weight models) and the trade-offs between quality, latency, cost and data residency.
  • Strong grounding in classical ML and MLOps: model development, deployment, monitoring and lifecycle management at scale.
  • Strong software engineering skills in Python and SQL. You use AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) daily and can build a working demo application quickly.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) and modern data platforms.
  • Proven ability to influence technical leaders up to CTO/CDO level and to explain complex AI topics in business terms.
  • Communication: Proven ability to communicate and teach complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

title: Staff Engineer, EU Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Our Infrastructure teams build the foundation that engineers at Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash build on: the compute, cloud, and networking capabilities that enable Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and run services at global scale. The EU Compute team has a specific focus on provisioning, scaling, and the efficient operation of GPU infrastructure for AI and ML workloads. This is an emerging space with plenty of greenfield opportunities.

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be a hands-on technical leader for this infrastructure work that crosses team and brand boundaries. You'll set direction for the platform, turn complex problems into deliverable plans, write and review production code, and help other engineers make sound decisions. It's an exciting time to join: we're building a global platform and the choices made now will shape how engineers across the company ship for years.

What you’ll be doing

  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation and incidents, raising the quality of infrastructure work across teams.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code (we use Terraform) and with designing systems that other engineering teams depend on.
  • A track record of leading complex technical work across teams, including architectural decisions, delivery, and operational follow-through. You have the breadth to collaborate and design across team and domain boundaries, and the depth to have hands-on impact.
  • Strong judgment on trade-offs in distributed systems, networking, security, reliability, and cloud cost.
  • Clear communication, and the ability to bring people together around a practical technical direction.

What we offer

  • Scope and influence. Shape infrastructure used globally, while staying close to the engineering. Your work will help product teams ship services with greater ease and confidence.
  • Real problems at global scale. Multi-cluster Kubernetes, AI / ML workloads, cloud networking, GitOps, and progressive delivery across a global company.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Set direction and see it through from design to operation, with the backing of a global engineering organisation spanning Europe and the US.
  • Growth. Room to expand your scope, whether through deeper technical leadership or broader cross-domain influence.
  • Great people. Work with talented engineers and leaders in a diverse, international environment, mentoring and learning from others.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you'll do

Kaluza runs the billing and payments engine behind some of the world's biggest energy retailers. This role builds and evolves the platform other engineering teams build on top of: the shared APIs, integration patterns, and technical standards that let billing and payments capability get built once and reused everywhere, instead of rebuilt separately for every new market or client relationship.

That matters because of where Kaluza is headed: as we grow into new markets and take on more of the world's largest energy retailers as clients, having a consistent, well-designed API platform is what lets new capability get adopted quickly and safely across every team that needs it, rather than each team solving integration and standards problems on its own. Getting this right directly shapes how fast Kaluza can extend billing and payments capability to new markets and clients.

We're also in the middle of reorganising how this part of the business works, moving toward one shared global core that every market configures rather than rebuilds. This role's remit, API platform and standards, is one of the technical foundations that shift depends on. Responsibilities include:

  • You'll own system design and architecture for the API Platform and Standards squad, not just a single service.

  • You'll create and challenge product and engineering proposals, backing design trade-offs with data.

  • You'll diagnose and resolve complex technical and product issues, including in areas outside your immediate domain.

  • You'll establish architectural patterns and technical standards that other teams build on top of.

  • You'll take ambiguous, loosely-defined technical requirements and turn them into a concrete plan others can execute against.

  • You'll influence engineering leadership, product, and adjacent squads to bring clarity and alignment on technical direction.

  • You'll mentor and upskill engineers beyond your immediate team, contributing to a wider learning culture.


What you'll bring
Ideally you’ll have:

  • Deep technical expertise applied to system design and architecture ownership across a squad, not just a single team or service.

  • Be able to create and challenge product and engineering proposals and make design trade-offs, backed by data.

  • A track record diagnosing and resolving complex technical and product issues, including in domains you aren't already close to.

  • Be skilled at establishing and driving adoption of architectural patterns and technical standards that other teams build on top of.

  • Be comfortable taking ambiguous, loosely-defined technical requirements and turning them into a concrete plan others can execute against.

  • Be accomplished at influencing both upwards and outwards, bringing clarity and alignment to engineering leadership, product, and adjacent squads on technical direction.

  • A track record mentoring and upskilling other engineers, and fostering a learning culture beyond your own immediate team.

  • Be comfortable operating in a high-integrity data domain (billing or payments), where reliability, security, and auditability come before speed.

  • Demonstrable customer obsession and a working-backwards practice: start from the problem other engineering teams or end customers have, and design the simplest platform capability that solves it.

  • A demonstrable record of applying AI/LLMs to deliver customer impact, not just adopting AI tooling internally.

What will set you apart 

  • Direct experience with API gateway, versioning, or developer-experience standards work at scale.

  • Direct experience in billing, payments, or financial-services domains.

  • Experience operating a "global core, configurable edge" or multi-market platform model (one engine, configuration at the edge, no client-specific forks of core logic).


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Come as you are

descriptionHtml:

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. title: Staff Robotic Sales Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

As our Staff Robotic Sales Engineer (m/f/d), you are RobCo's most senior technical voice in sales, owning your own deals alongside Account Executives while setting the technical standards that make the whole Robotics Sales Engineering team stronger. If something is broken, you fix it. If something can be automated, you build it.

This is a technical leadership role without people management. You keep a quota with your own Account Executives, and a fixed part of your time goes into raising the technical bar across the team. You work where modular robotics, software and AI come together, and you help bring physical AI from the lab into real production. Sales leadership turns to you first when they want to know how strong the pipeline really is.

Your Responsibilities

  • Define how the team judges feasibility, including real-world limits beyond data sheets, edge cases and clear no-go criteria

  • Develop our requirement workshop format and handover standards further

  • Step into complex or escalating deals across the team, set the technical direction and stay involved until the responsible RSE can carry the case forward

  • Make the go/no-go call on difficult feasibility cases, review concepts before handover and approve larger price indications

  • Build reusable assets such as calculation models, reference layouts per use case and enablement material for Sales and our partners

  • Track which use cases keep coming up and which we win or lose, and feed these insights into focus areas and the product roadmap

  • Shape onboarding and ramp-up for new RSEs and give technical feedback across the team

  • Pitch to strategic customers, give talks at trade fairs and events, and decide with Marketing and Product what we demo and why

  • Stay the technical lead for your own Account Executives and share their quota

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Extensive experience in technical pre-sales, application engineering or automation projects, including time at a senior level

  • Experience working against a quota and winning complex deals

  • A track record as the person colleagues turn to when a feasibility question gets hard

  • The ability to recognize patterns across projects and turn them into rules, templates and tools that others use

  • Experience leading through expertise, with the trust of engineers and sales leaders in your technical judgement

  • The confidence to make a go/no-go call and stand behind it, even when a deal is on the line

  • Strong presence on stage and in the boardroom, from trade fair talks to pitches to strategic customers

  • Fluent German (C1+) and fluent English (C1+), and willingness to travel, around 30% of the time

  • Experience in physical AI (AI-based perception, learning-based manipulation, autonomous robots) is a plus

  • Experience building sales or partner enablement programs is a plus

  • A background at a robot manufacturer or system integrator is a plus

How you'll make an impact

  • You drive important, ambiguous initiatives to outcomes and define standards and approaches your peers adopt.

  • You translate strategy into execution with significant latitude and design improvements aligned with business goals.

  • You are a recognized subject matter expert at RobCo and set the technical or functional standards in your area.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

descriptionHtml:

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the Role

As a Senior / Staff Product Manager, you will play a defining role in shaping the future of global money movement, embedded commerce, and unified payment acceptance at Airwallex. Operating at the intersection of core clearing/settlement infrastructure, merchant-facing experiences, and developer-first toolkits, you will own the end-to-end product lifecycle—from long-term strategy and architectural design to global roadmap execution.

In this role, you will bridge our online payments-for-platforms suite (enabling marketplaces and SaaS platforms to collect, route, and embed payments) with next-generation in-person commerce (smart POS, SoftPOS, hardware/software integrations, and loyalty engines). You will lead cross-functional teams to modernise omnichannel workflows, scale coverage across international markets, and deploy AI-native capabilities that remove operational friction for global merchants.

  • Own the vision, roadmap, and delivery plans for Airwallex’s platform payments and in-person commerce solutions, expanding our reach across key verticals, marketplaces, and global geographies.

  • Architect seamless integrations connecting POS terminal workflows and embedded platform checkouts directly to core clearing, ledgering, and multi-currency settlement engines—optimising for processing speed, fee netting, and dynamic routing.

  • Build developer-first APIs, unified commerce SDKs, and intuitive terminal management systems (TMS) that drastically reduce integration overhead for marketplaces, platforms, and third-party software vendors.

  • Pioneer AI workflows and autonomous agents across merchant onboarding, automated terminal setup, dispute/risk management, transaction reconciliation, and proactive loyalty/reward engine optimisations.

  • Expand capabilities around alternative payment methods (APMs), card acquiring, and integrated loyalty redemption loops to help platforms monetize payments and retain underlying sellers.

  • Ensure high-availability infrastructure (including offline POS processing resilience) while delivering tooling to help merchants satisfy regulatory mandates (PCI-DSS, EMV, PSD3/local frameworks) and manage platform risk.

  • Hands-on domain expertise in card acquiring, embedded finance/platform payment models (marketplaces, payfac-like setups), or card-present ecosystems (POS/SoftPOS, EMV/NFC standards, terminal management).

  • Proven ability to engage deeply with engineering on complex architectural discussions covering API design, distributed ledgers, high-throughput transaction processing, and hardware/software interfaces.

  • Exceptional analytical rigor with a track record of structuring complex ecosystem workflows, leveraging data to drive strategic trade-offs, and solving ambiguous problems.

  • High agency, persistence, and an entrepreneurial bias for action—capable of executing fast and driving complex initiatives to completion in a high-growth environment.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; proven success influencing cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders across diverse international regions.

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher with strong academic performance, preferably with coursework in Computer Science, Engineering, or quantitative disciplines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience designing or scaling developer-first payment APIs, unified commerce SDKs, or multi-sided platform architectures.

  • Hands-on exposure to deploying Generative AI, agentic workflows, or automated intelligence in fintech operations, transaction reconciliation, or onboarding.

  • Working familiarity with international card networks, alternative payment methods (APMs), cross-border settlement rails, and regional regulatory frameworks (UK/EU, APAC, or Americas).

We're not just maintaining what exists — we're rebuilding from the ground up with a bold vision: a modern, intuitive user experience with fast, streamlined workflows that make complex treasury operations feel effortless; a cloud-native architecture built on the latest technologies, designed for scalability, resilience, and speed; and first-class support for both traditional fiat currencies and digital assets, positioning Ripple Treasury at the leading edge of where treasury is headed.

  • Lead technical design reviews and provide constructive feedback that elevates the team's architectural thinking

Team Enablement & Mentorship:

  • Share your enthusiasm for tech trends, explore and learn new technologies, engage with tech communities, mentor fellow engineers, and lead in technical design and code evaluations

Enhance Agility:

  • Drive adoption of modern engineering practices that improve developer experience and productivity
  • Lead post-mortems and blameless retrospectives that turn incidents into learning opportunities

Strategic Technical Vision:

  • Anticipate future scalability challenges before they become blockers (e.g., handling 10x growth in transaction volume)
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend when/how to adopt them (e.g., new ML frameworks, database technologies)
  • Balance technical excellence with pragmatic delivery, knowing when "good enough now" beats "perfect later"

Ownership & Accountability:

  • Own critical systems end-to-end, from design through production support
  • Take responsibility for production reliability and proactively prevent incidents
  • Step into ambiguous situations and drive them to resolution without needing explicit direction
  • Lead by example in code quality, documentation, and operational excellence
  • Make tough technical trade-off decisions and clearly communicate the reasoning

What You’ll Work On:

  • Core platform modernization — the team is rebuilding the platform from the ground up: a modern, intuitive UX with fast workflows, and a cloud-native architecture designed for scalability, resilience, and speed
  • Real-time cash/liquidity data pipelines — building systems that give treasury professionals real-time transparency into cash and liquidity positions across banks, accounts, currencies, and legal entities worldwide
  • Digital asset support — engineering first-class support for both traditional fiat currencies and digital assets as part of the platform's forward-looking vision
  • AI features — developing and optimizing machine learning models for the GSmart AI engine that predicts cash flows and enables businesses to balance accounts in real time while making complex funding decisions

Essential Knowledge / Experience:

Years & Scope:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • 3+ years working on complex, business-critical systems in production
  • Experience working on products with significant scale
  • Strong communication skills with experience working in cross functional projects
  • Track record of delivering projects that span multiple quarters and require coordination across teams

Technical Leadership:
