  • Established technical patterns that were adopted across the team

Cloud & Infrastructure:

  • Proficiency with at least one major cloud platform (preferably Azure)
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)
  • Understanding of infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipeline design
  • Knowledge of observability: logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting strategies
  • Experience with microservices deployment patterns and service mesh concepts

Core Technologies:

  • Deep expertise with C#/.NET
  • Expert in relational databases (SQL Server ideally), including query optimization, indexing strategies, and data modeling
  • Deep experience in building large scale multi-tenant enterprise applications
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs and understanding when to use alternative patterns (GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks)
  • Deep knowledge in building applications using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and related technologies

descriptionHtml:

  1. Comprendre le terrain. Mener des entretiens dans toutes les équipes (ingénierie, projets, commerce, support client, etc..) pour identifier les irritants réels et les cas d'usage à fort potentiel.
  1. Poser un cadre. Cartographier les données par niveau de sensibilité et proposer des règles d'usage claires : quel outil pour quelle donnée.
  1. Prouver par l'exemple. Concevoir et déployer des POC sur les cas d'usage prioritaires, définir les indicateurs de gain et les mesurer.
  2. Embarquer les équipes. Rendre l'IA compréhensible et utile pour chacun : démonstrations sur le travail réel des équipes, ateliers, formations.
  1. Construire la feuille de route. Élaborer une feuille de route IA couvrant toutes les équipes et la présenter au CODIR.

En 6 mois : une feuille de route IA pour toutes les équipes, des POC déployés et utilisés, et un CODIR qui maîtrise réellement les possibilités de l'IA.

  2. Mois 2 à 4 : preuves de valeur. POC déployés sur les cas d'usage prioritaires, premiers gains mesurés, premiers référents IA formés, session de sensibilisation du CODIR.

title: Stage Energie/Mécatronique
descriptionHtml:
Ironflow Batteries est une startup qui conçoit une technologie innovante de batterie à flux redox, pensée pour pallier l’intermittence des énergies renouvelables sur le réseau électrique — un enjeu central de la transition énergétique.

La technologie développée repose sur des batteries aqueuses utilisant des complexes métalliques. Celles-ci ont la particularité de découpler la puissance délivrée de la quantité d’énergie stockée, grâce notamment à la taille modulable des réservoirs d’électrolyte.

Ironflow Batteries s’appuie sur des matériaux abondants et des complexes métalliques innovants, associés à une membrane performante et à faible coût. Ce positionnement technologique permet d’offrir une solution compétitive pour le stockage stationnaire de l’énergie.

Dans ce cadre, Ironflow Batteries recherche un ou une stagiaire à partir de début 2027 (début du stage au plus tard en avril 2026) et pour une durée de 5 à 6 mois. Le stage s’adresse à un profil de niveau Master, issu d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’un master universitaire orienté ingénierie. Il peut s’agir d’un stage de césure comme d’un stage de fin d’études.

Vos missions

Les missions pourront inclure des travaux de conception assistée par ordinateur (CAO), de prototypage, d’assemblage et de tests en conditions laboratoires ou réelles (réseau électrique), selon les priorités du moment. En raison de la diversité des compétences mobilisées, un temps d’apprentissage et de montée en compétence sera prévu.

Le profil recherché est celui d’une personne curieuse, adaptable, passionnée par le secteur de l’énergie et attirée par un environnement startup. Des compétences en programmation (Python ou autre) et en conception CAO (Solidworks ou autre) seront un atout apprécié.

title: Stage - Project Manager & Automation (F/H) - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Horizon Trading Solutions est une FinTech internationale indépendante, spécialisée dans les technologies de trading électronique multi-actifs depuis plus de 20 ans. Avec environ 160 collaborateurs répartis entre Paris, Rennes, Nantes, Montréal, Dubaï, Hong Kong, Bangkok et Singapour, nous accompagnons les institutions financières dans l'optimisation de leurs activités de trading grâce à des solutions technologiques innovantes.

Certifiée B Corp, Horizon s'engage en faveur d'une innovation responsable et a été récompensée à plusieurs reprises pour ses solutions, notamment avec le prix Best Sell-Side OMS 2025.

Le poste

Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire en automatisation et gestion de projet pour rejoindre notre équipe Client Delivery Management (CDM), dans le cadre d'un stage de 6 mois, avec un démarrage possible entre février et avril 2027.

Notre équipe CDM accompagne nos clients dans le déploiement, la personnalisation et l'évolution de notre plateforme de trading, de la connectivité API à la configuration des workflows de trading.

Dans une démarche d'amélioration continue, nous avons récemment déployé Rocketlane, une plateforme dédiée à la gestion de projets et à l'onboarding client.

Votre mission sera de développer des solutions d'automatisation, d'optimiser les processus existants et d'intégrer Rocketlane à nos outils internes, afin de simplifier le quotidien de nos chefs de projet, de fiabiliser le suivi des activités et de réduire les tâches répétitives.

Ce stage vous permettra d'évoluer à l'intersection de la technologie, de la gestion de projet et des marchés financiers, en participant à des projets concrets dans un environnement international.

Vos missions

  • Analyse et optimisation des processus : Étudier l'utilisation actuelle de Rocketlane et identifier les tâches manuelles pouvant être automatisées : création de projets à partir de modèles, relances, mises à jour de statuts et reporting.

  • Développement et automatisation : Concevoir et développer des scripts et des automatisations, notamment en Python, en exploitant les API et les webhooks de Rocketlane.

  • Intégration des outils : Améliorer l'interconnexion entre Rocketlane et nos outils internes (ticketing, support, documentation, annuaires clients) afin de limiter les doubles saisies et de fluidifier le partage d'informations.

  • Suivi et reporting : Contribuer à la création et à l'amélioration de tableaux de bord, d'indicateurs de performance et d'outils de suivi des projets.

  • Participation aux projets clients : Prendre part à des projets d'onboarding réels pour comprendre les besoins opérationnels, notamment les tests de connexion, la configuration des workflows de trading et la documentation.

  • Collaboration transverse : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Client Delivery, Développement, Support et Produit pour comprendre leurs besoins et proposer des solutions adaptées.

Profil recherché

  • Tu prépares un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 (Master 2 ou dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs) en informatique, ingénierie, finance ou dans un domaine équivalent.

  • Tu disposes de bonnes bases en programmation, idéalement en Python, et tu comprends le fonctionnement des API. Des connaissances en webhooks ou en outils d'automatisation sont un plus.

  • Tu es à l'aise aussi bien sur les aspects techniques (programmation, intégrations, automatisation) que fonctionnels (gestion de projet, processus métiers, besoins clients).

  • Tu maîtrises le français et l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, et tu es à l'aise pour communiquer dans un environnement international.

  • Tu es curieux(se), rigoureux(se), autonome et doté(e) d'un bon esprit analytique. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement des outils, identifier des pistes d'amélioration et proposer des solutions concrètes.

  • Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des interlocuteurs aux profils variés, techniques comme fonctionnels.

  • Tu t'intéresses aux nouvelles technologies et aux marchés financiers, et tu souhaites découvrir les enjeux du trading électronique dans un environnement FinTech.

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un projet concret et responsabilisant : Contribuez directement à l'amélioration des processus et des outils utilisés quotidiennement par notre équipe Client Delivery.

  • Une expérience technique et fonctionnelle : Développez vos compétences en programmation, automatisation, intégration d'API et gestion de projet dans un environnement FinTech.

  • Un environnement international : Échangez avec des collaborateurs et des équipes répartis en Europe, en Amérique du Nord, au Moyen-Orient et en Asie.

  • Un accompagnement personnalisé : Travaillez aux côtés de professionnels expérimentés et développez vos compétences sur des problématiques réelles.

  • Une culture collaborative : Rejoignez une entreprise à taille humaine, innovante et multiculturelle, où les initiatives et les idées sont encouragées.

  • Une gratification de stage comprise entre 1 300 € et 1 700 € brut par mois, selon votre profil conformément à la politique de l'entreprise.

title: Summer Intern 2027 - Alan Summer Internship Program
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

📍 Paris, on-site
🗓 Early June to end of August 2027
🎓 Students (incl. Polytechnique 2nd-year internship)

⭐ THE PROGRAM ⭐

This summer, for the first time, Alan is bringing in a cohort of interns for a 3-month internship, from June to August. This program is for students whose curriculum includes a summer internship.

This is not a "watch and learn" internship. Past interns and Founders Associates have shipped work that teams still use after they left:

  • An AI tool searching the web for fake documents used in insurance fraud. The findings started a fraud-prevention pilot with a major French insurer.

  • An automated system approving simple medical claims in one of Alan's international markets, with no manual review.

  • An AI agent for sales reps. Cuts prep time before every prospect meeting with a personalized meeting brief and pitch.

  • A national health insurance bid. It led to a new local company and its first General Manager hire.

  • Launched a new insurance product, from the regulator application to in-app design and customer support. Took the product from idea to a regulator-ready launch.

  • A public AI healthcare hackathon co-hosted with Mistral. Brought together top AI builders, with €10K+ in prizes and credits for the winners.

This summer, it's your turn.

⭐ WHAT YOUR SUMMER LOOKS LIKE ⭐

  • Weeks 1 & 2 - team sprint: you build a shared project in a mixed squad with other interns. You meet several teams and see how Alan works as a whole.

  • June to August - your project: you’ll take full ownership of a project that drives real value, working inside a host team with clear goals and the freedom to decide how to reach them. At the end of August, you demo it to the company.

  • All summer - the program: talks and workshops with Alan leaders including the CEO/CTO, weekly coffee chats with Alaners, and a mentor who helps you grow.

You'll join one track, based on your interests, and the projects available across:

  • Engineering

  • Data & AI

  • Product

  • Design & Research

  • Marketing

  • Customer Care

  • IT & Operations

And more!

⭐ KEY OUTCOMES ⭐

By the end of August, you will have:

  • Shipped a project that a real team uses, and demoed it to the company

  • Built with AI, data and code on real problems: shipped AI agents, automations and analyses that go to production

  • Worked closely with senior Alaners and Alan's leadership

  • Met a cohort of sharp students from top schools in France and abroad

  • Gained a 360° view of how a fast-growing company works

Strong interns may be invited back to Alan after graduation, as a Founder Associate or full-time hire.

⭐ PROFILE & COMPETENCIES ⭐

  • You build. You code, or build seriously with AI tools, and you have something to show us: a tool, a prototype, a side project, a hackathon project.

  • You learn fast. You're comfortable owning a project that isn't fully defined yet, and you figure things out before asking someone to show you.

  • Analytical sense. You frame the right questions and break down problems clearly.

  • High agency. When something is broken, your first instinct is to fix it.

  • Clear writing. At Alan, we work in writing, in English. You need to be fluent.

  • Growth mindset. You ask for feedback and use it.

  • Available for 3 months, from June to end of August 2027.

⭐ THE PROCESS ⭐

We know you have other offers to weigh, so our process is designed to be efficient:

  1. Application (tell us about something you've built)

  2. A short call with the team to meet you

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

International students welcome. If you apply through a university program (Princeton IIP, MIT MISTI, Penn GRIP, Waterloo Co-op), mention it in your application.

title: System Engineer - System Architecture - Contra
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 

The role

As a Systems Engineer for C-UAS System-of-Systems, you own the high-level architecture of a distributed air defence capability.

You define the top-level architecture (L0 and L1), partitioning the capability into network, sensor, and effector subsystems and the interfaces between them. The architecture is open and hardware agnostic: any qualified node can join the network. It is controlled centrally but is designed to keep operating when nodes are lost or contested, so that no single point of failure breaks the chain. This is the layer that enables engage-on-remote and launch-on-remote, where the effector need not sit with the sensor that cued it.

This is a role for someone who thinks at the level of the whole system. Your decisions on architecture, networking, and interfaces determine whether a distributed capability performs as one coherent whole under real operational conditions.

The day-to-day

  • Own the top-level (L0/L1) architecture of the C-UAS system-of-systems, partitioning the mission into network, sensor, and effector subsystems

  • Specify the network capabilities that let distributed nodes share a common air picture and coordinate engagements, including decentralised operation when the central command node is degraded or absent

  • Derive network, sensor, and effector requirements from the operational concept, and own the trade-offs between coverage, resilience, latency, and cost

  • Translate operational concepts into a coherent system architecture and clear engagement concepts, then hold that architecture consistent as the design matures

  • Keep the architecture open and hardware agnostic, establishing the interfaces that let any qualified node join the network

  • Enable engage-on-remote and launch-on-remote by defining how cueing, track handover, and fire control flow across nodes

  • Produce a structured architecture that can be exposed externally to partners and customers at the right level of abstraction, without disclosing sensitive detail

  • Collaborate daily with the situational awareness and interceptor integration teams, and with AI, software, and hardware engineers, to keep the system-of-systems coherent

You should apply if you

  • Have hands-on experience architecting distributed systems or systems-of-systems, ideally for defence, air defence, C-UAS, or comparable networked mission systems

  • Can define top-level architectures and derive network, sensor, and effector requirements from an operational concept

  • Understand distributed and decentralised system design: how nodes share state, degrade gracefully, and coordinate without a single point of failure

  • Have a strong foundation in requirements management and interface definition

  • Can communicate an architecture clearly to both internal engineering teams and external partners and customers

  • Hold a university degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace, Computer Science, or a related field

  • Are business fluent in German and English

  • Are willing to travel

  • Your personal values match ours: ownership, initiative, dedication to mission, speed and inclusiveness

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of tactical networking, mesh communications, or resilient data links in contested environments

  • Familiarity with air defence engagement concepts, kill-chain design, or NATO C-UAS framework

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 

  • Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

  • The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

  • Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

  • In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

  • We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

title: Talent community lead
descriptionHtml:
About the role

We're hiring a Founder Community Lead to build and run the top of our founder funnel. You'll make sure that every new venture we start has strong prospective founders already engaged before it needs one.

Founders Factory builds companies with corporate partners. Next year, we're aiming for 25 approved ventures in the next 12 months, and each venture needs a founder who pitches at the investment committee alongside our venture design team.

You'll own our Founder Bench: a small, high-quality community of pre-vetted founders, matched to the sectors and founder profiles our ventures need. You'll fill it through sourcing and partnerships, and keep it active through four events a quarter. You'll sit in the talent team to help matching founders to ventures.

What you'll do:

Pipeline building:

  • Build a steady flow of experienced founders, operators and domain experts in our partners' focus areas.

  • Run first conversations, write short founder notes, and tag each person by founder archetype, sector, stage and availability.

  • Share our standard founder deal with each person when they join the bench, so terms are clear before anyone commits time.

  • Build referral routes with our portfolio founders, investors, operator communities and university spinout offices.

Events:

  1. Sector founder drinks: 12–15 founders and operators around a theme from our partner's focus areas.

  2. Weekly Open studio office hours: a look at the problems we're working on, so prospective founders can see what building with us is like.

  3. Partner event: co-hosted with a feeder programme with a select group of universities

  4. Bench gathering: for founders already on the bench, to keep them engaged between ventures with managing a Slack or Whatsapp community or newsletters

Engagement:

  • Keep the founder data accurate, with every founder's archetype, sector, availability and last contact up to date in our tracker.

  • Keep founders engaged with regular updates, intros and early sight of new themes, so they're ready when a venture starts.

  • Give the talent team a ready longlist of 5–8 founders for each new venture within its first two weeks.

  • Report monthly on bench size, quality, diversity and how bench founders move through to trials and selection.

Who you are:

  • 3+ years in founder-facing work: VC platform or scouting, an accelerator or founder programme, startup community building, or founding a company yourself.

  • A network among founders and operators that you can open up quickly, and the instinct to grow it.

  • Good judgement on founders: you can tell a strong operator from a good storyteller in a first conversation, and explain why in writing.

  • A track record of running events that lead somewhere, from 15-person dinners to larger community nights, with clear follow-up.

  • The ability to sell an unusual offer: building a venture we've designed with a corporate partner, rather than your own idea.

  • Disciplined pipeline habits, keeping a CRM or tracker accurate across hundreds of relationships.

  • A real commitment to building diverse founder pipelines, and experience doing it.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of, or a network in, healthcare, deep tech or B2B sectors.

  • Experience working with corporate partners or in corporate venturing.

  • Familiarity with Airtable or similar tools.

title: Talent Lead
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs has grown to over 1,000 in three years, and the rate of growth is not slowing down. As Talent Lead, you will be in charge of one of the most visible and impactful functions in the company: hundreds of hires a quarter across Research, Engineering, GTM and Operations, in one of the most competitive talent markets in history. You’ll move Talent from a high-volume recruiting engine to a strategic partner that tells leaders what is achievable, and you’ll rebuild how we hire using the same AI products we make.

You'll run the entire Talent team (currently 20 - 30 recruiters, sourcers, and talent operations) across verticals, setting the strategy, building the systems, and staying hands-on where it matters. You'll report directly to the Operations Lead and be a close partner to the People team. This isn't a pure executive role - we want someone who still loves the craft of recruiting and can model what great looks like for the team around them.

The right person has done this before at scale - at a company that grew fast and hired harder. Your team will look to you not just for direction, but as someone they can genuinely learn from. This will be an opportunity to shape the direction of Talent at ElevenLab; where we go, how we get there and who we get there with. If you want to shape the future of the Talent industry by building industry-defining playbooks using the latest technology and AI solutions, whilst building an expert team - this might be your best fit yet.

In this role you will:

  • Lead the full talent function across Research, GTM, Engineering & Product, and G&A hiring - setting strategy, managing team performance, building a recruiter capacity engine, and driving outcomes across all verticals.

  • Shape Talent Operations: ATS (Ashby) configuration, headcount tracking, hiring velocity metrics, and recruiter tooling - ensuring the function runs with precision and minimal friction.

  • Identify innovative ways of approaching Talent: design the next-gen Talent org structure, envision how Talent processes can be agentified and work with the team to build ElevenLabs products throughout.

  • Act as a strategic partner to department heads and hiring managers, bringing market intelligence, pipeline health visibility, and honest counsel on what it takes to consistently win the best people in the market.

  • Build and maintain a strong talent brand through thoughtful candidate experience, community engagement, building a Talent events program and creative sourcing strategies.

  • Coach and develop a team of recruiters, establishing clear standards for quality of hire, speed, and candidate experience.

  • Partner with functional leaders across Research, Engineering, GTM, and Operations - acting as a trusted advisor who can challenge, align, and mobilize leaders around talent priorities and workforce strategy.

We’re moving quickly on this search. Applications close on 13 November 2026, and we’ll start reviewing right away, so we’d encourage you to apply early.

Requirements

  • Proven track record leading large TA functions at high-growth companies, with direct experience filling hundreds of roles per year across multiple functions and geographies.

  • Hands-on recruiting instincts - comfortable being in the weeds on critical searches, not just managing from a distance.

  • Strong people leader who builds, develops, and retains recruiting talent.

  • Sharp on process: able to design and iterate on systems, tooling, and workflows that make a team of 20–30 perform at a high level with AI.

  • Close collaborator with People, Finance, and business leaders - comfortable operating at the intersection of headcount planning, compensation, and hiring strategy.

  • Held a high bar for quality of hire while hitting aggressive volume, with the metrics to show it.

  • Advised founders and executive suite on workforce planning, and changed a plan with your judgment.

  • Worked with Finance, People and RevOps on headcount planning, capacity modelling, compensation and offer strategy.

  • Has recruited across the Americas, EMEA and APAC and understands the differences between markets.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere, with the ability to operate from New York or London strongly preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

title: Teamlead Customer Support & Sales (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du machst aus unserem Support ein Team, das Kund:innen hält und gewinnt

Bei eRecht24 melden sich jeden Tag Website-Betreiber, Online-Shops und Agenturen: per Ticket, per Telefon, mit Fragen zu Tarifen, Rechnungen und Rechtstexten. Hinter vielen dieser Anfragen steckt mehr als ein Supportfall: ein Upgrade, das hilft, eine Kündigung, die sich abwenden lässt, eine Agentur, die zwanzig Kundenprojekte im kleinsten Tarif verwaltet.

Wir suchen eine erfahrene Person, die unser Customer-Support-Team führt, den Betrieb stabil und messbar macht und daraus Schritt für Schritt eine Kundenberatung mit Vertriebsblick aufbaut. Du führst, du planst, und du bist selbst am Telefon.

Wer wir sind und wo wir stehen

eRecht24 ist Deutschlands größte Plattform für Rechtssicherheit im Web: Impressum Generator, Datenschutz Generator, Website Scanner und viele weitere Tools, kostenlos im Freemium-Bereich und vollumfänglich in eRecht24 PREMIUM (Basic, Business, Enterprise).

Die Firma ist in wenigen Jahren stark gewachsen und professionalisiert sich gerade: neue Rollen in Marketing, Product und Data, ein Data Warehouse, klarere Prozesse. Im Support sind die Werkzeuge da, ein modernes Ticketsystem und eine voll funktionsfähige Telefonanlage. Der Support betreut inzwischen die gesamte Unternehmensgruppe. Was fehlt, ist eine Führung, die daraus ein belastbares System macht.

Deine Aufgaben

Team führen und Betrieb steuern

  • Du führst das Customer-Support-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch, arbeitest Mitarbeitende ein und entwickelst sie weiter.

  • Du planst Einsätze, Urlaube und Vertretungen und sorgst dafür, dass wir erreichbar sind und Anfragen zeitnah bearbeitet werden.

  • Du analysierst Kontaktvolumen, Bearbeitungszeiten und Kapazität, erkennst Engpässe früh und begründest, wann wir mehr Leute brauchen.

Qualität, Prozesse und Systeme

  • Du etablierst Service-, Qualitäts- und Dokumentationsstandards, Gesprächsleitfäden und Kennzahlen.

  • Du bewertest unsere Support- und Telefoniesysteme, empfiehlst Verbesserungen und steuerst freigegebene Systemwechsel samt Migration.

Kundenberatung und Sales aufbauen

  • Du baust die telefonische Beratung aus: Inbound und Outbound, Produkt- und Tarifberatung, Unterstützung bei Tarifwechseln, Upselling, das wirklich zum Bedarf passt.

  • Kund:innen zurückgewinnen: Du holst gekündigte und inaktive Kund:innen zurück, verstehst, warum sie gegangen sind, und entwickelst mit dem Marketing die passenden Angebote.

  • Du bindest Kund:innen und beugst Kündigungen vor, gerade bei Business- und Enterprise-Kund:innen und Agenturen.

  • Du spielst Kundenwissen zurück: Wer sind unsere besten Kund:innen, was brauchen sie, woran scheitern sie? Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Product schärfst du so unser Bild der idealen Kund:innen.

So verteilt sich deine Zeit: rund 40 % operativ im Kundenkontakt, davon ein guter Teil am Telefon, 30 % Führung und Kapazitätssteuerung, 30 % Prozesse, Telefonie und Systeme. In der Einarbeitung ist der operative Anteil höher.

Deine ersten Monate

  • Monat 1 bis 3: Produkt, Tarife und Kundenanliegen kennenlernen, das Team übernehmen, Erreichbarkeit stabilisieren, Kapazitäten und Engpässe analysieren.

  • Monat 3 bis 6: Qualitätsstandards und Kennzahlen etablieren, Telefonberatung strukturiert aufbauen, Systeme bewerten, Personal- und Prozessbedarf ableiten.

  • Danach: Beratung und Sales weiterentwickeln, Reporting aufbauen, Prozesse standardisieren und skalierbar machen.

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Customer Support, Customer Success, Inside Sales oder Contact Center, idealerweise bei einem SaaS- oder Abo-Anbieter

  • Erfahrung als Führungskraft eines Support-, Service- oder Inside-Sales-Teams, inklusive Einsatz- und Kapazitätsplanung

  • Du hast Inbound- und Outbound-Telefonie selbst gemacht und aufgebaut und telefonierst gern: erst zuhören, dann beraten

  • Du erkennst Kaufsignale und Einwände und gehst mit beiden souverän um, ohne Rabatt als ersten Reflex

  • Sicher mit Ticket- und Telefoniesystemen; idealerweise hast du schon einmal ein System ausgewählt, eingeführt oder migriert

  • Du arbeitest mit Kennzahlen und kannst Personalbedarf nachvollziehbar begründen

  • Strukturiert, verlässlich, entscheidungsfreudig im Tagesgeschäft

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, in Wort und Schrift. Du berätst unsere Kund:innen am Telefon auf Deutsch

  • Plus: Erfahrung im Aufbau eines Service- oder Beratungsbereichs, mit Retention und Rückgewinnung, mit Agenturen als Kund:innen, Nähe zu Website-Recht oder Datenschutz

Ein bestimmter Abschluss ist nicht nötig. Entscheidend sind Führungserfahrung, Aufbaukompetenz und die Lust, selbst mit anzupacken.

Warum sich die Rolle lohnt

  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entscheidest selbst über Einsatzplanung, Prioritäten, Standards, Leitfäden und Einarbeitung.

  • Werkzeuge sind da: Ticketsystem, Telefonanlage, Data Warehouse. Du musst nicht bei null anfangen, sondern daraus ein System bauen.

  • Sichtbarer Impact: Jede gerettete Kündigung, jedes passende Upgrade ist messbar und wird gesehen.

  • Kurze Wege: Du berichtest direkt an die Marketing-Leitung und arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Product und IT.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Vollzeit

  • Hybrid in Berlin, mindestens drei Präsenztage pro Woche vor Ort

  • Operative Mitarbeit während unserer Supportzeiten von 9 bis 16 Uhr

  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung

Klingt nach dir?

Dann lass uns sprechen: 15 Minuten Kennenlernen, ein einstündiges Fachgespräch, dann Team und ein kurzes Rollenspiel aus unserem Alltag.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beantworte uns stattdessen in der Bewerbung kurz drei Fragen:

  1. Welches Team hast du zuletzt geführt (Größe, Aufgabe), und was hast du dort als Erstes verändert?

  2. Welche Kundin oder welchen Kunden hast du zuletzt zurückgeholt oder von der Kündigung abgehalten, und wie?

  3. Wie viel Zeit verbringst du heute selbst am Telefon mit Kund:innen?

title: Teamleider logistiek Veenendaal
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een leidinggevende die graag zichtbaar is op de werkvloer? Weet jij medewerkers te motiveren en de logistieke operatie soepel te laten verlopen? Dan zoeken wij jou als teamleader logistiek in Veenendaal. Als teamleader logistiek geef je dagelijks leiding aan een operationeel team. Je stuurt op kwaliteit, veiligheid en resultaat, coacht medewerkers en zorgt ervoor dat de operatie efficiënt verloopt.


Waar kom je te werken?

Je werkt nauw samen met collega teamleaders en de operations manager. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat duizenden pakketten iedere dag veilig en op tijd worden verwerkt. Je werkt in een vast roulerend rooster:

  • Leidinggeven, coachen en ontwikkelen van medewerkers.

Wat neem je mee?

  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring als leidinggevende.

  • Je stuurt op resultaten en KPI's.

  • Je communiceert makkelijk en coacht medewerkers.

  • Je ziet kansen om processen te verbeteren.

  • Je bent bereid om in wisselende diensten te werken.

Over DPD Nederland

Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega’s die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou.

Onze cultuur is ondernemend, betrouwbaar en mensgericht. Wat ooit begon als een nuchter MKB-bedrijf leeft nog steeds voort: praktisch, sociaal en trots. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, samenwerking en zelf aanpakken. Uitdagingen gaan we niet uit de weg. Dat zit in ons DNA.

We groeien hard, hebben grote ambities en jij hoort er straks écht bij. Samen maken we het verschil.

Solliciteer eenvoudig via onderstaande sollicitatiebutton. Wij nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op. Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan zetten we samen de volgende stappen in de sollicitatieprocedure.

  2. Assessment: je maakt een online assessment thuis.

  3. Tweede gesprek: we bespreken de resultaten en gaan verder in op de functie.

  4. Aanbod: is er een match? Dan doen we je een aanbod.

Vragen? Neem gerust contact op met onze corporate recruiter, Donne van der Wal via +31 6 29 989 532.

title: Tech Lead (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We are hiring a backend-leaning Tech Lead to lead a team of 3-4 engineers and own the tech for a part of Superchat’s product.

This is a hands-on leadership role: You’ll spend roughly half your time designing and building software and the other half enabling your team to perform at its best. Work directly on architecture, development and important projects while creating the clarity, feedback and environment your engineers need to deliver an excellent product

Who We Want

A strong, current backend engineer.
You bring 3+ years of experience as a Senior or Staff Engineer and remain deeply involved in software development. You are comfortable owning, designing and building crucial parts of production systems.

Experienced with the JVM ecosystem.
You have substantial experience with Java or another JVM language. Kotlin and AWS experience are a plus, since our backend runs on Kotlin/Quarkus.

Ready to lead people.
You may already have worked in a hybrid Tech Lead role, have been an Engineering manager for a short time or be taking your first steps in people leadership after successfully owning projects and architecture. What matters is that you genuiely want to help people grow

Strong at delivery.
You know how to turn product goals into reality. You are used to work in fast-paced startups and are a driver to increase velocity.

Product-minded.
You care about solving the customers problem. You engage with product decisions, challenge assumptions constructivly and find pragmatic solutions to build things in a lean way.

Clear communicator.
You are able to explain complex technical things in details to Engineers and in an understandable way to non-technical stakeholders. You create alignment and motivate people

Excited about AI-assisted development.
You are already using AI in your development workflow and are eager to explore how it can improve engineering speed, quality and the way teams work.

Who We Don’t Want

Pure people manager. You no longer want to work directly on software. This role requires meaningful, ongoing involvement in architecture, implementation, code review, and technical problem-solving.

Hero engineer. You want to make every important technical decision yourself or become the bottleneck for the team. Your job is to raise the effectiveness of the whole team, not to be the only person who can solve difficult problems.

Pure delivery manager. You treat engineering as a ticketing operation focused only on timelines and task tracking instead of product quality, technical health, and team growth. We need engineering leaders, not project coordinators.

Remote-only operator. You prefer fully remote work and don’t want to actively build relationships and culture in person with the team. We believe strong engineering leadership requires regular in-person collaboration and presence in Berlin.

Your Day To Day

  • Spend approximately 50% of your time contributing directly to architecture, development, code reviews, and important technical projects.
  • Lead a team of 3-4 engineers and take responsibility for its effectiveness, technical quality, and delivery.
  • Work closely with your Product Manager to understand customer problems, shape solutions, scope projects, and set priorities.
  • Establish clear technical direction while enabling engineers to own decisions and develop their judgment.
  • Run regular 1:1s, give actionable feedback, and support each engineer’s development and performance.
  • Remove blockers, manage dependencies, and help the team identify delivery risks early.
  • Improve engineering practices and explore effective uses of AI throughout the software-development lifecycle.
  • Contribute to hiring through technical interviews, structured feedback, and candidate conversations.

Stakeholders

Director of Engineering: Your manager and partner on people development, calibration, processes.
Direct Reports: Engineers in your team; you own their development, performance and growth
Product Manager: PMs own what and why; you own how (delivery) and who (people)
CTO and CPO: We are a lean organization with a flat hierarchy. You will regulary disccuss the direction of architecture with the CTO and product with the CPO

Why People Choose Us

Mission that matters. Real impact on small businesses, not abstract metrics

Funded with conviction. $18M raised and profitable

Modern stack. Kotlin/Quarkus, AWS, TypeScript/React/Next.js, and LangGraph for AI-powered features

Squad-based organization. Each squad owns its domain end-to-end with real ownership and autonomy

Two clear career tracks. We support both individual contributor growth (up to Staff level) and Management Paths with explicit reversibility between both and Tech Lead being the first level of management that is still quite hands-on

Product-led structure. PMs report directly to the CPO, keeping product strategy focused, consistent, and clearly prioritized

Hybrid by design. Our Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg is the center of gravity, with two work-from-home days as the standard setup

Direct feedback culture. Honest, direct, and kind feedback is part of how we work together - in 1:1s, retrospectives, and everyday collaboration

Benefits & Culture

  • Choose between an Urban Sports Club/John Reed membership or a public transport/Dance subscription
  • Regular company and team events
  • Annual personal development budget of €500 for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more
  • An inclusive and exciting startup culture that enables fast professional and personal growth
  • Beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment

We want to build a community, not just a company.

It’s important to us to create an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together - whether that’s through HYROX training, golfing, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or whatever kind of community you’d like to help build here!

We're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the description. At Superchat, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously.

Relocating to Berlin? We support you with practical relocation help. You'll feel home in no time.

We look forward to your application!

title: Tech Lead - New Customers Team
descriptionHtml:
Tech Lead - New Customers Team

Hybrid in London, UK

We’re looking for a Tech Lead

You'll lead the engineering behind how new businesses become iwoca customers – the application they fill in, the checks they go through, and the offer they get.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The New Customers team owns everything from a business's first application to a funded loan: the application flow, the logic that routes each application, the documents we ask customers for, and the models that set loan amounts and pricing. Its measure of success is the customer lifetime value it adds between sign-up and first loan.

The team sets its own goals and direction. It brings together engineers, data scientists, and product and strategy people. It partners closely with credit risk on the trade-offs behind every lending decision. Knowledge sharing is central to how the team works, supported by regular forums to share findings, and dedicated research and development time.

You'll lead two engineers and report to the head of engineering for iwoca's customer journey, from first application to repeat lending.

The role

As the Tech Lead, you'll spend most of your time building. The team is moving its offer logic out of a legacy monolith into a new service. It's the biggest change in a decade to the system behind iwoca's lending decisions. The next phase is yours to lead.

  • Autonomy and ownership. You'll shape what the team builds, decide how to build it, and own what goes live. You'll set its engineering roadmap, including what to pull out of the monolith, what to rewrite, and in what order.

  • Technical complexity. You'll design the team's part of the new service, which turns models and rules into a lending decision and optimises each offer across amount, duration, fee, and interest rate. You'll keep it reliable in production, easy to change as the models evolve, and able to show how it reached each decision.

  • Experimentation and learning. You'll build the systems that let data scientists test new models on live applications. Some experiments run for years, until each loan reaches the end of its term. You'll see the long-term results of the team's lending decisions.

  • Influence. You'll get colleagues across iwoca behind technical work that competes with new features for time.

  • Leadership and growth. You'll line-manage and coach the team's engineers, setting context and helping them own projects end to end. As the team grows, you'll decide the skills and make-up it needs, and hire the engineers to match.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Technical leadership. You've led a team of engineers for at least two years, including line management, while still remaining hands on.

  • Backend engineering. You have deep expertise in at least one object-oriented language. You've designed, built, and run customer-facing backend systems in production.

  • Commercial or product thinking. You take a business goal, get to the root of what's needed and why, and turn it into a technical plan. You can explain a trade-off in terms of what it means for customers and the business.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to deliver engineering work you couldn't have done alone. You help your team do the same. You judge where it's useful. You check its output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Lending or payments experience. You've worked in lending, payments, or another domain where engineering decisions carry financial risk.

  • Experimentation. You've built systems that run controlled experiments, especially long-running ones.

  • Legacy migration. You've moved business-critical logic out of a complex legacy monolith and kept everything that depends on it working.

  • Working with data scientists. You've worked with data scientists from prototype to production, and know their work well enough to challenge it.

  • Python stack. You've worked with Python, Django, and PostgreSQL.

  • Frontend. You've built frontend features as well as backend services.

The salary

We expect to pay from £100,000 to £130,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Compensation: £100K – £130K

title: Technology Transformation - Senior
descriptionHtml:
Eight Advisory est un cabinet leader sur le marché du conseil financier et opérationnel, indépendant, spécialisé en Transaction, Restructuration et Transformation d’entreprises.

Nous accompagnons les dirigeants, les actionnaires, les banques et les investisseurs potentiels dans leurs décisions.

En très forte croissance depuis notre création fin 2009, Eight Advisory compte aujourd’hui plus de 1100 collaborateurs dont 129 associés et continue de se développer. Nous sommes présents en France, Belgique, Allemagne, Royaume-Uni, Suisse, Pays-Bas, USA, Espagne, Italie ainsi que dans une trentaine d’autres villes dans le monde à travers notre réseau de cabinets indépendants "Eight International".

Dans le cadre de nos missions, nous axons notre développement sur une approche mixte IT et financière, du diagnostic jusqu’à la mise en place des recommandations et nous intervenons en collaboration étroite avec les membres de la Direction Générale.

En rejoignant notre équipe Transformation IT, vous interviendrez principalement dans les contextes suivants :

  • Accompagnement des opérations M&A :

    • Dans un contexte de transaction, vous participerez aux « IT Due Diligences » dans lesquels vous présenterez un état des lieux de l’entreprise d’un point de vue IT : organisation de la DSI, stratégie et projets, infrastructure, applications, analyses des dépenses IT.

    • Dans un contexte de détourage d’actifs

      • Vous réaliserez une « IT Due Diligence » de ou des entités concernées en insistant sur les enjeux de dépendance et d’adhérence vis-à-vis du groupe / du vendeur ;

      • Vous évaluerez les éléments IT ayant un impact sur la valeur des actifs ;

      • Vous participerez à l’élaboration de plan de séparation et à la rédaction des TSA.

    • Dans un contexte d’intégration

      • Vous définirez la stratégie d’intégration de l’entité cible, la recherche de synergies, la définition et la déclinaison opérationnelle de projets d’intégration, l’optimisation des coûts et du planning d’intégration ;

      • Vous challengerez les propositions d’intégration d’éventuels prestataires.

      • Vous participerez au suivi des différents chantiers d’intégration.

  • Conduite de la transformation IT & Digitale :

    • Vous participerez à la définition de plans de transformation IT et digitale, visant à soutenir la stratégie de développement ou de reconstruction de l’entreprise ;

    • Vous travaillerez à l’élaboration de schémas directeurs : planning, coûts, ressources, priorisation des projets, etc. ;

    • Vous pourrez suivre et piloter les différents chantiers de ce schéma directeur pour en assurer le bon déroulement.

  • Pilotage et amélioration de la performance :

    • Vous assisterez nos clients dans l’amélioration et le contrôle de leur performance IT, en particulier à l’audit de projets IT et à la revue de la performance de la DSI ;

    • Vous accompagnerez nos clients dans la rédaction de cahier des charges, en les assistant dans le choix des outils répondant à leurs besoins ;

    • Vous participerez à la définition et mise en œuvre de plan d’actions impactant l’EBITDA et/ou la trésorerie (réduction des coûts IT, réorganisation de la DSI, optimisation des projets, etc.) ;

    • Dans le cadre d’un accompagnement de nos clients en situation de perte de rentabilité, manque de visibilité ou de compréhension des flux de la part des managers (actionnaires ou société mère), vous participerez à la réalisation de diagnostics mêlant finance & IT, à l’accompagnement à la renégociation de contrats, à l’élaboration de plans d’amélioration de la rentabilité et de rationalisation de la DSI, puis à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle.


Nous recherchons pour ces missions des candidats de formation supérieure (Bac+5 –école d’ingénieur ou école de commerce de rang A), ayant acquis une expérience probante parmi les suivantes :

  • Une expérience dans le conseil durant laquelle il/elle aura développé de solides compétences IT & digitales avec une appétence pour l’analyse des impacts financiers attendus.

  • Une expérience opérationnelle dans une structure reconnue pour son excellence dans les domaines informatiques et / ou digitaux.

  • Une bonne connaissances des outils présents sur le marché.

Vous êtes dotés de qualités relationnelles et analytiques reconnues. Curieux, dynamique, vous faites preuve d'esprit d'équipe et vous pratiquez couramment l’anglais dans le cadre de vos missions (la pratique d’une seconde langue étrangère sera un plus). Vous êtes motivé par le challenge d’intervenir dans des contextes à fort enjeux stratégiques marqués par des opérations de haut de bilan et/ou de retournement et d’élargir vos compétences sur les dimensions IT, financières et opérationnelles.

title: Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Test Engineer - Output-/CCM-Systeme

Für unseren Kunden aus Bern, suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n, motivierte:n und aufgeschlossene:n Test Engineer - Output-/CCM-/Dokumenten-Management-Systemen.

Diese 50% Position kann möglicherweise mit der Test Management Position (ebenfalls 50%) kombiniert werden.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Analysieren der bestehenden Dokumentenlogik und Ableiten von Testfällen, insbesondere für komplexe regelbasierte Varianten (if-then-else-Logik, Textbausteine, Datenanreicherung)
  • Konzipieren und Umsetzen eines automatisierten Alt-/Neu-Vergleichs auf Basis des XML-Datenstroms aus OUTPUT (Vergleich von Inhalt, Layout und Ausgabeformaten)
  • Erstellen und Pflegen von Use-Case-basierten Testdaten (synthetisch oder anonymisiert) für die relevanten Geschäftsfälle
  • Mitarbeit beim Erfassen der Dokument-Trigger sowie beim Aufbau von Testmechanismen für zeitgesteuerte, nicht manuell auslösbare Dokumente (z.B. Mahnungen)
  • Durchführen von Integrations-, End-to-End- sowie Performance- und Massentests (Volumen von ca. 100 Mio. Seiten pro Jahr)
  • Prüfen der Ausgabe über alle Kanäle (physischer Druck, digitale Kanäle) inkl. Ausgabesteuerung, Bündelung und Jobverarbeitung
  • Fehleranalyse, Dokumentation und Nachtesten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Entwicklung; Unterstützung der Fachbereiche im UAT

Dein Profil:

  • Ausgewiesene Arbeitserfahrung als Test Engineer im Bankenumfeld
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in XML, XPath/XSLT sowie SQL und im Umgang mit grossen Datenmengen
  • Ausbildung/Zertifikat ISTQB Foundation Level, idealerweise Advanced Test Automation Engineer (oder vergleichbar)
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Customer Communication Management / Output-Management
  • Erfahrung in Erstellung und Management von Testdaten, inkl. Anonymisierung
  • Erfahrung in agilen Teams (z.B. SAFe/Scrum) sowie analytische, strukturierte und selbständige Arbeitsweise
  • Einwandfreies Leumundszeugnis (keine Betreibungen oder Strafregistereinträge)
  • Fliessende Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch

title: UK Summer Internship 2027 - Solutions AI LAB
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Baringa is looking for talented 2027 Summer Interns to join our Solutions & AI Lab team.

Our Internship

Our eight week Summer Internship Programme is designed to give you hands-on experience, meaningful responsibility, and a true insight into life at Baringa. Over the course of the programme, you’ll work alongside experienced consultants and specialists on real projects, develop valuable skills through tailored learning opportunities, and build connections across the business. Whether you’re exploring your career options or looking to kick-start your professional journey, our internship offers a supportive environment where you can learn, grow, and make an impact.

What's in it for you?

Well, it’s up to you. Baringa is what you make it.

Our Summer Internship Programme is designed to help you build your skills, expand your network, and gain first-hand experience of consulting. As well as making a meaningful contribution from day one, you'll have the chance to explore future career opportunities at Baringa, including the opportunity to be considered for a permanent Analyst role after graduation.

Our Summer Internship opportunities are available across a range of our Capability business units. Explore the summaries below to learn more about each team and discover where your skills and interests could make an impact. You can also find additional information about each team on our website.

About our Solutions & AI Lab Team:

Our Solutions & AI Labs (SAIL) practice focuses on helping clients control their data, turn them into actionable insights and better leverage them through the use of Machine Learning solutions directly embedded into business processes. We support clients across a number of industries and offer deep expertise in AI, ML, Cloud and Managed Solutions. We are seeking passionate and dynamic ML engineers who are excited by building production Machine Learning solutions.

Desirable skills & degrees: A degree in a STEM related field is required, but degrees in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics and Engineering are preferred.

Requirements

  • Applicants should be graduating in 2028 and be in the penultimate year of their bachelor’s or master’s Degree studies.
  • Applicants must have the permanent right to work in the UK now and in the future. All applicants will be asked for proof if invited to an assessment centre. Please note we’re unable to sponsor individuals for this opportunity.

 Any questions surrounding this please contact us at Key dates

Assessment centres: January 2027
Internship start: Monday 5th July 2027
Internship end: Friday 27th August 2027

This is a paid full-time internship.

For further information, please read our Summer Internship 2027 pack

What a career at Baringa will give you

Putting People First. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. title: User Acceptance Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:

title: wo-stage woningmarkt onderzoek: verhuisketens, doorstroom en ouderenwoningen
descriptionHtml:
wo-afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij die analytische wo-student die nieuwsgierig is naar de doorstroom op de woningmarkt?
Krijg je energie van onderzoek doen, werken met data en programmeren in R?
Wil je jouw onderzoeksvaardigheden inzetten voor een actueel maatschappelijk vraagstuk?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Verhuisketens geven inzicht in de doorstroom op de woningmarkt en zijn daardoor actueel en relevant. Het CBS heeft een methode ontwikkeld om deze ketens in beeld te brengen. Het dashboard Verhuisketens in Nederland toont onder meer de gemiddelde lengte van een verhuisketen. Er is echter nog veel ruimte voor verdieping.

Tijdens deze stage kun je afstudeeronderzoek doen naar de rol van ouderenwoningen in de doorstroom op de huizenmarkt. Je kunt daarin op zoek gaan naar antwoorden op de volgende vragen:

  • In hoeverre draagt het bouwen van ouderenwoningen bij aan de doorstroom op de woningmarkt?

  • Wat is de invloed van vergrijzing en overlijden van ouderen op de doorstroom en het woningaanbod?

Heb je zelf een goede onderzoeksvraag die aansluit bij dit thema, dan is daar ook ruimte voor.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

De afdeling Beleidsstatistiek bestaat uit 70 collega’s verdeeld over Den Haag en Heerlen. Er werken onderzoekers en projectleiders met veel verschillende studieachtergronden binnen onze afdeling. Wij stellen cijfers samen die gebruikt worden voor het ontwikkelen, monitoren en verbeteren van beleid, vaak met een thema-overstijgend karakter. We zijn samenwerkingspartner op het gebied van data-gedreven werken bij overheden.

Dit breng jij mee

Je bent bijna klaar met jouw wo master-opleiding in de sociale wetenschappen, demografie, ruimtelijke ordening of een aanverwante opleiding en zoekt een afstudeerstage om je opleiding succesvol af te ronden.

Daarnaast:

  • heb je (enige) ervaring met programmeren in R;

  • kun je zelfstandig onderzoek uitvoeren en uitkomsten analyseren;

  • weet je hoe je met verschillende methoden en technieken onderzoek doet.

Kernwoorden die jou omschrijven zijn enthousiast, proactief en analytisch.

Omdat alle communicatie tijdens de stage – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • jouw vakkennis vergroot en werkervaring opdoet;

  • programmeervaardigheden toepast in de praktijk;

  • leert werken met CBS-data.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

  • Employer Branding: Partner with the team to shape our homepage messaging, craft engaging brand content, and bring our company culture to life.

  • Performance Marketing: Help set up, track, and optimize paid ad campaigns, blending your creative instincts with sharp analytics.

Your Profile

  • Fluent in English & German: Both languages are an absolute must-have (written and spoken).

  • Social Media Native: You live and breathe current trends, memes, and platform formats. Having your own social media channel with a few thousand followers is a huge plus!

  • First Experience: Prior experience from a marketing internship, working student role, or side hustle is a major advantage.

  • Balanced Mindset: You are highly creative, yet analytical enough to look at data and understand what drives performance.

  • Drive & Energy: Proactive, eager to learn, and ready to take ownership from Day 1.

  • Location & Availability: Based in Hamburg or surrounding areas, available for 2.5 days per week (working student) or full-time (internship). Preferred working days: Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.

Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions

title: Working Student Platform Engineering & DevOps (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über KnowWay

Wir bei KnowWay entwickeln KI-Agenten für kritische Infrastruktur – Energie, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Sektor. Überall dort, wo Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datensouveränität keine Kompromisse zulassen, automatisieren wir Geschäftsprozesse mit KI.

Die Rolle

Als Werkstudent im Bereich Platform Engineering, Systemadministration und DevOps verantwortest Du einen großen Teil unserer internen IT: Du betreibst den Technologie-Stack eines wachsenden KI-Startups und machst ihn robust und sicher.

Dabei arbeitest Du mit hoher Eigenständigkeit. Du bringst eigene Vorschläge für Architektur und Toolauswahl ein, triffst Entscheidungen mit uns gemeinsam und setzt sie selbst um.

Zusätzlich gestaltest Du die Infrastruktur unserer Produkte mit – von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Engineers.

Der Umfang liegt bei 15–20 Stunden pro Woche, flexibel planbar neben Deinem Studium.

Aufgaben

  • Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer internen IT-Landschaft – von Identitäten und Geräten bis zu Servern und Entwicklerwerkzeugen

  • Architektur- und Toolentscheidungen vorbereiten, bewerten und eigenverantwortlich umsetzen

  • Automatisierung wiederkehrender Aufgaben und Infrastructure as Code

  • Betrieb und Ausbau von Container-Plattformen sowie CI/CD-Pipelines

  • Absicherung des Stacks: Zugriffskonzepte, Härtung, Patch-Management und Monitoring

  • Konzeption und Umsetzung der Infrastruktur für unsere KI-Produkte gemeinsam mit unseren Engineers

  • Dokumentation von Setups, Abläufen und Entscheidungen, damit das Team sie nachvollziehen kann

Das Team

Du arbeitest direkt mit unseren Gründern sowie unserem Plattform- und Delivery-Team aus AI und Software Engineering zusammen. Die Infrastruktur unserer Produkte entsteht im engen Austausch mit den Engineers, die darauf entwickeln – kurze Wege und direkte Abstimmung sind dabei selbstverständlich.

Qualifikation

Must-haves

  • Du bist immatrikulierte/r Student/in im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.

  • Du hast schon Server selbst aufgesetzt und betrieben und weißt, wie man sie absichert, überwacht und bei Problemen debuggt – ob im Homelab, im Studium oder im Job

  • Verständnis und erste Erfahrungen mit Container-Plattformen wie Kubernetes, OpenShift oder vergleichbaren Systemen

  • Kenntnisse von Cloud-Infrastruktur und ihren Konzepten

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Git

  • Eigenständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen

  • Interesse an IT-Sicherheit und regulierten Umgebungen

  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Engineers und daran, technische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar zu begründen

  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher

Für uns zählen praktische Erfahrungen mehr als Zertifikate. Homelab, eigene Server, Open-Source-Beiträge oder GitHub-Repositories sehen wir uns deshalb besonders gerne an.

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung mit KI- und GenAI-Tooling, z. B. LLM-APIs, Agenten-Frameworks oder dem Betrieb von Modellen

  • Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Terraform

  • Erfahrung mit CI/CD-Pipelines .z.B. mit GitHub Actions

  • Administration von Microsoft 365, z. B. Entra ID, Intune und Exchange Online

Benefits

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, abgestimmt auf Vorlesungen und Prüfungsphasen

  • Echte Verantwortung für einen produktiven Tech-Stack statt Nebenaufgaben

  • Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum bei Architektur und Toolauswahl

  • Modernes GenAI-Umfeld mit Fokus auf produktive AI Agents

  • Direkter Kontakt zu Fachbereichen und Entscheider

  • Wertschätzendes Team und kurze Entscheidungswege

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents und Firmenfeiern sorgen für den gemeinsamen Austausch.

title: Working Student, SpaceOps
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

The Space Operations team is crucial to Planet's success, responsible for maintaining and optimizing the health and productivity of the world's largest Earth Observation satellite constellation. Our team spans North America and Berlin. Given the scale of our fleet, automation is at the heart of our operations. You'll develop and maintain critical software, transforming large datasets into actionable metrics.

As a Working Student, you'll support daily satellite operations, analyze data, triage and resolve anomalies, run on-orbit experiments, test and deploy software both on the ground and in orbit, and commission satellites. You'll work closely with hardware and software experts across teams to debug anomalies, enhance or create services, and provide operational insights to shape our next-generation satellites. 

We are looking for a data-driven self-starter with effective communication skills that collaborates well within a technical team and adapts quickly to changing tasks and contexts.

This part-time, hybrid role is based at our Berlin office which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Develop and maintain real-time, mission-critical software solutions for satellite operations
  • Write scripts to aggregate satellite data and generate system monitoring metrics
  • Analyze data to identify issues and inefficiencies in the full stack of services and propose solutions to improve productivity
  • Drive improvements to fleet capacity and productivity through process enhancements
  • Monitor satellite health and perform on-orbit experiments

What You Bring:

  • Ongoing BSc in engineering or computer science
  • Proficiency in software development, particularly in Python or equivalent languages
  • Data-driven mindset with experience in statistical analysis
  • Proactive, self-starter approach to engineering and problem-solving
  • Effective interpersonal and collaboration skills within a technical team

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Experience with agile software development
  • Experience with DevOps tools and practices (e.g., Git, GitLab, Docker, Jenkins, Bash, Linux, CI/CD, Sentry, Datadog)
  • Familiarity with satellite engineering and/or the space environment and its challenges
  • Hands-on experience operating spacecraft or remote systems
  • Familiarity with automation and optimization tools
  • Contributions to open-source software projects

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by German, EU, or U.S. authorities.

Benefits While Working at Planet:

This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses and/or equity.

Why we care so much about Belonging. 
We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.  If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!  At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.  We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.  We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.
